title: When do machine-learned exchange-correlation improvements inherit into density-functional tight binding?
summary: Machine-learned exchange-correlation functionals correct band gaps at near-semilocal cost, while density-functional tight binding reaches the $10^3$-$10^6$-atom regime; combining them assumes that a better parent yields a better parameterization, but we show it does not. Current-generation functionals are orbital-dependent generalized Kohn-Sham operators, whereas the parameterization channel is built on a multiplicative potential, preventing exact representation. Using the transfer ratio, the surviving fraction of a parent-level change, we find anti-transfer: coherently negative ratios across four covalent semiconductors move the gap in the wrong direction, consistent with a molecular proxy and an r$^2$SCAN control. The minimal-basis overgap is dominated by the on-site convention rather than basis incompleteness; correcting the on-site block removes most of it, while one $d$-polarization shell closes a further $16$-$40%$, depending on the placement of the empty $d$ level, which no free-atom eigenvalue uniquely fixes. Occupied-manifold enhancements, ionic and closed-shell repulsive potentials, and rocksalt-oxide gaps inherit, whereas elemental and III-V covalent networks inherit neither gaps nor repulsive potentials and oxide networks inherit only the latter. We screen 23 elements and release the parameter sets, showing that the transfer ratio provides a cheap pre-test before any parameterization campaign.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个反直觉现象：将机器学习交换关联泛函与密度泛函紧束缚方法结合时，更好的母泛函并不必然产生更好的参数化结果，甚至可能出现"反迁移"效应（负传递率），使带隙向错误方向移动。作者通过传递率指标在四种共价半导体中发现一致的负相干传递率，并指出最小基组过隙主要由site约定而非基组不完备性主导。文章筛选了23种元素并发布了参数集，提出传递率可作为任何参数化工作前的廉价预测试。
AI.motivation: 现有假设认为更好的母泛函（如orbital-dependent的广义Kohn-Sham算符）必然能产生更好的密度泛函紧束缚参数化。但作者发现这个假设是错误的，因为参数化通道依赖乘法势，无法精确表示轨道依赖的算符，导致改进无法正确传递甚至反向传递。
AI.method: 引入"传递率"（transfer ratio）作为量化指标，衡量母泛函层级的改变有多少能存活到参数化结果中。通过四种共价半导体、分子代理和r²SCAN对照实验验证；区分最小基组过隙的主导因素（on-site约定 vs基组不完备性）；分析occupied流形增强、离子/闭壳层排斥势、氧化物带隙的继承行为；筛选23种元素并发布参数集。
AI.result: 发现负的相干传递率导致带隙向错误方向移动；最小基组过隙主要由on-site约定主导，一壳d极化可再消除16-40%的过隙（取决于空d能级的位置）；不同材料体系（元素、III-V共价、氧化物网络）对带隙和排斥势的继承情况各异；传递率可作为廉价的前置筛选测试。
AI.conclusion: 传递率提供了一种低成本、可操作的方法，在任何参数化工作前检测母泛函改进是否能正确传递。该发现打破了"更好母泛函→更好参数化"的固有假设，为机器学习与紧束缚方法结合的改进策略提供了重要指导。

title: Coherent Phonon Blocking in Superlattices
comment: 21 pages, 9 figures, The following article has been submitted to the Journal of Applied Physics. After it is published, it will be found at (https://publishing.aip.org/resources/librarians/products/journals/)
summary: At cryogenic temperatures, phonons become one of the dominant energy carriers and thus can strongly influence the performance of electronic and sensing devices. In this work, we present a wave-mechanics based framework that predicts phonon transmission and thermal resistance of arbitrarily thick superlattices while retaining all acoustic branches, mode-conversion pathways, and angles of incidence. By enforcing phase coherence, our model predicts frequency-dependent transmission through arbitrary multi-layered structures.We use a genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) to efficiently select both materials and layer thicknesses. Our success criterion is that constituent layers satisfy the quarter-wavelength condition of the dominant phonon frequencies at a target temperature. This strategy identifies novel bilayer combinations that achieve thermal resistance of up to 3000 times greater than previously reported superlattices. The identified superlattices are poised to advance any technology that relies on coherent acoustic scattering, from ultra-low-temperature thermal insulation in superconducting flip-chip assemblies to phonon-blocking components in micro- and nano-electromechanical systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于波动力学的框架，用于预测任意厚度超晶格中声子传输和热阻，保留所有声学分支、模式转换路径和入射角。通过相位相干性实现频率相关的传输预测，并利用遗传算法(NSGA-II)优化材料选择和层厚，使各层满足目标温度下主导声子频率的四分之一波长条件，识别出的新型双层组合热阻比此前报道的超晶格高3000倍。
AI.motivation: 在低温下声子成为主导能量载体，显著影响电子和传感设备性能，因此需要精确预测和优化超晶格结构以控制声子传输和热阻。
AI.method: 提出波动力学框架，通过相位相干性预测任意多层结构的频率相关声子传输；使用NSGA-II遗传算法同时优化材料选择和层厚，以四分之一波长条件作为成功标准。
AI.result: 识别出的新型双层超晶格组合实现的热阻比此前报告的超晶格高3000倍。
AI.conclusion: 该超晶格可应用于超导倒装芯片组件的超低温热绝缘以及微/纳机电系统中的声子阻挡组件，推动依赖相干声学散射的技术发展。

title: Higher-order nonadiabaticity governs the temperature dependence of the phonon spectrum
summary: Nonadiabatic effects determine the frequency and linewidth of coupled phonon modes, shape of Kohn anomalies and have important implications on many material properties. State-of-the-art ab-initio nonadiabatic phonon self-energy relies on an infinite electron lifetime approximation, which cannot capture the temperature dependence of the phonon spectrum, neglects long-wavelength intraband phonon decay, and exhibits exaggerated phonon splitting. In MgB$_2$, we show how the higher-order nonadiabatic phonon corrections mitigate these deficiencies, yielding linewidths in a closer experimental agreement and a dome-like coupling strength temperature dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了MgB₂中高阶非绝热声子修正，证明这些修正能够克服传统无限电子寿命近似的缺陷，包括温度依赖、长波长带内声子衰减的缺失以及过度的声子分裂问题，从而获得与实验更一致的线宽和穹顶状耦合强度温度依赖。
AI.motivation: 最先进的从头算非绝热声子自能依赖于无限电子寿命近似，这无法捕捉声子谱的温度依赖性、忽略了长波长带内声子衰变，并表现出夸大的声子分裂，限制了理论预测的准确性。
AI.method: 在MgB₂中引入高阶非绝热声子修正，超越无限电子寿命近似的限制。
AI.result: 高阶非绝热声子修正减轻了上述缺陷，得到的声子线宽与实验更接近，并表现出穹顶状的耦合强度温度依赖关系。
AI.conclusion: 高阶非绝热声子修正是精确描述耦合声子模式频率、线宽和Kohn异常的必要条件，对理解材料性质具有重要意义。

title: Data-Efficient Construction of Material-Specific Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials from Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics Trajectories
summary: Pretrained machine-learning interatomic potentials, so-called universal or foundation models offer an appealing starting point for atomistic simulations, but their accuracy for material-specific observables often remains limited without additional reference data (fine-tuning). Here, we systematically quantify how much first-principles data are required to convert universal models into ab initio-accurate material-specific potentials, and ask whether fine-tuning is necessarily preferable to training from scratch. We compare five universal MLIP frameworks, MACE-MP-0, SevenNet-0, GRACE-1L-OAM, MatterSim-v1-5M and ORB-v2, across seven chemically diverse systems incorporating rare and reactive events. Fine-tuning on only 10 AIMD-derived configurations is insufficient for the investigated systems; 200 configurations succeed in favorable cases, but the outcome remains strongly system-dependent. By contrast, 2000 AIMD configurations constitute a robust default, yielding low force and energy errors and reproducing the target material-specific observables. Moderately dense sub-sampling of the AIMD trajectory reduces the required trajectory length tenfold with little loss in model quality. Training from scratch on the same datasets is competitive with, and often slightly more accurate than, naive fine-tuning for MACE and SevenNet, whereas GRACE requires more data. The energy profile for a sulfur-vacancy jump in MoS$_2$ reveals that low trajectory-level errors do not guarantee a correct reaction profile, highlighting the need for observable-level validation. Finally, we show that averaging independently trained models improves predictions in scarce-data regimes at no additional first-principles cost. Together, these results provide practical guidelines for converting limited AIMD reference data into reliable material-specific MLIPs for nanosecond-timescale simulations at near-DFT accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统量化了将通用机器学习原子间势（基础模型）微调为材料特定高精度势能所需的从头算数据量，比较了五种通用MLIP框架在七个化学体系上的表现，发现2000个AIMD构型是稳健默认值，200个在有利情况下可成功，10个基本不够；训练从头开始训练可与朴素微调竞争甚至更优；低轨迹级误差不保证反应路径正确。
AI.motivation: 通用（基础）机器学习原子间势模型虽具吸引力，但其对材料特定可观测量的精度往往有限，需要额外的参考数据进行微调。然而，究竟需要多少从头算数据才能将通用模型转化为具有从头算精度的材料特定势能，以及微调是否必然优于从头训练，这些问题尚未被系统量化。
AI.method: 对五种通用MLIP框架（MACE-MP-0、SevenNet-0、GRACE-1L-OAM、MatterSim-v1-5M和ORB-v2），在七个化学多样且包含稀有和反应事件的体系上进行系统实验。比较不同数据量（10、200、2000个AIMD构型）下的微调效果，评估AIMD轨迹子采样策略、从头训练对比微调的性能差异，并引入模型集成平均来改善稀缺数据场景。
AI.result: ①10个AIMD构型微调不足；②200个在有利情况下可成功但高度依赖体系；③2000个是稳健默认值，可获得低力和能量误差；④中等密度的轨迹子采样可减少十倍轨迹长度而不损失模型质量；⑤MACE和SevenNet从头训练可与朴素微调竞争甚至更准确，GRACE需要更多数据；⑥低轨迹级误差不保证正确的反应路径（S空位跳跃能量剖面）；⑦独立训练的模型集成平均在稀缺数据情景下可改善预测。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为将有限的AIMD参考数据转化为可靠的、可用于纳秒时间尺度模拟、接近DFT精度的材料特定MLIPs提供了实用指南。

title: Characterization of Thermal Systems from Noisy and Low-resolution Measurements Using Dynamic Mode Decomposition
summary: Thermal monitoring in practical applications is often constrained by sparse sensing, measurement noise, and limited spatial resolution, which hinder the identification of heat transfer dynamics. In such settings, calibrating high-fidelity physical models is computationally demanding, motivating data-driven approaches. Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) provides a framework for extracting spatiotemporal structures from measurement data, but its standard formulation is sensitive to noise and degraded observations. This chapter examines the use of DMD under these constraints, focusing on preprocessing and truncation strategies that affect stability and interpretability. Two cases are considered: forced convection with thermocouple data and transient heat conduction from degraded thermal images. The number of retained modes is treated as a modeling parameter that governs the trade-off between reconstruction fidelity and noise sensitivity. The results indicate that DMD recovers dominant thermal behavior from both sparse and degraded datasets when the truncation level is appropriately selected. Low-rank models provide stable but simplified descriptions, while higher-rank models improve spatial detail at the cost of increased noise sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在稀疏传感、噪声和低空间分辨率的实际约束下，如何利用动态模式分解（DMD）进行热监测，并探讨了预处理和截断策略对模型稳定性与可解释性的影响。
AI.motivation: 实际热监测中常面临稀疏传感、测量噪声和空间分辨率有限等约束，导致难以识别传热动态。高保真物理模型校准计算成本高昂，促使研究者寻求数据驱动方法。
AI.method: 采用动态模式分解（DMD）框架，重点研究预处理与截断策略对稳定性和可解释性的影响。将保留模式数作为建模参数，权衡重建保真度与噪声敏感性。考虑两个案例：热电偶数据的受迫对流和退化热图像的瞬态热传导。
AI.result: 当截断级别选择适当时，DMD能够从稀疏和退化的数据集中恢复主导热行为。低秩模型提供稳定但简化的描述，而高秩模型改善空间细节但增加噪声敏感性。
AI.conclusion: DMD在适当的模式截断选择下，能够有效处理稀疏和退化的热监测数据，模式截断级别是控制重建质量与噪声鲁棒性之间权衡的关键参数。

title: No-Go Theorem and Routes towards Cavity-Enhanced Superconductivity
summary: Recent experiments reporting cavity-vacuum-modified superconductivity raise a fundamental question: under what conditions can vacuum electromagnetic fluctuations increase a superconducting transition temperature? Starting from a Ginzburg--Landau theory minimally coupled to a quantized cavity mode, we derive the cavity-induced renormalization of the superconducting free energy. This correction comprises a positive diamagnetic contribution and a negative paramagnetic exchange contribution. We prove that, in a passive cavity, the latter cannot exceed the former, establishing a no-go theorem: within minimal cavity electrodynamics, vacuum fluctuations suppress, rather than enhance, superconductivity. We then identify two routes beyond this constraint, both involving additional collective degrees of freedom. In the collective-mode route, a cavity-active excitation amplifies the attractive paramagnetic contribution. In the competing-order route, the cavity weakens an order that competes with superconductivity, thereby indirectly enhancing superconductivity. Together, these results turn the no-go theorem into a practical design principle: cavity superconductivity enhancement requires an additional cavity-coupled material mode that either strengthens paramagnetic exchange or suppresses a competing order.

AI.tldr: 该论文从Ginzburg-Landau理论出发，研究真空电磁涨落对超导转变温度的影响，证明无源腔中真空涨落会抑制而非增强超导（no-go定理），并指出通过集体模式或竞争序两条途径可突破该限制，实现腔增强超导。
AI.motivation: 近期实验报道了腔真空修饰超导现象，但真空电磁涨落何时能提高超导转变温度这一基本问题尚不清晰，本文旨在从理论上厘清条件并给出设计原则。
AI.method: 从量子化腔模式最小耦合的Ginzburg-Landau理论出发，推导腔诱导的超导自由能重整化，分别获得正抗磁贡献和负顺磁交换贡献，并证明无源腔中顺磁项不能超过抗磁项；随后分析两条突破路径：集体模式路径和竞争序路径。
AI.result: 证明了无源腔中真空涨落必然抑制超导（no-go定理）；识别出两条可增强超导的路径：腔活跃集体激发放大顺磁吸引贡献，或腔削弱与超导竞争的序从而间接增强超导。
AI.conclusion: No-go定理转化为实用设计原则：腔增强超导需要额外的腔耦合材料模式，该模式要么增强顺磁交换，要么抑制竞争序。

title: Electronic structure and magnetic correlations in the epitaxially strained bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_{7}$
summary: Using the DFT+dynamical mean-field theory method we study the effects of electron-electron correlations and epitaxial strain of the crystal structure on the normal-state electronic structure, quasiparticle band renormalizations, Fermi surface, and magnetic correlations of the bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ (LNO). Our results exhibit a remarkable orbital-selective renormalization and strong incoherence of the Ni $3d$ bands, pointing to the proximity of the Ni $x^2-y^2$ and $3z^2-r^2$ states to orbital-selective localization. The electronic properties of LNO show a high sensitivity to the in-plane strain. We note that both a tensile and a moderate compressive strain (up to about $-2$\%) yield a significant enhancement of magnetic correlations compared to the unstrained LNO. Under a large compressive strain of about $-4$\%, we observe a Lifshitz transition characterized by the disappearance of the $γ$ Fermi surface sheet, which is associated with a nearly fully occupied, shallow flat-band of the bonding Ni $3z^2-r^2$ orbital character. As a result, we observe a sharp decrease of magnetic correlations, implying suppression of superconductivity. Overall, our results support the picture of spin- and change-density-wave stripe instability driven by the Fermi surface nesting in LNO. Our results suggest that both pressure and strain can effectively tune (suppress or enhance) spin-change-density-wave ordering, giving rise to enhanced spin fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文利用DFT+动力学平均场理论研究了双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍氧化物La₃Ni₂O₇中电子关联效应和外延应变对正常态电子结构、准粒子能带重整化、费米面及磁关联的影响。研究发现Ni 3d能带呈现显著的轨道选择性重整化和强非相干性，电子性质对面内应变高度敏感，拉伸和中等压缩应变（约-2%）增强磁关联，而约-4%的大压缩应变导致Lifshitz转变，抑制磁关联和超导性，支持自旋/电荷密度波条纹不稳定性由费米面嵌套驱动的观点。
AI.motivation: 理解La₃Ni₂O₇超导体的电子关联效应和应变调控机制，探讨磁关联与超导电性的关系，以及压力/应变如何有效调控自旋-电荷密度波有序。
AI.method: 采用DFT+动力学平均场理论（DMFT）方法，系统研究电子-电子关联和晶格外延应变对La₃Ni₂O₇正常态电子结构的联合影响，包括能带重整化、费米面和磁关联的分析。
AI.result: 发现Ni 3d能带具有轨道选择性重整化和强非相干性，位于轨道选择性局域化边缘；应变调控下，拉伸和-2%压缩应变增强磁关联，而-4%大压缩应变引发Lifshitz转变（γ费米面片消失），对应键合Ni 3z²-r²轨道浅平带的近完全占据，导致磁关联急剧下降。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持LNO中由费米面嵌套驱动的自旋/电荷密度波条纹不稳定性图像，压力与应变可有效抑制或增强自旋-电荷密度波有序，从而调控自旋涨落和超导电性。

title: Trimer Thouless Pump: Topology, Symmetries, and Multigap Structure
summary: Topological charge pumping is paradigmatically understood through two-band systems such as the Rice-Mele model, which are intrinsically restricted to a single independent pumping channel. In this work, we introduce the Trimer Thouless Pump (TTP), a minimal three-band generalization that exhibits genuinely multigap topological transport. By subjecting a one-dimensional three-site lattice to cyclic adiabatic modulations of its hopping amplitudes and antisymmetric onsite potentials, we explore a topological regime characterized by two independent bulk gaps. We show that the quantized charge transport is driven by highly localized Berry curvature hotspots corresponding to effective two-level Dirac avoided crossings on the parameter torus. Crucially, we demonstrate that the middle energy band acts as a geometric mediator: it facilitates the exchange of quantized Berry flux between the upper and lower bands while maintaining a net zero Chern number itself. This bulk topology is corroborated by the spectral flow of boundary-localized edge states traversing multiple gaps. Furthermore, we map the topological phase diagram as a function of central-site detuning, illustrating a band-selective transfer of topological invariants across discrete phase transitions. Finally, we propose a concrete experimental protocol to realize the TTP and observe its multigap charge transport using ultracold atoms in phase-controlled optical superlattices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种三带最小推广模型——三聚体Thouless泵（TTP），其在一维三格点晶格上通过循环绝热调制跳跃振幅和反对称在位势，展现出真正的多带隙拓扑传输。中间能带充当几何媒介，以净陈数为零的方式促成上下带之间量子化Berry通量的交换，并通过边界态谱流和相位图加以验证，最后提出了超冷原子实验实现方案。
AI.motivation: 传统的拓扑荷泵浦（如Rice-Mele模型）仅限于两带系统，本质上只能存在单一独立的泵浦通道，无法充分探索多带隙拓扑输运的丰富物理。作者希望突破这一限制，提出一个最小化的三带推广模型，以研究多带隙拓扑电荷传输及其背后的几何机制。
AI.method: 作者将一维三格点晶格置于循环绝热调制的跳跃振幅和反对称在位势之下，通过对参数环面上的Berry曲率热点分析（对应有效两能级Dirac反交叉），表征量子化电荷输运。利用中间能带的几何媒介作用分析Berry通量交换，通过边界局域边缘态的谱流验证体拓扑，并绘制以中心格点失谐为变量的拓扑相图，最后提出基于相位控制光学超晶格中超冷原子的实验协议。
AI.result: 研究展示了TTP具有两个独立体带隙的拓扑区域，量子化电荷输运由高度局域的Berry曲率热点驱动；中间能带作为几何媒介，以净陈数为零的方式实现上下带之间Berry通量的交换。边界态谱流横穿多个带隙证实了体拓扑，拓扑相图显示了跨离散相变时拓扑不变量的带选择性转移，并给出了具体的实验实现方案。
AI.conclusion: TTP作为三带推广模型，突破了传统两带Thouless泵的固有局限，揭示了多带隙系统中复杂的拓扑电荷输运机制——特别是中间带作为零陈数媒介的角色，为拓扑泵浦研究提供了新的理论框架和可行的实验路径。

title: Exact Thermoelectric Transport Coefficients and Figure of Merit for Graphene Photothermoelectric Devices from a Finite Zeta-Function Mott Series
summary: The standard Mott formula is widely used to describe thermoelectric transport, but it becomes less accurate when the temperature is not much smaller than the Fermi energy. In this work, we develop an all-orders extension of the Mott approach using a series of Riemann zeta functions. We show that when the transport function is a polynomial, the series ends after a finite number of terms, giving exact results within the model. We apply this method to graphene photothermoelectric devices using a quadratic conductivity model. The results provide closed-form expressions for the Seebeck coefficient, Lorenz ratio, and electronic figure of merit. The analysis shows that the Seebeck coefficient reaches a maximum instead of increasing indefinitely, while the Wiedemann-Franz law can be significantly violated at higher temperatures. We also find that disorder reduces the thermoelectric performance and that the electronic figure of merit has an upper limit in the clean graphene model. Finally, we discuss the effect of radiative heat transport on the figure of merit. These results provide a simple analytical way to study graphene thermoelectric transport beyond the usual low-temperature Mott approximation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种基于黎曼zeta函数级数的全阶Mott公式扩展方法，用于描述石墨烯热电输运。该方法在输运函数为多项式时精确收敛，并给出了塞贝克系数、洛伦兹比和电子品质因子的闭式表达式，揭示了塞贝克系数存在最大值、Wiedemann-Franz定律在高温下显著偏离、无序降低热电性能以及电子品质因子存在上限等重要结论。
AI.motivation: 标准的Mott公式在温度远小于费米能时有效，但当温度与费米能相当或更高时精度下降，需要一种超越低温Mott近似的解析方法来描述热电输运。
AI.method: 使用一系列黎曼zeta函数构建Mott方法的全阶（all-orders）扩展；当输运函数为多项式时该级数在有限项后终止，从而在模型内获得精确结果；将该方法应用于基于二次电导率模型的石墨烯光热电器件。
AI.result: 获得了塞贝克系数、洛伦兹比和电子品质因子的闭式表达式。发现塞贝克系数达到最大值而非无限增长；高温下Wiedemann-Franz定律显著违背；无序降低热电性能；洁净石墨烯模型中电子品质因子存在上限；并讨论了辐射热输运对品质因子的影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种简单的解析方法，可用于研究超出传统低温Mott近似的石墨烯热电输运行为，为理解和优化石墨烯热电器件性能提供了理论工具。

title: Multi-Agent Closed-Loop Reasoning for Organic Structure Elucidation from Multimodal Spectra
summary: Following the molecular discovery and synthesis revolutions, scalable automated structure elucidation from routine spectroscopic data remains an outstanding challenge. Despite decades of computational efforts, no existing system achieved reliable reasoning over unseen spectra. Here, we propose MACROS, a multi-agent system automating structure elucidation by emulating expert iterative hypothesis-testing. Trained on 100M simulated and 1.6M experimental spectra-molecule pairs, it natively supports arbitrary combinations of routine spectroscopic techniques. It achieves unprecedented zero-shot generalization to diverse real-world samples, correctly identifying synthetic compounds, natural products and metabolites above 500 Da with 1D NMR. Remarkably, MACROS spontaneously recovers textbook spectroscopic correlations from unassigned data and exhibits emergent chemical intuition such as a ring-first parsing preference, learning fundamental chemical principles rather than memorizing database patterns. MACROS augments chemists via collaboration to deliver sixfold faster, 40% more accurate elucidation. MACROS establishes a scalable foundation for fully automated structure elucidation, and catalyzes accelerated molecular discovery toward autonomous laboratories.

AI.tldr: MACROS是一个多智能体系统，通过模拟专家的迭代假设-检验推理过程来自动化分子结构解析。在1亿模拟和160万实验光谱-分子对数据上训练，支持任意常规光谱技术组合，实现了对多样真实世界样本前所未有的零样本泛化能力，并能自发恢复教科书级光谱相关规律。与化学家协作可将解析速度提升6倍、准确率提升40%。
AI.motivation: 尽管分子发现和合成经历了革命性发展，但从常规光谱数据中进行可扩展的自动化结构解析仍然是重大挑战。经过数十年计算努力，现有系统均无法对未见光谱实现可靠的推理，因此亟需一种能模拟专家推理过程的新方法。
AI.method: 提出MACROS多智能体系统，通过模拟专家迭代假设-检验的推理范式进行结构解析。系统在1亿模拟光谱和160万实验光谱-分子对上进行训练，原生支持任意组合的常规光谱技术，并通过多智能体协作实现自主推理与假设验证。
AI.result: 在多样真实世界样本上实现了前所未有的零样本泛化，能正确识别合成化合物、天然产物及500 Da以上的代谢物（使用1D NMR）。系统自发恢复了教科书中的光谱相关规律，并展现出涌现的化学直觉（如环优先解析偏好）。与化学家协作时，解析速度提升6倍，准确率提升40%。
AI.conclusion: MACROS建立了全自动结构解析的可扩展基础，学习的是基本化学原理而非记忆数据库模式，为加速分子发现并推动自主实验室的发展铺平了道路。

title: Paraexciton Excitation in Cu$_2$O under Laguerre--Gaussian Illumination
summary: In Cu$_2$O the lowest yellow exciton, the $Γ_2^+$ paraexciton, is optically inaccessible in conventional spectroscopy because transitions to this state are forbidden in both electric-dipole and electric-quadrupole approximations. We investigate whether optical fields carrying orbital angular momentum (OAM) can overcome this restriction. A microscopic symmetry analysis identifies the gradient-assisted $l=5$ and direct $l=6$ OAM channels as the leading contributions that couple to the paraexciton, independent of the detailed radial profile of the optical field. Calculations for finite-waist Laguerre--Gaussian beams, however, show that the corresponding matrix elements are strongly suppressed because the optical field varies only weakly over the exciton Bohr radius. Thus, satisfying the OAM selection rule alone is insufficient: efficient excitation requires not only the correct angular symmetry but also optical-field variations on the spatial scale of the exciton. This second condition is achieved by localized OAM fields. Expressing the coupling in terms of the physical intensity-ring radius provides a direct comparison between the optical and excitonic length scales and reveals that the optimal localization is determined primarily by the polynomial degree of the target cubic harmonic. For the degree-six $Γ_2^+$ paraexciton the strongest coupling occurs for an intensity-ring radius of approximately $6a_B$--$7a_B$. These results establish that paraexciton excitation is governed jointly by symmetry and spatial localization: cubic symmetry selects the allowed OAM channels, whereas the polynomial degree sets the characteristic radial scale for efficient coupling. This work provides both the symmetry framework and a practical design rule for engineering structured-light excitation of paraexcitons in Cu$_2$O.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了利用携带轨道角动量（OAM）的光学涡旋场来激发Cu₂O中光学禁戒的Γ₂⁺黄激子束缚态（paraexciton）。微观对称性分析确定了梯度辅助l=5和直接l=6的OAM通道可以耦合到该态，但有限束腰的拉盖尔-高斯光束由于光场在激子玻尔半径尺度内变化太弱而被强烈抑制。作者发现需要同时满足角对称性和光场在激子空间尺度上的局域化两个条件，并推导出最优耦合对应的强度环半径约为6a_B–7a_B，为工程化设计结构光激发paraexciton提供了设计规则。
AI.motivation: Cu₂O中最低黄激子（Γ₂⁺ paraexciton）在电偶极和电四极近似下都是光学禁戒的，传统光谱学无法直接激发，这限制了对该态的研究。作者希望探索携带轨道角动量的光场能否克服这一光学禁戒，从而实现对paraexciton的直接激发。
AI.method: 通过微观对称性分析识别允许的OAM耦合通道（l=5梯度辅助和l=6直接通道）；对有限束腰Laguerre-Gaussian光束计算跃迁矩阵元；将耦合强度用物理强度环半径表达，以直接比较光学与激子长度尺度，确定最优局域化条件。
AI.result: 有限束腰LG光束的耦合被强烈抑制，因为光场在激子玻尔半径内变化过弱；仅满足OAM选择定则不够，还需光场在激子尺度上空间变化。对于六阶Γ₂⁺ paraexciton，最优耦合出现在强度环半径约6a_B–7a_B处，主要由目标立方谐波的多项式阶数决定。
AI.conclusion: Paraexciton激发同时受对称性和空间局域化控制：立方对称性选择允许的OAM通道，而多项式阶数设定高效耦合的特征径向尺度。该工作为Cu₂O中paraexciton的结构光激发提供了对称性框架和实用设计规则。

title: Updated all-electron Dirac--Fock densities and an element-adaptive parameterisation of scattering factors and potentials for neutral atoms
comment: 45 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Acta Crystallographica Section A
summary: Updated reference data and an analytic parameterisation of elastic electron and X-ray scattering are presented for all 118 neutral atoms. The reference electron densities for the multi-electron elements $Z=2$--$118$ are computed with the relativistic B-spline Dirac--Fock code atomx, while hydrogen is constructed from the exact relativistic one-electron Dirac $1s$ solution; the electron scattering factor $f_e(g)$, X-ray scattering factor $f_x(g)$ and radial moments are derived from these densities. The reported parameterisation extends the fixed-size Lobato--Van Dyck hydrogenic expansion while retaining closed-form expressions for $f_x(g)$, $ρ(r)$, the electrostatic potential $V(r)$ and the projected potential $V(R)$. These extensions are an element-adaptive basis size $n_t(Z)$, a simultaneous real- and reciprocal-space fit, an exact $\langle r^4\rangle$ constraint in place of the non-relativistic Kato cusp, and a charge-carrying Dirac--Padé basis term that adds a polynomial-times-exponential shape channel without replacing the hydrogenic basis by a tabulated Dirac radial function or assigning the term to a physical shell. For the same total parameter count, the Dirac--Padé-enriched basis improves on the parameter-matched non-relativistic basis for 111 of the 118 elements, lowering the mean total cost by 39\%. Relative to a controlled fixed five-term refit on the same reference grid and objective, the element-adaptive bases improve the median reciprocal-space deviations by about three to four orders of magnitude and resolve shell structure in $4πr^2ρ(r)$ that the fixed five-term basis cannot. The largest changes occur near the nucleus and in the reciprocal-space tail beyond the legacy 12 inverse angstroms range, which is directly relevant to quantitative high-angle scattering and electron-diffraction measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文为全部118种中性原子提供了更新参考数据和弹性电子/X射线散射的分析参数化。多电子元素（Z=2-118）的电子密度使用相对论B-spline Dirac-Fock代码atomx计算，氢则使用精确相对论Dirac 1s解。该参数化扩展了Lobato-Van Dyck类氢展开，引入了元素自适应基大小、实空间与倒空间联合拟合、精确<r^4>约束以及携带电荷的Dirac-Padé基项，在总参数数相同的情况下，对111种元素优于参数匹配的非相对论基，平均总成本降低39%。
AI.motivation: 需要更准确、更通用的电子和X射线散射因子参数化方法，以支撑定量高角散射和电子衍射测量，尤其是现有固定规模展开在近核区和倒空间尾部（>12Å⁻¹）存在不足。
AI.method: 采用相对论B-spline Dirac-Fock代码atomx计算Z=2-118的参考电子密度，氢用精确相对论解；在此基础上扩展Lobato-Van Dyck氢化展开，增加元素自适应基大小n_t(Z)、实空间与倒空间联合拟合、精确<r^4>约束替代非相对论Kato尖端，以及Dirac-Padé基项提供多项式乘指数形状通道。
AI.result: 在相同总参数数下，Dirac-Padé富集基对118种元素中的111种优于参数匹配的非相对论基，平均总成本降低39%；元素自适应基相比固定五项基，中位倒空间偏差改善3-4个数量级，并能解析固定五项基无法呈现的4πr²ρ(r)壳层结构。
AI.conclusion: 元素自适应的Dirac-Padé富集参数化在近核区和倒空间尾部显著提升精度，对定量高角散射和电子衍射测量具有直接的实际意义，为所有118种元素提供了改进的电子和X射线散射分析描述。

title: Rapid supercurrent decay in Mn$_5$Si$_3$ Josephson junctions
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures main text. 4 pages, 2 figures SM
summary: Theoretical work predicts that Josephson junctions containing metallic altermagnetic barriers should display $0$-$π$ transitions of the critical current as a function of both barrier thickness and temperature, with the decay and oscillation period of the supercurrent depending on the orientation of the crystal axes relative to the transport direction. Motivated by these predictions, and by reports of a compensated magnetic phase attributed to altermagnetism in epitaxial Mn$_5$Si$_3$ thin films, we fabricate and measure Nb/Pt/Mn$_5$Si$_3$/Pt/Nb Josephson junctions varying the thickness of the Mn$_5$Si$_3$ barrier. The critical current decays as a single exponential over more than four orders of magnitude with decay length $ξ_{\text{Mn}_5\text{Si}_3} = 0.31 \pm 0.03$ nm, shorter than reported for Josephson junctions containing the metallic antiferromagnets FeMn, Cr, and NiMn. The Mn$_5$Si$_3$ barrier has an estimated current-perpendicular-to-plane resistivity of $320 \pm 10 μΩ\,$cm. No $0$-$π$ transition is resolved at the sampled barrier thicknesses, and the temperature dependence of the critical current of a junction with a 1 nm barrier is smooth and monotonic. We discuss the absence of resolvable transitions in terms of the microstructure of the barrier, its uncertain magnetic phase, and the narrow thickness window imposed by the rapid decay, and identify barriers with well-defined crystalline orientation as the key requirement for future tests of altermagnetic Josephson physics.

AI.tldr: 本文制备并测量了Nb/Pt/Mn₅Si₃/Pt/Nb约瑟夫森结，发现临界电流随Mn₅Si₃势垒厚度呈单指数衰减（衰减长度0.31±0.03 nm），但未观察到理论预测的0-π转变。作者讨论了可能原因（势垒微结构、磁性相不确定性、厚度窗口太窄），指出具有明确晶体取向的势垒是未来测试交错磁约瑟夫森物理的关键。
AI.motivation: 理论预测含金属交错磁（altermagnetic）势垒的约瑟夫森结应表现出临界电流随势垒厚度和温度的0-π转变，且超流的衰减和振荡周期依赖于晶轴方向相对输运方向的取向。Mn₅Si₃外延薄膜被报道具有补偿磁性相并归因于交错磁性，因此是验证这些理论预测的理想候选材料。
AI.method: 制备了Nb/Pt/Mn₅Si₃/Pt/Nb约瑟夫森结，系统地改变Mn₅Si₃势垒层的厚度，测量临界电流随厚度和温度的变化，并与已知的含金属反铁磁（FeMn、Cr、NiMn）约瑟夫森结进行对比。
AI.result: 临界电流在超过四个数量级范围内呈单指数衰减，衰减长度ξ=0.31±0.03 nm，短于含FeMn、Cr和NiMn的结；势垒层估算的电流垂直平面电阻率为320±10 μΩ·cm；在采样的势垒厚度范围内未解析出0-π转变，1 nm势垒结的临界电流温度依赖是光滑单调的。
AI.conclusion: 由于势垒微结构、磁性相不确定以及临界电流快速衰减导致的窄厚度窗口，实验中未能观察到可分辨的0-π转变。作者强调具有明确晶体取向的势垒是实现未来交错磁约瑟夫森物理测试的关键要求。

title: Antiferroquadrupolar Order in Altermagnetic CoF$_2$
summary: Altermagnets host non-relativistic spin-split electronic states whose microscopic origin is theoretically linked to a hidden charge order, yet experimental studies of this charge order are limited. We therefore investigate charge order within CoF$_2$, a $d$-wave altermagnetic compound with a rutile crystal structure and $Γ$-point antiferromagnetism. Combining resonant elastic X-ray scattering, symmetry analysis and ab initio calculations, we directly observe charge ordering and identify it as antiferroquadrupolar in nature. Via electronic structure calculations, we show that the experimentally observed antiferroquadrupolar order gives rise to the characteristic altermagnetic spin-splitting, thereby establishing empirical evidence for the decomposition of the altermagnetic order parameter into magnetic and charge degrees of freedom. We hence demonstrate that antiferroquadrupolar order is the microscopic origin of altermagnetism in CoF$_2$, with implications to the wider family of rutile altermagnets. Furthermore, our approach is applicable to studying altermagnetism in general, having demonstrated that resonant elastic X-ray scattering can serve as a direct probe of the charge multipoles that underpin spin-split electronic states in these materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过共振弹性X射线散射、对称性分析和第一性原理计算，首次直接观测到CoF₂中的反铁四极子电荷序，并证明该电荷序是d波交变磁（altermagnetism）自旋劈裂现象的微观起源，从而建立了交变磁序参量分解为磁性和电荷自由度的实验证据。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体的非相对论自旋劈裂电子态在理论上被认为与隐藏的电荷序有关，但此前缺乏直接的实验观测证据。作者旨在通过实验直接验证这一理论联系，揭示交变磁性的微观起源。
AI.method: 结合三种互补手段：(1) 共振弹性X射线散射（REXS）直接探测电荷序信号；(2) 对称性分析识别电荷序的对称性性质；(3) 第一性原理电子结构计算验证所观测的反铁四极子序与交变磁自旋劈裂之间的因果关系。
AI.result: 直接观测到CoF₂中的电荷序，并鉴定其为反铁四极子（antiferroquadrupolar）性质；电子结构计算表明该反铁四极子序正是CoF₂中特征性交变磁自旋劈裂的起源，为交变磁序参量分解为磁性和电荷自由度提供了经验证据。
AI.conclusion: 反铁四极子序是CoF₂中交变磁性的微观起源，该结论可推广至更广泛的金红石结构交变磁体家族。此外，共振弹性X射线散射被证明是探测支撑自旋劈裂电子态的电荷多极序的直接有效手段，具有普适性。

title: Spectral preservation under momentum-dependent similarity transformations in non-Hermitian lattice systems
summary: We investigate the conditions under which momentum-dependent similarity transformations preserve spectral properties of lattice Hamiltonians with open boundary conditions (OBC). While such transformations exactly preserve spectra in infinite systems, their application to finite systems introduces subtleties due to the long-range nature of the inverse transformation in real space. For general traceless $2\times 2$ Hamiltonians, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions for reduction to skew-diagonal form via constant similarity transforms, providing explicit transformation matrices for all cases. We then establish rigorous conditions for bulk spectral preservation under momentum-dependent transformations: the generalized Brillouin zone of $H$ must lie inside the smallest zero of $\det S(z)$ (the two-radius condition $r_{\mathrm{GBZ}}^{\max}<z_{\min}$), together with a spectral-stability (no critical non-Hermitian skin effect) condition on $H$. Two-sidedness of $S(z)$ governs only the modification of a finite number of boundary eigenvalues, not the bulk. Our results establish when bulk topological invariants computed in transformed coordinates reliably predict boundary physics, with implications for non-Hermitian systems, photonic crystals, and other platforms where chiral or hidden symmetries emerge only after appropriate basis changes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了动量依赖性相似变换在何种条件下能保持开放边界条件（OBC）下晶格哈密顿量的谱性质。推导了2×2无迹哈密顿量经常数相似变换化为斜对角形式的充要条件，并确立了体态谱保持的严格条件：广义布里渊区（GBZ）需位于det S(z)最小零点之内（两半径条件），同时满足谱稳定性（无临界非厄米趋肤效应）条件。
AI.motivation: 虽然动量依赖性相似变换在无限系统中精确保持谱，但在有限系统中由于逆变换在实空间中的长程性质而引入微妙问题。作者希望明确在何种条件下，经变换后计算出的体态拓扑不变量能够可靠地预测边界物理，这对于非厄米系统、光子晶体等平台中浮现的手性或隐藏对称性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 针对一般无迹2×2哈密顿量，推导了通过常数相似变换化为斜对角形式的充要条件，并给出所有情况的显式变换矩阵。随后建立了动量依赖变换下体态谱保持的严格条件：(1) 广义布里渊区最大值小于det S(z)的最小零点（两半径条件 r_GBZ^max < z_min）；(2) H满足谱稳定性条件（无临界非厄米趋肤效应）。分析了S(z)的双侧性质对边界特征值有限个数的修正作用。
AI.result: 确立了体态谱在动量依赖相似变换下保持的严格数学条件；证明了两半径条件与谱稳定性条件共同构成体态谱保持的充分条件；阐明S(z)的双侧性仅影响有限数量的边界特征值而非体态；给出了2×2无迹哈密顿量化为斜对角形式的所有显式变换矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 本研究建立了在变换坐标下计算的体态拓扑不变量能够可靠预测边界物理的精确条件，为非厄米系统、光子晶体等需要基变换才能浮现手性/隐藏对称性的平台提供了理论指导，揭示了动量依赖相似变换在有限系统中的适用边界。

title: The $6-ε$ Expansion for Long-Range Lee--Yang and Percolation Criticality
summary: The crossover from long-range (LR) to short-range (SR) criticality in percolation has remained unsettled because previous renormalization-group (RG) analysis within the $ε'=3σ-d$ expansion fixes the anomalous dimension at $η=2-σ$, whereas SR percolation has $η_{\rm SR}<0$ near $d=6$. Sak's matching condition then places the crossover above $σ=2$, outside the regime in which the LR interaction dominates. In spatial dimension $d=6-ε$, we formulate a perturbative expansion for the LR $φ^3$ field theory and perform a one-loop RG analysis throughout the perturbatively accessible nonclassical regime $0<δ<ε/3$, where $δ= 2-σ$. We derive the one-loop corrections to the critical exponents $η$ and $ν$, which acquire nontrivial dependence on $ε$ and $δ$. They reduce to their mean-field values at the LR upper critical line and continuously recover the SR $6-ε$ results as $σ\to2$. These results support a crossover threshold $σ_*=2$ and remove the apparent discontinuity of $η$ between the LR and SR values within this framework. The same approach also yields the anomalous and edge exponents of the LR Lee--Yang universality class and $q$-state Potts universality classes with $q<2$.

AI.tldr: 本文在d=6-ε维空间中，对长程（LR）φ³场论进行了微扰展开和单圈重整化群（RG）分析，在非经典区域0<δ<ε/3内推导出临界指数η和ν的单圈修正。结果表明LR到SR逾渗的交叉阈值σ_*=2，消除了η在LR和SR值之间的表观不连续性。
AI.motivation: 此前LR到SR逾渗临界性的交叉问题一直悬而未决。原因是已有的RG分析在ε'=3σ-d展开中将异常维数固定为η=2-σ，而SR逾渗在d=6附近有η_SR<0，这导致Sak匹配条件将交叉置于σ>2，超出了LR相互作用主导的范畴。作者希望解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 在空间维度d=6-ε中，作者构建了LR φ³场论的微扰展开，并在整个微扰可达的非经典区域0<δ<ε/3（其中δ=2-σ）内进行单圈RG分析。该方法推导出临界指数η和ν对ε和δ的依赖关系。该方法也推广到LR Lee-Yang普适类和q<2的q态Potts普适类，求得其异常指数和边界指数。
AI.result: 单圈修正后的η和ν在LR上临界线上还原为其平均场值，并且在σ→2时连续恢复到SR的6-ε结果。这些结果支持交叉阈值σ_*=2，消除了该框架内η在LR和SR值之间的表观不连续性。
AI.conclusion: 作者的新RG方案成功解决了LR到SR逾渗交叉的长期悬而未决的问题，确立了σ_*=2为交叉阈值，并展示了LR和SR临界指数之间的连续连接。该方法的有效性还扩展到其他普适类（Lee-Yang和q<2的Potts模型）。

title: Elucidating Trace Gas Interactions with Ice Surfaces using Molecular Dynamics
summary: Recent experimental work carried out by Yettapu, Manning, and Cyran on ice / vapor interfaces revealed changes in sum frequency generation (SFG) signals at ~ 3170 cm$^{-1}$ depending on whether acetone or methanol was adsorbed onto the ice at 223 K. They linked the transformation of that signal to the induced melting of the ice crystal. We present molecular dynamics modeling of their experiments using methanol and acetone layers adsorbed on the basal facet of a proton-ordered Ice-Ih crystal at temperatures of 223 K and 265 K. The width of the quasi-liquid layer (QLL), O-H bond frequencies, calculated SFG signals, and hydrogen bonding statistics all indicate changes due to the presence of the adsorbates. While we see no significant adsorbate-based differences in QLL formation, we find at 223 K that acetone preserves under-coordinated waters that are associated with a secondary water with a low frequency O-H bond, while methanol integrates more fully into the hydrogen bonding network, resulting in a narrower distribution of O-H bond frequencies. This change in hydrogen bonding produces a local modification of the electric field, which may contribute to the difference in the experimental SFG signals at low frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子动力学模拟研究了丙酮和甲醇吸附在冰晶表面时对冰/蒸气界面准液态层（QLL）的影响，发现虽然两者都能促进QLL形成，但丙酮能保留与低频O-H键相关的欠配位水分子，而甲醇则更完全地融入氢键网络，导致O-H键频率分布变窄，从而解释了实验中SFG信号在~3170 cm⁻¹处的差异。
AI.motivation: 解释Yettapu等人实验中观察到的丙酮和甲醇吸附在冰面上时SFG信号变化差异的微观机制，特别是与诱导冰融化的关联，需要通过计算模拟来验证和阐明氢键网络变化的根本原因。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学（MD）模拟，对质子在有序Ice-Ih晶体的基面吸附甲醇和丙酮层，在223 K和265 K两个温度下进行模拟，分析QLL宽度、O-H键振动频率、SFG信号以及氢键统计等指标。
AI.result: 两种吸附物均能改变QLL形成和氢键特征，但在223 K下，丙酮保留了与低频O-H键相关的欠配位水分子，而甲醇更完全地整合进氢键网络，导致O-H键频率分布更窄。这种氢键差异引起局部电场改变，可能解释了实验SFG信号在低频区域的差异。
AI.conclusion: 吸附物种类对冰表面氢键网络结构的影响不同是导致实验SFG信号差异的关键因素，甲醇和丙酮与冰表面水分子整合程度的差异通过局部电场调制影响了SFG响应。

title: Probing three-dimensional structures of complex colloidal quantum dots at the single-atomic level
summary: Colloidal quantum dots (QDs) are promising optoelectronic materials due to their size-tunable properties, yet their three-dimensional (3D) quantum confinement makes electronic states highly sensitive to structural and chemical heterogeneity, which critically impacts their optoelectronic performance. Accurately resolving the 3D atomic structure with sub-angstrom precision is thus essential for rational design. Here, we applied atomic electron tomography (AET) to determine, for the first time, the 3D atomic structure of complex core/shell QDs, resolving over 14,000 atoms per particle. Our reconstructions reveal surface morphology, eccentric cores, and nearly atomically abrupt heterovalent interfaces and identify anisotropic shell growth directed by twin boundaries. Utilizing an AET-derived atomic structure, we performed large-scale quantum mechanical calculations to uncover an orientation-dependent strain accommodation mechanism where the heterogeneous strain is compensated at interfaces and twin boundaries. Furthermore, our results reveal strain-induced localized states near the band edge, which contribute to the key features of the experimental ensemble absorption spectrum. This work sets a new benchmark for atomic-level characterization, establishing a powerful framework for the rational design of next-generation nanomaterials.

AI.tldr: 本文首次利用原子电子断层扫描（AET）技术，以亚埃级精度解析了复杂核/壳胶体量子点的三维原子结构，单颗粒解析超过1.4万个原子。重构结果揭示了表面形貌、偏心核、近原子级突变的异质界面，以及由孪晶界引导的各向异性壳层生长。结合大尺度量子力学计算，发现了取向依赖的应变补偿机制，并揭示了带边附近的应变诱导局域态，这些态对实验系综吸收光谱的关键特征有贡献，为下一代纳米材料理性设计建立了新框架。
AI.motivation: 胶体量子点因尺寸可调特性是有前景的光电材料，但其三维量子限域使电子态对结构和化学异质性高度敏感，严重影响光电性能。精确解析具有亚埃级精度的三维原子结构是理性设计的关键，但目前缺乏对复杂核/壳量子点三维原子结构的直接测定手段。
AI.method: 采用原子电子断层扫描（AET）技术对复杂核/壳量子点进行三维原子级重构，单颗粒解析超过14,000个原子；随后利用AET导出的原子结构进行大尺度量子力学计算，分析应变分布与电子态结构。
AI.result: 成功重构核/壳量子点的三维原子结构，揭示了表面形貌、偏心核、原子级突变的异质界面及孪晶界引导的各向异性壳层生长；量子力学计算发现了界面和孪晶界处补偿异质应变的取向依赖机制，并识别出应变诱导的带边附近局域态，这些态与实验吸收光谱的关键特征相符。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为原子级表征设立了新基准，建立了将三维原子结构与电子性质计算相结合的完整分析框架，为下一代纳米材料（特别是核/壳量子点）的理性设计与性能优化提供了关键的结构基元信息。

title: Plasolver: Physics-Informed Neural Operators for Elastoplasticity
summary: Elastoplastic analysis is computationally demanding because its nonlinear, path-dependent constitutive behavior requires incremental loading and repeated iterative solutions. To address this challenge, we propose Plasolver, a physics-informed neural operator framework that combines the efficiency of operator learning with the accuracy and robustness of classical numerical solvers. Plasolver consists of a physics-informed pretraining stage and an optional warm-start stage. During pretraining, the neural operator is trained solely by minimizing the incremental potential energy of elastoplasticity formulated by Simo, without requiring any labeled solution data. It operates directly on unstructured point clouds by encoding spatial coordinates, loading histories, and material properties as unified point-wise prompts. This formulation provides dual invariance to spatial and loading-path discretizations, enabling consistent predictions across different spatial resolutions and different numbers of increments representing the same loading trajectory. The pretrained Plasolver achieves relative errors on the order of 1\% while providing approximately two orders of magnitude acceleration over conventional finite element simulations. In the warm-start stage, the pretrained prediction is supplied as the initial solution to a classical iterative solver, preserving its numerical accuracy, robustness, and convergence properties while substantially accelerating convergence. Numerical results show that Plasolver reduces the required number of iterations by approximately 50\% compared with conventional zero-initialized solvers and converges to solutions at any prescribed tolerance. Plasolver thus provides an efficient, accurate, and discretization-invariant computational framework for nonlinear, path-dependent elastoplastic problems.

AI.tldr: Plasolver是一个物理信息神经算子框架，用于弹塑性分析。它结合了算子学习的效率和经典数值求解器的精度，通过物理信息预训练（最小化增量势能）和可选的热启动阶段，实现无需标注数据的训练，在空间和加载路径离散化上具有双重不变性，相对误差约1%，较传统有限元加速约两个数量级，热启动可将迭代次数减少约50%。
AI.motivation: 弹塑性分析计算代价高昂，因为其非线性和路径依赖的本构行为需要增量加载和反复迭代求解。现有方法在效率和精度之间存在权衡，亟需一种既能保持经典求解器精度鲁棒性又能大幅加速的框架。
AI.method: Plasolver包含两个阶段：(1) 物理信息预训练阶段：神经算子仅通过最小化Simo提出的弹塑性增量势能进行训练，无需任何标注解数据；直接在非结构点云上操作，将空间坐标、加载历史和材料属性编码为统一的逐点提示，从而实现对空间离散化和加载路径离散化的双重不变性。(2) 热启动阶段：将预训练预测作为经典迭代求解器的初始解，保持数值精度、鲁棒性和收敛性质，同时加速收敛。
AI.result: 预训练的Plasolver相对误差约为1%，相比传统有限元模拟加速约两个数量级；热启动阶段相比零初始化的传统求解器可减少约50%的迭代次数，并能以任意指定容差收敛到解。
AI.conclusion: Plasolver为非线性、路径依赖的弹塑性问题提供了一种高效、精确且离散化不变的统一计算框架，兼顾了算子学习的效率与经典数值求解器的可靠性。

title: Anharmonicity and Nonadiabaticity in Hydride Superconductors
summary: We study superconductivity in representative hydrides using anharmonic phonons, electron-phonon vertex corrections, and full-bandwidth Eliashberg theory. The high-pressure binary hydrides H3S, YH6, and YH9 must be treated with both anharmonic and nonadiabatic corrections, whereas the ambient-pressure PdH/PdD/PdT series is strongly anharmonic but remains adiabatic, reproducing the inverse isotope effect without sizable vertex contributions. LaBeH8 exhibits weak anharmonicity, while vertex corrections reduce the critical temperature (Tc) by approximately 4 K, leaving the predicted Tc above experiment. To identify when treatments beyond harmonic, adiabatic Migdal-Eliashberg theory are required, we introduce the anharmonic renormalization $A_λ$ and the vertex ratio $R_{V}$ as material-specific diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多种代表性氢化物超导体，发现不同材料需要不同程度的修正：高压二元氢化物（H3S、YH6、YH9）需同时考虑非谐声子和非绝热顶点修正，而常压PdH/PdD/PdT系列虽具有强非谐性但保持绝热性。文章引入了两个材料特异性诊断参数（非谐重整化Aλ和顶点比RV）来判断何时需要超越谐波绝热Migdal-Eliashberg理论。
AI.motivation: 传统的谐波绝热Migdal-Eliashberg理论在预测氢化物超导临界温度时存在系统偏差，需要确定何时必须引入非谐声子修正和非绝热顶点修正等超越标准理论的效应。
AI.method: 采用非谐声子、电子-声子顶点修正和全带宽Eliashberg理论，对多种氢化物（H3S、YH6、YH9、PdH/PdD/PdT、LaBeH8）进行计算，并引入非谐重整化参数Aλ和顶点比RV作为材料特异性的诊断指标。
AI.result: 高压二元氢化物（H3S、YH6、YH9）需要同时考虑非谐和非绝热修正；PdH/PdD/PdT系列强非谐但绝热，正确重现逆同位素效应且无需显著顶点修正；LaBeH8非谐性较弱，但顶点修正使Tc降低约4K，仍高于实验值。
AI.conclusion: 提出了Aλ和RV两个诊断参数来判定是否需要超越谐波绝热Migdal-Eliashberg理论，为不同氢化物超导体的理论处理方法选择提供了实用准则。

title: Low temperature magnetic structure and lattice response in SmCuAs$_2$
summary: We investigated the structural and magnetic properties of single-crystalline SmCuAs$_2$ using high-resolution synchrotron X-ray diffraction and X-ray resonant magnetic scattering (XRMS) at the Sm $L_2$ and $L_3$ edges. Temperature-dependent diffraction measurements confirm that SmCuAs$_2$ maintains its tetragonal symmetry from room temperature down to 8 K, with lattice parameters showing anomalous behavior below the resistivity minimum ($T \approx$ 30 K). Notably, the \textbf{c}-axis lattice parameter exhibits a plateau and subsequent increase near the Néel temperature, indicating magnetoelastic coupling. XRMS measurements reveal a commensurate antiferromagnetic structure with a propagation vector \textbf{\textit{q}} = (0, 0, 0.5). Our measurement shows that the Sm moments are aligned within the \textbf{\textit{ab}} plane and arranged in a $++--$ stacking along the \textbf{\textit{c}}-axis. Comparison with related \textit{RE}CuAs$_2$ compounds (\textit{RE} = Pr, Nd, and Gd) suggests that in-plane moment orientation and associated magnetic frustration play a key role in the emergence of the resistivity minimum. Differences in spin-orbit and magnetoelastic coupling across the series highlight their importance in governing low-temperature transport behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高分辨率同步辐射X射线衍射和X射线共振磁性散射（XRMS）研究了SmCuAs₂单晶的结构与磁性。研究发现该材料在8 K至室温保持四方对称性，在电阻率最小值附近（约30 K）出现晶格参数的异常行为，c轴在Néel温度附近呈现平台及随后增大，表明存在磁弹性耦合。XRMS揭示了传播矢量为q=(0,0,0.5)的共线反铁磁结构，Sm磁矩位于ab面内，沿c轴呈++--堆叠。与Pr、Nd、Gd同族化合物比较显示，面内磁矩取向及相关磁阻挫在电阻率最小值的出现中起关键作用。
AI.motivation: 理解SmCuAs₂中电阻率最小值的微观起源，特别是磁结构与晶格、磁弹性耦合及自旋-轨道耦合如何协同影响低温输运行为，并通过与同族RECuAs₂化合物的系统比较来阐明其机制。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率同步辐射X射线衍射进行变温结构表征，并在Sm L₂和L₃边进行X射线共振磁性散射（XRMS）测量，以确定磁结构的传播矢量、磁矩取向及堆叠方式。
AI.result: SmCuAs₂在8-300 K保持四方结构；晶格参数在约30 K以下出现异常，c轴在Néel温度附近出现平台后增大；磁结构为q=(0,0,0.5)的共线反铁磁，Sm磁矩在ab面内，沿c轴呈++--堆叠。
AI.conclusion: 面内磁矩取向产生的磁阻挫以及系列化合物中自旋-轨道和磁弹性耦合的差异，共同决定了RECuAs₂体系的低温输运行为，为理解电阻率最小值的产生机制提供了微观磁结构依据。

title: Interaction driven charge transfer transitions in closely spaced graphene double layers
summary: Charge transfer between two conductors is conventionally viewed as a single-particle process governed by electrostatics and band alignment. Using tunneling spectroscopy, we show that charge transfer in closely spaced graphene double layer quantum Hall ferromagnets instead proceeds through a sequence of interaction driven phase transitions governed by the competition between capacitive charging and Coulomb exchange interactions. A comparison of experimental data and theoretical calculations identifies spectroscopic signatures of the interaction driven charge transfer transitions, and reveals that this charge transfer reconstructs the quasiparticle spectrum. While intralayer exchange favors abrupt transfer of entire spin-valley subbands between the layers, interlayer exchange stabilizes coherent intermediate phases that enable gradual charge transfer. Our results establish interlayer tunneling as a powerful probe of interacting electronic systems whose quasiparticle spectrum is itself bias dependent.

AI.tldr: 本文通过隧穿谱学研究了紧密排列的石墨烯双层量子霍尔铁磁体中的电荷转移机制，发现这一过程并非传统的单粒子过程，而是由电容充电与库仑交换相互作用竞争所驱动的系列相互作用驱动相变序列。实验数据与理论计算对比揭示了相互作用驱动电荷转移跃迁的谱学特征，并表明电荷转移会重构准粒子谱。层内交换有利于自旋-谷子带在层间的整体转移，而层间交换则稳定了相干中间相，实现渐进式电荷转移。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为导体间电荷转移是由静电学和能带对齐支配的单粒子过程，但该研究希望揭示在紧密排列的石墨烯双层量子霍尔铁磁体中，电荷转移实际上是由相互作用驱动的复杂多体现象，需要通过隧穿谱学来深入理解其内在机制。
AI.method: 采用隧穿谱学（tunneling spectroscopy）技术研究紧密排列的石墨烯双层量子霍尔铁磁体中的电荷转移行为，并将实验结果与理论计算进行系统对比分析，以识别相互作用驱动的电荷转移跃迁的谱学特征。
AI.result: 研究发现电荷转移通过一系列相互作用驱动的相变进行，是电容充电与库仑交换相互作用的竞争结果。层内交换倾向于导致整个自旋-谷子带在层间的突变转移，而层间交换则稳定相干中间相，促成渐进电荷转移。电荷转移过程会重构准粒子谱。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了层间隧穿作为探测相互作用电子系统的有力工具，特别是在准粒子谱本身依赖于偏压的系统中具有重要意义，为理解强关联电子系统中的电荷转移机制提供了新的视角。

title: Nonequilibrium Maxwell-Demon NEMD simulations of transport: I. Extrapolating shear viscosity to the hydrodynamic limit
summary: We present a Maxwell-Demon nonequilibrium molecular dynamics method for measuring the shear viscosity of a Lennard-Jones fluid. The simulation cell is divided into two regions of width $w$ in the $x$-direction, with particles free to move between the two sides. The Demon maintains equal and opposite regional average particle velocities in the $y$-direction ($\pm u_p$), by applying an acceleration $g_{total}$ that includes both total force balance and a correction for diffusion of particles across boundaries. The momentum relaxation rate needed to sustain the nonequilibrium steady state (NESS) is $γ=g_{total}/u_p$. We show that the driven velocity profile is not imposed point-wise in $x$ by the constraint, but is selected by the regional hydrodynamic response of the fluid. For this shear geometry, the measured NESS profile in Eulerian slabs is well represented by a piecewise parabolic form, reminiscent of planar Poiseuille flow. The parabolic profile estimates the kinematic viscosity from work done on the shearing fluid, $ν_{para}=γ_{total}w^2/12$, as well as an entropy production estimate, derived from heat removal by the Nosé--Hoover thermostat that keeps each regional average temperature constant. For a representative run, the work and entropy routes agree to within $0.6\%$, confirming consistency between the mechanical work supplied by the Demon and the heat removed by the thermostat. Once NESS driving is removed, the parabolic velocity profile relaxes exponentially rapidly to sinusoidal, the natural transverse momentum-diffusion eigenmode. These results establish the Maxwell-Demon shear method as a direct NEMD route for obtaining shear viscosity from momentum diffusion, work, and entropy balances. Our results in 3D for increasing system size $N$ (the number of particles) demonstrate that shear viscosity approaches an asymptote (the hydrodynamic limit) as $1/\sqrt{N}$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种麦克斯韦妖非平衡分子动力学（Maxwell-Demon NEMD）方法，用于测量Lennard-Jones流体的剪切粘度。
AI.motivation: 传统的剪切粘度测量方法在非平衡分子动力学模拟中存在局限，需要一种更直接、更可靠的途径来从动量扩散、做功和熵平衡等方面获取剪切粘度。
AI.method: 将模拟单元沿x方向分为两个等宽区域，通过麦克斯韦妖施加等大反向的区域平均y方向速度（±u_p），应用包含力平衡和粒子跨边界扩散修正的加速度g_total，从而维持非平衡稳态（NESS）。通过测量维持稳态所需的动量弛豫率γ=g_total/u_p来表征流体的剪切响应。
AI.result: 驱动速度剖面并非逐点强制施加，而是由流体区域流体动力学响应自发选择，呈分段抛物线形式（类似于Poiseuille流）。功法和熵产生法两种路径估计的运动学粘度在0.6%内一致。撤除驱动后，抛物线剖面指数级弛豫回正弦本征模式。三维模拟中，剪切粘度随系统尺寸N增大按1/√N收敛到流体动力学极限。
AI.conclusion: 麦克斯韦妖剪切方法是一种直接的NEMD途径，能够从动量扩散、做功和熵平衡三种角度一致地获得剪切粘度，并确认了其收敛于流体动力学极限。

title: Separation of Flexible Enantiomers Using Shear Flow
summary: Mechanical separation of enantiomers is an attractive alternative to synthetic methods for producing enantiopure samples. Shear flow that produces solution vorticity has been shown to be a viable means for separating chiral objects on the micro- to nano-scale due to the tensorial nature of the interactions between chiral objects and the surrounding fluid. A recently-developed theory of molecular pitch characterizes these interactions using the resistance tensor and predicts the shear-induced separation of drug-like molecules from their optimized molecular geometries. We present a molecular dynamics study on the effects of incorporating molecular flexibility into the molecular pitch framework. We also evaluate the potential for enantiomeric separation of two drug molecules: bicalutamide (Casodex) and montelukast sodium (Singulair). Simulations reveal the emergence of flexibility-induced pitch distributions that result from conformational changes occurring in a realistic solvent environment. However, these distributions are weakly influenced by the solvent identity and the shearing process, producing mean scalar pitch values that are close to those from optimized gas phase structures. Despite the opposing effect of translational diffusion at the molecular scale, racemic mixtures of flexible enantiomers show linear rates of separation at the 10 ns timescale, and we predict that cm-scale separation can be achieved within hours. Additionally, we provide estimates for parameters of a Taylor-Couette device for generating laminar shear flow, as well as considerations for future experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子动力学模拟，研究了分子柔性对"分子螺距"（molecular pitch）框架的影响，该框架用于预测剪切流中手性分子的对映体分离。研究针对两种药物分子（比卡鲁胺和孟鲁司特钠），发现柔性导致的螺距分布受溶剂和剪切过程影响较弱，平均标量螺距接近气相优化结构值。尽管平移扩散有不利影响，柔性对映体混合物在10 ns时间尺度上表现出线性分离速率，预测厘米级分离可在数小时内实现，并给出了Taylor-Couette装置的参数估计。
AI.motivation: 机械分离对映体是替代合成方法制备对映纯样品的有效途径，剪切流已被证明可在微纳尺度分离手性物体。最近发展的分子螺距理论利用阻力张量表征手性物体与流体的相互作用，但该理论基于优化分子几何构型（刚性假设），未考虑分子在真实溶剂环境中的柔性构象变化，因此需要评估分子柔性对分离效果的影响。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学（MD）模拟方法，将分子柔性引入分子螺距框架，研究两种药物分子（比卡鲁胺和孟鲁司特钠）在不同溶剂环境中的构象变化及其产生的螺距分布，评估剪切流对分离效率的影响，并结合平移扩散效应分析对映体混合物的分离动力学。
AI.result: 模拟揭示了柔性诱导的螺距分布源于真实溶剂环境中的构象变化，但这些分布受溶剂身份和剪切过程影响较弱，平均标量螺距接近气相优化结构值。尽管分子尺度的平移扩散有对抗作用，柔性对映体混合物在10 ns时间尺度上仍表现出线性分离速率，预测厘米级分离可在数小时内完成，并提供了Taylor-Couette装置的关键参数估计。
AI.conclusion: 分子柔性虽然引入了螺距分布的多样性，但平均分离行为与刚体理论预测一致，表明基于优化几何的分子螺距理论仍可作为剪切诱导对映体分离的有效预测工具。研究为实验设计（如Taylor-Couette装置）提供了可行参数，推动了机械分离对映体从理论走向实际应用。

title: Discovering Physically Interpretable Mathematical Expression for Predicting CO2 Adsorption in Metal-Organic Frameworks via Machine Learning-Symbolic Regression
summary: This work presents a machine learning-symbolic regression (ML-SR) strategy to develop a physically interpretable formula for predicting low pressure CO2 adsorption capacity in hypothetical metal-organic frameworks (hMOFs). Four ML models were trained on a small dataset of 1,000 samples, and five key descriptors-largest cavity diameter, pore limiting diameter, void fraction, gravimetric surface area, and number of hydrogen atoms-were identified through SHAP and feature importance analyses. Symbolic regression was then employed to derive a concise adsorption formula, Q=aA, where a represents an adsorption baseline (mmol/g) and A is a dimensionless adsorption number incorporating four structural descriptors. We interpret A as the ratio between an adsorption binding force and a diffusion driving force, revealing how pore topology and surface chemistry jointly influence adsorption. Validation against a comprehensive dataset of 137,652 hMOFs demonstrates that this formula achieves over 70% prediction accuracy for 62,448 structures, confirming strong applicability within defined structural and operational ranges. Unlike conventional black box ML models, the proposed physics-guided expression enables efficient prediction and provides clearer insight into adsorption mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种机器学习-符号回归(ML-SR)混合策略，从1000个样本的小数据集出发，利用SHAP和特征重要性分析识别出五个关键描述符，并通过符号回归推导出一个简洁的物理可解释公式Q=aA，用于预测假设性金属有机框架(hMOFs)的低压CO2吸附容量。该公式在137,652个hMOFs的验证数据集中对62,448个结构实现了超过70%的预测准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统的黑盒机器学习模型虽然预测能力强，但缺乏物理可解释性，难以揭示CO2吸附背后的机理。作者希望开发一种既能高效预测又能提供物理洞察的公式化表达方式，以更好地理解MOFs结构与吸附性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用两阶段策略：(1)训练四种机器学习模型于1000个样本的小数据集，通过SHAP和特征重要性分析筛选出五个关键描述符（最大腔体直径、孔限直径、空隙率、重力比表面积、氢原子数）；(2)利用符号回归推导出简洁吸附公式Q=aA，其中a为吸附基线值，A为无量纲吸附数，包含四个结构描述符。A被解释为吸附结合力与扩散驱动力之比。
AI.result: 在137,652个hMOFs的综合数据集验证中，该公式对62,448个结构实现了超过70%的预测准确率，证明了其在明确的结构和操作范围内的适用性。相比黑盒ML模型，该公式在保持预测效率的同时提供了更清晰的吸附机理洞察。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的物理引导公式Q=aA在预测准确性和物理可解释性之间取得了良好平衡，不仅能高效预测hMOFs的CO2吸附容量，还通过将吸附数A解释为吸附结合力与扩散驱动力之比，揭示了孔拓扑和表面化学对吸附性能的联合影响机制。

title: Conforming and nonconforming Trefftz approximations for two-dimensional scalar electromagnetic problems
summary:
Trefftz functions satisfy the differential equation locally and exactly; quasi-Trefftz functions do so approximately to prescribed high order. This paper considers (quasi-)Trefftz approximations for two-dimensional scalar electromagnetic problems. Established discretizations include the Flexible Local Approximation MEthod (FLAME), Trefftz elements ($T$-elements), and Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin (Trefftz-DG) methods. New developments are gradient-enriched FLAME (GEFLAME), conforming Trefftz--FLAME finite elements (TFF), and a full-field Bloch-wavevector-vs-frequency solution with Schur--DtN reduction. Applications cover electrostatics, scattering, singular fields, and Bloch waves in periodic structures.
  These methods make different compromises between conformity and flexibility. FLAME and GEFLAME incorporate Trefftz functions directly into local difference schemes; TFF uses elementwise FLAME schemes to lift polynomial traces into element interiors; $T$-elements match elementwise Trefftz spaces weakly to such traces; and Trefftz-DG couples broken Trefftz spaces through fluxes and penalties.
  In the reported wave-scattering examples, GEFLAME gives field and gradient errors several orders of magnitude below those of the quadratic finite-element discretization at comparable algebraic cost. Localized singular-function enrichment removes the dominant reentrant-corner error. Conforming TFF and quasi-conforming $T$-elements admit standard finite-element assembly but expose polynomial edge traces as an accuracy bottleneck. For periodic media, the bilinear Trefftz-DG formulation gives an analytic polynomial wavenumber-vs-frequency eigenproblem without restricting the Bloch multiplier to the unit circle. Schur--DtN reduction yields compact boundary-response problems.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了二维标量电磁问题中的（拟）Trefftz近似方法，涵盖FLAME、GEFLAME、Trefftz元、Trefftz-DG等方法的对比，并应用于静电、散射、奇异场和周期结构Bloch波等问题。
AI.motivation: Trefftz函数在局部精确满足微分方程，但不同离散化方法在保形性与灵活性之间存在权衡，需要一个统一框架来比较和评估这些方法的性能，特别是在波散射、奇异场和周期介质等具有挑战性的电磁问题中。
AI.method: 论文提出了若干新方法：梯度增强型FLAME（GEFLAME）、保形Trefftz-FLAME有限元（TFF）、以及带Schur-DtN约减的全场Bloch波矢-频率解。这些方法通过不同方式将Trefftz函数融入离散格式，从局部差分格式到弱匹配的元级Trefftz空间，再到通量和惩罚项耦合的间断Galerkin格式。
AI.result: 在波散射例子中，GEFLAME的场和梯度误差比二次有限元离散低几个数量级，且代数计算成本相当。奇异性函数增强消除了主导的凹角误差。TFF和拟保形T元素可进行标准有限元组装，但多项式边迹成为精度瓶颈。双线性Trefftz-DG格式产生了解析多项式波数-频率特征问题。
AI.conclusion: Trefftz类方法在电磁问题中展现了优越的精度-成本平衡，GEFLAME尤其适用于波散射问题；Schur-DtN约减为周期结构提供了紧凑的边界响应问题，Trefftz-DG则不需将Bloch乘子限制在单位圆上。

title: Josephson network as a~model for high-temperature superconductor and beyond: Macroscopic quantum coherence probed by microwave absorption
comment: RevTeX, 10 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to the special issue of Acta Phys. Pol. A, in commemoration of the 40th anniversary of the discovery of high-temperature superconductivity
summary: Since the seminal experiment by Stankowski et al. [Phys. Rev. B 36, 7126 (1987)] on YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-x}$, Magnetically-Modulated Microwave Absorption (MMMA) has become an important technique for detecting the superconducting transition in inhomogeneous ceramic compounds. The rise of microwave absorption below $T_c$ is accompanied by several low-field anomalies, usually attributed to the weak links between superconducting grains showing the Josephson effect, or to the dynamics of Abrikosov-Josephson vortices. In this article, we briefly review selected theoretical models rationalizing MMMA spectra for high-temperature superconductors, focusing on the $3$-dimensional array of Josephson junctions with random parameters including the resistivity, capacity and inductance of each junction, showing characteristic absorption anomalies observed in the experiment. The implications for recently studied microwave absorption in Josephson junction qubits are also discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文简要回顾了磁调制微波吸收（MMMA）技术在高温超导体中的应用，重点介绍了具有随机参数（电阻、电容、电感）的三维约瑟夫森结阵列模型如何合理化实验中观察到的特征吸收异常，并讨论了该工作对约瑟夫森结量子比特中微波吸收研究的启示。
AI.motivation: 自Stankowski等人1987年的先驱实验以来，MMMA已成为检测非均匀陶瓷化合物中超导转变的重要技术。然而，T_c以下微波吸收的增强伴随多种低场异常现象，其理论解释尚需系统梳理，特别是关于弱连接约瑟夫森效应和Abrikosov-Josephson涡旋动力学的作用机制。
AI.method: 本文是一篇综述性文章，简要回顾了合理化高温超导体MMMA谱的选定理论模型，核心聚焦于具有随机参数（包括每个结的电阻、电容和电感）的三维约瑟夫森结阵列模型，用以解释实验中观察到的特征吸收异常现象。
AI.result: 该综述呈现了三维随机参数约瑟夫森结阵列模型能够重现实验中观察到的特征吸收异常，为理解MMMA谱提供了理论框架，并将这些见解延伸至约瑟夫森结量子比特中微波吸收现象的分析。
AI.conclusion: MMMA作为检测超导转变的有力技术，其理论理解通过三维随机约瑟夫森结阵列模型得到深化；该模型对解释实验异常具有重要意义，同时对超导量子比特中微波吸收研究具有潜在启示。

title: Quantum Many-Body Scars, Magnon-Pair Condensation, and Hilbert Space Fragmentation in an Anisotropic Heisenberg Model
summary: We investigate a spin-$1/2$ anisotropic Heisenberg model on a lattice consisting of two identical bipartite sublattices. A family of exact eigenstates generated by the restricted spectrum generating algebra (RSGA) constitutes quantum many-body scar states, characterized by subextensive entanglement entropy and supporting. These scar states are magnon-pair condensates exhibiting off-diagonal long-range order (ODLRO). At the resonance point of the inter-sublattice interaction, the model exactly maps onto a mixed spin-$1$ and spin-$0$ XY model on a bipartite lattice, which decomposes into independent sub-Hamiltonians labeled by all possible spin configurations. Each spin-$0$ particle is dynamically isolated from its neighbors and acts as a kinetic constraint, giving rise to emergent Hilbert space fragmentation (HSF). Our work establishes an exactly solvable platform in which quantum many-body scars, magnon-pair condensation exhibiting off-diagonal long-range order, and Hilbert space fragmentation naturally coexist.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个由两个相同二分子格组成的自旋-1/2各向异性海森堡模型。通过受限谱生成代数(RSGA)构造了一系列精确本征态作为量子多体疤痕态，这些疤痕态是磁子对凝聚体，具有亚广延纠缠熵并表现出离对角长程序(ODLRO)。在子格间相互作用的共振点，模型精确映射为二分子格上的混合自旋-1和自旋-0 XY模型，可分解为由所有自旋构型标记的独立子哈密顿量。每个自旋-0粒子被动力学隔离，作为动力学约束，产生涌现的希尔伯特空间碎裂(HSF)。该工作建立了一个精确可解平台，使量子多体疤痕、磁子对凝聚(ODLRO)和希尔伯特空间碎裂自然共存。
AI.motivation: 旨在寻找一个精确可解的模型平台，使量子多体疤痕态、磁子对凝聚（离对角长程序）和希尔伯特空间碎裂这三种看似独立的现象能够自然共存，从而深入理解这些非平衡和量子关联现象的相互关系。
AI.method: 采用受限谱生成代数(RSGA)构造精确本征态作为量子多体疤痕态；利用熵和关联函数分析疤痕态性质；在共振点处通过精确映射将模型转化为混合自旋-1和自旋-0的XY模型，并利用自旋构型标记将哈密顿量分解为独立子哈密顿量以揭示希尔伯特空间碎裂。
AI.result: 得到一族具有亚广延纠缠熵的量子多体疤痕态，这些疤痕态表现为具有离对角长程序(ODLRO)的磁子对凝聚体；在共振点，模型精确映射为可分解的XY模型，自旋-0粒子作为动力学隔离的约束导致希尔伯特空间碎裂。
AI.conclusion: 建立了量子多体疤痕、磁子对凝聚（ODLRO）和希尔伯特空间碎裂自然共存的精确可解平台，为理解这些量子现象之间的深层联系提供了新的理论框架。

title: Symmetry-Tunable Skyrmions and Merons in Magnetic Nanodisks via Spatially Engineered Anisotropy
summary: We demonstrate that spatially engineered magnetic anisotropy can stabilize skyrmion and meron spin textures in magnetic nanodisks even in the absence of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI). Using a constrained analytical model and micromagnetic simulations, we show that competing perpendicular and in-plane anisotropies can generate non-collinear topological textures in non-chiral magnetic systems. We further show that DMI and dipolar interactions lift the helicity degeneracy and select preferred chiral configurations; micromagnetic simulations were used to identify physically stable states. These results establish anisotropy-patterned nanodisks as a platform for studying DMI-free topological spin textures and their controllable magnetic response. We also show that arrays of anisotropy-engineered skyrmions can control spin-wave transmission by manipulating their vorticity arrangement, pointing to reconfigurable magnonic elements based on non-chiral topological textures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过空间工程化的磁各向异性，在无需Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用（DMI）的磁性纳米盘中稳定了斯格明子和meron自旋纹理，并展示了其可重构的磁振子（自旋波）传输控制能力。
AI.motivation: 传统上，拓扑自旋纹理（如斯格明子）的稳定通常依赖DMI或偶极相互作用等手性机制。本文旨在探索一种无需DMI即可稳定非共线拓扑自旋纹理的替代途径，从而拓展拓扑磁性材料的选择范围，并为可重构磁振子器件提供新平台。
AI.method: 采用约束解析模型与微磁模拟相结合的方法：通过在纳米盘中空间工程化垂直各向异性与面内各向异性的竞争，生成非共线拓扑纹理；随后引入DMI和偶极相互作用以消除螺旋度简并并筛选物理稳定的手性构型；最后通过微磁模拟研究各向异性工程化斯格明子阵列对自旋波传输的调控。
AI.result: 证明了在无DMI的非手性磁性体系中，通过各向异性图案化能够稳定斯格明子和meron拓扑自旋纹理；DMI与偶极相互作用可提升特定手性构型的稳定性；各向异性工程化的斯格明子阵列可通过操控涡度排列来控制自旋波传输。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了各向异性图案化纳米盘作为无需DMI的拓扑自旋纹理研究平台，并为基于非手性拓扑纹理的可重构磁振子器件指出了新方向。

title: Information, order, complexity, and entropy in materials including biological systems: a thermodynamic theory based on state variables
summary: Entropy plays a central role in thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, information theory, and biology. However, its interpretation becomes increasingly ambiguous when information-theoretic concepts are applied to materials, including biological systems. For example, in biology, it is common practice to evaluate the entropy of DNA by enumerating possible configurations. This configuration entropy does not vanish at $T=0$, apparently contradicting the third law. Similar conceptual difficulties also arise in relating entropy to order, randomness, complexity, and information. In thermodynamics, entropy is a state function, and hence the entropy must be uniquely determined by a given state of a material. The crucial issue is therefore to identify the state variables that uniquely specify the thermodynamic state of a material. By establishing consistent definition of equilibrium and state variable, it is found that the time-averaged atom positions serve as the state variables of a solid. This leads to the important conclusion that a solid possesses many equilibrium states even at fixed temperature and volume. Entropy is not information but uncertainty associated with the state variables. The latter quantities convey the information of a material. This framework provides a unified thermodynamic basis of entropy, information, order, complexity, hysteresis, and residual entropy while preserving the third law. Frozen configurations and their activation resolve many longstanding ambiguities the thermodynamic evaluation of entropy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以时间平均原子位置作为固体热力学状态变量，建立熵与信息、有序、复杂性、滞回和残余熵的统一热力学框架，同时保持热力学第三定律的有效性。
AI.motivation: 熵在热力学、统计力学、信息论和生物学中具有核心地位，但将信息论概念应用于材料（包括生物系统）时，其解释变得模糊不清。例如，DNA的构型熵在T=0时不消失，与第三定律矛盾；熵与有序、随机性、复杂性及信息之间的关系也存在类似的概念困难。
AI.method: 通过建立一致的平衡态和状态变量定义，论证时间平均原子位置可作为固体的状态变量。基于此框架，将熵重新定义为与状态变量相关的不确定性（而非信息本身），并引入冻结构型及其激活机制来解释熵的评估。
AI.result: 发现固体在固定温度和体积下仍可拥有多个平衡态。该框架为熵、信息、有序性、复杂性、滞回现象和残余熵提供了统一的热力学基础，同时保留了第三定律。
AI.conclusion: 熵不是信息，而是与状态变量相关的不确定性；状态变量本身才承载材料的信息。冻结构型及其激活过程解决了热力学熵评估中长期存在的诸多歧义。

title: Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent-Field for the Entropic Regularization of Mean-Field Singularities
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures. Includes Supplementary Information. Submitted to The Journal of Chemical Physics. Data underlying this study are available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21940452
summary: We present a Quantum Boltzmann Equation self-consistent-field (QBE-SCF) formulation for molecular electronic structure in which the one-electron reduced density matrix is propagated in a fixed Gaussian orbital basis and relaxed by a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook collision operator toward a Fermi-Dirac equilibrium defined by the instantaneous Fock matrix. At stationarity, the converged density and Fock matrices satisfy $[\mathbf{F},\mathbf{P}]=0$, the Hartree-Fock condition. While the zero-temperature equilibrium target reduces to the integer Aufbau projector, the damped collision operator ensures the steady-state density matrix is not necessarily idempotent. This kinetic property affords a dual capacity to resolve mean-field singularities. For spatial degeneracies, such as H$_3$ symmetric dissociation, zero-temperature kinetic ergodicity fractionalizes the active space to recover the GVB limit. For the conical intersection in BeH$_2$ and the H$_4$ structural distortion ($D_{2h} \rightarrow D_{4h} \rightarrow D_{2h}$), finite-temperature entropic regularization recovers correlated adiabatic surfaces from a real-valued single-reference density. By maintaining stable numerical convergence across basis-set hierarchies and resolving static correlation without multi-reference wavefunctions, these results establish kinetic relaxation as a synthesis of single-reference electronic structure and quantum statistical mechanics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量子玻尔兹曼方程自洽场（QBE-SCF）方法，在固定高斯轨道基组中传播单电子约化密度矩阵，并通过Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook碰撞算符将其松弛到由瞬时Fock矩阵定义的费米-狄拉克平衡态。
AI.motivation: 传统Hartree-Fock方法在处理静态关联（如分子对称解离、锥形交叉等）时存在局限性，需要多参考波函数方法。作者希望从量子统计力学的视角，通过动力学松弛机制来解决单参考方法无法处理的强关联问题。
AI.method: 将单电子密度矩阵在固定基组中演化，采用QBE框架，以BGK碰撞算符驱动密度矩阵向由瞬时Fock矩阵定义的Fermi-Dirac平衡松弛。低温极限退化为整数Aufbau投影子，但阻尼碰撞算符使稳态密度矩阵不必是幂等的，从而具备解决平均场奇异性的能力。
AI.result: 在H₃对称解离中，零温动力学遍历性实现了活性空间的分化以恢复GVB极限；在BeH₂锥形交叉和H₄结构畸变中，有限温熵正则化从实值单参考密度恢复了关联绝热面。方法在不同基组层级间保持稳定数值收敛。
AI.conclusion: 动力学松弛机制将单参考电子结构理论与量子统计力学统一，无需多参考波函数即可解析静态关联，为电子结构计算提供了新的范式。

title: Network Topology of Hafnia-Based Amorphous Optical Coatings by Grazing-Incidence X-ray Total Scattering and Atomic Modeling
summary: Amorphous hafnia-based films are promising optical-coating materials for cryogenic GW detectors, but their performance depends on how doping and annealing modify the atomic network. We combine grazing-incidence X-ray total scattering measurements with experimentally constrained atomic modeling to study the as-deposited HfO$_2$ and 27% SiO$_2$-doped HfO$_2$ films annealed at 150$^\circ$C and 400$^\circ$C. Pure amorphous HfO$_2$ is a dense, high-coordination network of Hf-centered polyhedra with substantial edge- and face-sharing connectivity. Incorporating SiO$_2$ introduces stable SiO$_4$ tetrahedra, lowers the Hf and O coordination, and replaces highly connected Hf-rich oxygen environments with mixed Si--O--Hf bridges. This produces a chemically mixed network rather than isolated SiO$_2$-rich regions, and shifts the cation topology toward corner-sharing connectivity. Annealing to 400$^\circ$C produces only modest additional structural relaxation. These results provide an atomic-scale description of how SiO$_2$ modifies the topology of amorphous HfO$_2$-based coatings and suggest structural descriptors relevant to understanding their mechanical-loss behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过掠入射X射线全散射测量与原子建模结合，研究了纯HfO₂和27% SiO₂掺杂HfO₂薄膜在150°C和400°C退火后的原子网络结构，揭示了SiO₂掺杂如何改变氧化铪基非晶涂层的拓扑结构。
AI.motivation: 非晶氧化铪基薄膜是低温引力波探测器的重要光学涂层材料，但其性能取决于掺杂和退火如何改变原子网络结构。理解这些微观结构变化对于优化涂层性能至关重要。
AI.method: 结合掠入射X射线全散射测量和实验约束的原子建模方法，研究纯HfO₂和27% SiO₂掺杂HfO₂薄膜在150°C和400°C退火后的结构。
AI.result: 纯非晶HfO₂是致密的高配位网络，由Hf中心多面体组成，具有大量边共享和面共享连接。掺入SiO₂后引入稳定的SiO₄四面体，降低Hf和O的配位数，用混合Si-O-Hf桥替代高连接的富Hf氧环境，形成化学混合网络而非孤立SiO₂富集区域，并将阳离子拓扑转向角共享连接。400°C退火仅产生适度的额外结构弛豫。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了SiO₂如何修饰非晶HfO₂基涂层拓扑结构的原子尺度描述，并提出与理解涂层机械损耗行为相关的结构描述符。

title: Scalable dynamical inference of phase-field fracture from sparse and partial measurements
summary: Evolving crack fields in structural health monitoring and fracture assessment must often be inferred from sparse mechanical measurements rather than dense full-field observations. We develop CNN2D--ConvGRU, a convolutional-recurrent framework for measurement-conditioned reconstruction of time-dependent phase-field brittle fracture. At each load step, the model maps a fixed-length history of phase and displacement fields and sparse current-step displacement measurements to the current full-field state. New measurements are assimilated during sequential deployment, making the framework a state-inference surrogate rather than an autonomous time integrator. It reproduces crack paths, damage evolution, and bulk displacement response, with the largest errors near propagating crack tips and steep displacement gradients and some drift at late stages. Without retraining, weights learned on a $256 \times 256$ raster are evaluated on a $512 \times 512$ raster of the same physical domain and finite-element discretization using a proportionally refined measurement grid. This empirical raster-and-sensing transfer preserves the principal damage topology and global damage evolution, although fine-scale displacement errors increase near crack tips. Comparisons with alternative spatial and temporal architectures show that CNN2D--ConvGRU offers a favorable balance between reconstruction accuracy and computational cost. Relative to repeated finite-element solutions, sequential reconstruction achieves mean speedups of $175\times$ on CPU and $253\times$ on GPU. These results demonstrate efficient full-field fracture-state reconstruction from sparse observations while retaining the spatial structure and history dependence of phase-field fracture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CNN2D--ConvGRU，一种卷积-循环混合框架，用于基于稀疏测量数据在结构健康监测中重建时变相场脆性断裂的全场状态。该模型在每个载荷步将固定长度的相场、位移场历史及当前步稀疏位移测量映射到当前全场状态，作为状态推断代理而非自主时间积分器。在256×256栅格上训练的权重无需重训即可迁移到512×512栅格，实现了175倍(CPU)和253倍(GPU)的平均加速比。
AI.motivation: 结构健康监测和断裂评估中的演化裂纹场通常需要从稀疏力学测量而非密集全场观测中推断，直接计算相场断裂的有限元求解计算成本极高，需要一种高效且能保留时空结构的状态推断替代方法。
AI.method: 开发CNN2D--ConvGRU混合框架，结合二维卷积神经网络(提取空间特征)和卷积门控循环单元(ConvGRU,建模时间历史依赖)。模型输入为固定长度的相场和位移场历史，以及当前步的稀疏位移测量，输出为当前全场状态。测量数据在序列部署过程中逐步同化，实现状态推断而非自主时间推进。支持栅格和传感布局的迁移，无需重训练。
AI.result: 模型能准确再现裂纹路径、损伤演化和整体位移响应，最大误差出现在裂纹尖端附近和陡峭位移梯度区域，后期存在一定漂移。在512×512栅格上迁移测试保留主要损伤拓扑和全局损伤演化，但裂纹尖端附近的细尺度位移误差增大。对比替代时空架构，CNN2D--ConvGRU在重建精度与计算成本间取得良好平衡。相比重复有限元求解，实现CPU上175倍、GPU上253倍的平均加速。
AI.conclusion: CNN2D--ConvGRU展示了从稀疏观测高效重建全场断裂状态的可行性，同时保留了相场断裂的空间结构和时间依赖性，为实时结构健康监测提供了有前景的工具，尽管在裂纹尖端附近的精度和后期漂移方面仍需改进。

title: Superconducting Hydride Mg2RhH6 Experimentally Achieved at Lower Pressure
summary: Although tremendous progress has been made in recent years in the field of polyhydride superconductors, the realization of high critical temperature superconductivity still relies on formidable high pressures. Searching for superconducting hydrides at lower pressures is of particular importance. Here we report the first experimental synthesis of the Mg2RhH6, which achieves superconductivity under a significantly reduced pressure of 30 GPa. The synthesis of Mg2RhH6 proceeds via a two step process (1) preparation of the Mg2RhH5 precursor containing hydrogen atoms stabilized by covalent bonding, followed by (2) hydrogen supplementation resulting in the filling of electrons into anti bonding orbitals above 30 GPa, which was accompanied by the structural transition from RhH5 square pyramid to RhH6 octahedron. Superconductivity is achieved at 30 GPa with a Tc of 24 K, which is further enhanced to 29 K at 53 GPa, evidenced by a sharp drop of resistivity to zero and characteristic suppression of Tc under applied magnetic fields. Our experiments prove the Mg2RhH6 superconductor to be thermodynamically stable above 30 GPa, making it the first case exhibiting a Tc of approximately 30 K at a readily accessible pressure. This study pioneers a highly promising pathway for the rational design and discovery of high temperature superconductors within phonon mediated BCS framework.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实验合成了Mg2RhH6超导体，在显著降低的30 GPa压力下实现超导电性（Tc=24 K），并在53 GPa下提升至29 K。合成通过两步法进行：先制备含共价键氢的Mg2RhH5前驱体，再通过氢补充使电子填充至反键轨道，触发RhH5四方锥到RhH6八面体的结构转变。该材料在30 GPa以上热力学稳定，是首个在易达到压力下展现约30 K Tc的多氢化物超导体。
AI.motivation: 多氢化物超导体近年来取得巨大进展，但实现高临界温度超导仍依赖极高的压力，这严重限制了其实际应用。寻找在较低压力下即可实现超导的氢化物具有特别重要的意义。
AI.method: 采用两步合成法：(1)制备含共价键稳定氢原子的Mg2RhH5前驱体；(2)在30 GPa以上补氢，使电子填充到反键轨道，伴随RhH5四方锥向RhH6八面体的结构转变，从而实现超导。
AI.result: Mg2RhH6在30 GPa下实现超导，Tc为24 K，在53 GPa下提升至29 K。通过电阻降至零及磁场对Tc的抑制特征证实了超导电性。该材料在30 GPa以上热力学稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次实现在易达到的压力（约30 GPa）下获得Tc约30 K的氢化物超导体，为在声子介导BCS框架内合理设计和发现高温超导体开辟了高前景的新路径。

title: Zero-point theorems in quantum many-body physics
summary: We propose several zero-point type arguments based on the inevitable zero point(s) of a spectral gap in the quantum spin system phase diagrams in various dimensions. We consider multi-parameter families of Hamiltonian extending the conventional zero-point theorem that includes only one parameter. Analogously to the zero-point theorem, we only impose model-independent transformation relations along the parameter boundary, rather than specifying any low-energy dynamics or response. We further give a series of conjectures, which generalize our statements in a uniform way. Our results give powerful and universal model-independent constraints on the possible relevant operators for critical phenomena in quantum spin models in arbitrary high dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于量子自旋系统相图中谱隙必然存在的零点（零点定理）的多种零点型论证，将传统仅含单一参数的零点定理推广到多参数哈密顿量族，并给出了一系列统一化的猜想，为任意高维量子自旋模型中的临界现象提供了普适的模型无关约束。
AI.motivation: 传统零点定理仅适用于单参数哈密顿量族，限制了其在不同维度和多参数相图中的应用。作者希望将该定理推广到多参数情形，从而在更广泛的量子自旋模型中提供模型无关的约束条件，而不需要指定具体的低能动力学或响应函数。
AI.method: 作者提出多种零点半型论证，利用量子自旋系统相图中谱隙的不可避免零点。关键是仅沿参数边界施加模型无关的变换关系，而不依赖任何具体的低能动力学或响应。通过考虑多参数哈密顿量族来推广传统单参数零点定理，并基于此提出一系列统一化的猜想。
AI.result: 研究为任意高维量子自旋模型的临界现象提供了强大且普适的模型无关约束，特别是对可能的关联算符施加了限制。同时给出了一系列推广性猜想，以统一方式涵盖多种维度下的情形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，基于谱隙零点的零点型论证可以系统地推广到多参数和多维情形，为量子自旋系统的临界行为提供不依赖于具体微观模型的普适性约束，对理解量子相变和临界现象具有重要理论意义。

title: Temperature-Dependent Spin-Orbit Torque Generation in Perpendicularly Magnetized Topological Insulator-Magnetic Multilayer Heterostructures
summary: We report a comprehensive temperature-dependent investigation of spin-orbit torque (SOT) generation in heterostructures comprising a perpendicularly magnetized metallic multilayer grown on top of a topological insulator (TI) epilayer. Temperature-dependent second-harmonic Hall measurements reveal distinct trends in the magnitude of the spin-orbit torque across the studied heterostructures. Samples incorporating Bi2Se3 exhibit torques reaching approximately 12 mT/(10^12 A m^-2) at 15 K, around 5 times larger than those in a multilayer without the topological layer. The structure with a thin 2-nm Ta buffer for the multilayer shows the strongest enhancement and a pronounced increase at low temperatures, highlighting efficient spin-current generation from the topological surface states. In contrast, the sample with a 10 nm-thick Ta spacer exhibits reduced torque efficiency, consistent with partial attenuation of spin transmission through the buffer. Systems lacking Bi2Se3 but containing two heavy metals (Ta and Pt) yield significantly smaller torques, around 2.5 mT/(10^12 A m^-2), despite the presence of conventional spin Hall sources. These observations underscore the dominant role of TI-derived spin-momentum-locked currents in driving large damping-like torques and their sensitivity to interfacial structure and buffer-layer thickness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了拓扑绝缘体(TI)外延层上生长的垂直磁化金属多层膜异质结中自旋轨道矩(SOT)的温度依赖性。通过二次谐波霍尔测量发现，含Bi2Se3的样品在15K时扭矩可达约12 mT/(10^12 A m^-2)，比无拓扑层的多层膜大5倍；2nm薄Ta缓冲层增强效果最显著，而10nm厚Ta间隔层会衰减自旋传输。相比之下，仅含双重金属(Ta和Pt)而无Bi2Se3的体系扭矩仅约2.5 mT/(10^12 A m^-2)，凸显了TI表面态自旋动量锁定电流的主导作用。
AI.motivation: 探索拓扑绝缘体表面态作为高效自旋流源的潜力，理解其在不同温度下产生自旋轨道矩的机制，以及界面结构和缓冲层厚度对自旋传输效率的影响，为自旋电子学器件的优化设计提供依据。
AI.method: 制备包含Bi2Se3拓扑绝缘体外延层与垂直磁化金属多层膜的异质结样品，通过改变Ta缓冲层厚度(2nm vs 10nm)及是否含Bi2Se3进行对比，采用温度依赖的二次谐波霍尔测量技术定量表征自旋轨道矩的大小和趋势。
AI.result: 含Bi2Se3样品在15K时扭矩约12 mT/(10^12 A m^-2)，为无拓扑层样品的5倍；2nm Ta缓冲层结构增强最强且低温下显著上升；10nm厚Ta间隔层导致扭矩效率降低；无Bi2Se3的双重金属体系扭矩仅约2.5 mT/(10^12 A m^-2)。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑绝缘体衍生的自旋动量锁定电流在产生大阻尼类自旋轨道矩中起主导作用，该过程对界面结构和缓冲层厚度高度敏感。TI/多层膜异质结是实现高效自旋流产生与传输的优越平台。

title: Dynamic critical exponent of the Yang--Lee edge singularity at three loops
summary: We compute the dynamic critical exponent $z$ of the Yang--Lee edge singularity in relaxational dynamics using perturbative renormalization-group methods to the three-loop order. The calculation combines diagram reduction, analytic two-loop evaluation via parametric integration with hyperlogarithms, and numerical evaluation of three-loop integrals using the Sector Decomposition method. The perturbative series obtained is resummed using Padé and Padé-Borel-Leroy methods to produce estimates of $z$ in various spatial dimensions. The resulting values are consistent with previous perturbative and functional renormalization-group calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过三阶微扰重整化群方法计算了Yang-Lee边缘奇点在弛豫动力学中的动态临界指数z，结合了图解约化、参数积分与超对数函数的解析两环计算，以及Sector Decomposition方法的数值三环积分评估，并利用Padé和Padé-Borel-Leroy方法对微扰级数进行重求和，得到各空间维度下z的估计值，结果与先前微扰和泛函重整化群计算一致。
AI.motivation: 精确计算Yang-Lee边缘奇点的动态临界指数z，以验证和补充先前微扰及泛函重整化群方法的结果，进一步理解该普适类的动力学临界行为。
AI.method: 采用微扰重整化群方法至三环阶；通过图解约化简化费曼图计算；利用参数积分结合超对数（hyperlogarithms）进行解析两环计算；采用Sector Decomposition方法数值求解三环积分；最后用Padé和Padé-Borel-Leroy方法对微扰级数进行重求和以估计不同空间维度下的z值。
AI.result: 得到了各空间维度下动态临界指数z的估计值，且与先前微扰计算和泛函重整化群计算的结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 三环微扰重整化群方法能够可靠地计算Yang-Lee边缘奇点的动态临界指数z，其结果验证了该普适类的动力学临界行为，并与已有理论方法相互印证。

title: Gas-generating reactive flows in bicontinuous catalyst support structures
summary: A major challenge in the field of heterogeneous catalysis is selecting an optimal catalyst support structure. Commercially available structures can be easily manufactured at scale, but their stochastic nature makes their chemical and transport properties suboptimal. This is particularly relevant for gas-generation reactions, where non-uniformity of a porous structure leads to bubble trapping. Such trapping impedes the flow of reactants to catalyst sites, leading to conversion inefficiencies. Previous experimental work demonstrated that spinodally-derived architectures, in particular bicontinuous interfacially jammed emulsion gels (bijels), can alleviate these issues and deliver superior performance. However, to the best of our knowledge, numerical studies to optimize the operating conditions for such a morphology have not been performed yet. In this work, we aim to close this gap using color-gradient lattice Boltzmann simulations of reactive flows with a novel central moments collision operator. We develop an analytical model to predict catalyst performance based on our simulation data. Our findings show that this type of morphology can achieve very high conversion efficiencies. Moreover, we demonstrate that its catalyst performance can be optimized using superhydrophilic surface coatings.

AI.tldr: 本文利用颜色梯度格子玻尔兹曼模拟（采用中心矩碰撞算子）研究双连续界面稳定乳液凝胶（bijels）催化剂结构在气体生成反应中的性能，并开发了一个基于模拟数据的解析模型来预测催化剂性能，证明该形态可实现高转化效率，且可通过超亲水表面涂层优化性能。
AI.motivation: 多相催化中催化剂载体结构的选择是重大挑战。商用结构虽易于大规模制造，但其随机性导致化学和传输性质欠佳。对于气体生成反应，多孔结构的不均匀性会导致气泡滞留，阻碍反应物到达催化位点，造成转化效率低下。此前实验证明bijel结构可缓解此问题，但尚无数值研究来优化该形态的操作条件。
AI.method: 使用带有新型中心矩碰撞算子的颜色梯度格子玻尔兹曼方法对反应流进行数值模拟；基于模拟数据开发解析模型来预测催化剂性能。
AI.result: 该bijel形态能够实现非常高的转化效率；通过超亲水表面涂层可以优化催化剂性能。
AI.conclusion: 填补了bijel催化剂形态数值优化研究的空白，证明了该结构在气体生成反应中的优异性能，并提出了通过超亲水表面涂层进行性能优化的策略。

title: DINO4DSTEM: A self-supervised framework for structural discovery in 4D-STEM
comment: Main text: 17 pages, 6 figures. Includes Supplementary Information (14 pages, 20 supplementary figures). Code: https://github.com/DanielKhaykelson/dino-4dstem
summary: Nanodiffraction using 4D-STEM has become a key technique for quantitative nanoscale structural mapping in materials research, yet interpreting its high-dimensional datasets in structurally complex materials remains a major bottleneck. Existing analysis workflows typically rely on structural models, manual annotation, predefined classes, or sample-specific heuristics, limiting their ability to characterize heterogeneous complex materials.
