Here, we introduce DINO4DSTEM, a self-supervised machine learning framework that automatically discovers structurally meaningful states directly from raw diffraction data. Without structural models, manual labels, a predefined number of classes, or system-specific parameter tuning, the framework learns representations that organize diffraction patterns by their intrinsic structural similarities, transforming large collections of low-dose measurements into quantitative nanoscale structure maps. Across diverse datasets, DINO4DSTEM consistently identifies the dominant structural degrees of freedom, providing segmentation without human supervision. We applied the framework to the crystallization of indomethacin, a beam-sensitive, multidomain pharmaceutical system, revealing that crystallinity emerges from a partially ordered precursor and spans a continuous spectrum of structural order. The discovered nanoscale structural states are mapped to reveal the evolution of order across the specimen quantitatively. By replacing task-specific analysis with general self-supervised representation learning, DINO4DSTEM provides a broadly applicable framework for quantitative nanoscale structural mapping in complex materials, enabling the discovery of emergent structural organization in heterogeneous, beam-sensitive systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DINO4DSTEM，一种基于自监督机器学习的框架，能够直接从4D-STEM衍射数据中自动发现结构上有意义的物理状态，无需结构模型、人工标注、预定义类别或系统特定参数调整，实现对复杂材料的定量纳米尺度结构映射。
AI.motivation: 4D-STEM纳米衍射已成为材料研究中的关键技术，但其高维数据集在结构复杂材料中的解读仍是主要瓶颈。现有分析工作流依赖结构模型、人工标注、预定义类别或样本特定的启发式规则，限制了其对异质复杂材料的表征能力。
AI.method: 提出DINO4DSTEM框架，采用自监督机器学习方法，直接从原始衍射数据中学习表征，根据衍射图案的内在结构相似性进行组织，无需结构模型、人工标签、预定义类别数量或系统特定参数调优，将大量低剂量测量转化为定量的纳米尺度结构图。
AI.result: 在多个不同数据集上，DINO4DSTEM一致地识别出主导的结构自由度，提供无人工监督的分割。应用于吲哚美辛（一种对束流敏感的多域药物体系）的结晶过程研究，发现结晶性源于部分有序的前驱体，并跨越连续的结构有序谱。发现的纳米尺度结构状态被映射以定量揭示样品中有序性的演化。
AI.conclusion: 通过用通用的自监督表征学习替代任务特定的分析，DINO4DSTEM为复杂材料中的定量纳米尺度结构映射提供了广泛适用的框架，能够发现异质、束流敏感体系中涌现的结构组织。

title: Unlocking Multi-Component Bulk-Materials Molecular Dynamics with a Small-Footprint Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
summary: Bulk materials, as opposed to nanomaterials, require molecular dynamics (MD) simulations on a large spatial scale (~10^9 atoms or more) to adequately capture their atomic-scale physical properties. Previously, the introduction of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) has extended MD to this scale, but even single-component bulk systems require tens of thousands of GPUs on high-end supercomputers. However, multi-component bulk MD simulations remain barely achievable, as the HBM footprint of existing MLIPs - already substantial for single-component systems - grows explosively in multi-component scenarios. This paper proposes an MLIP with a small HBM footprint - less than 3% that of existing MLIPs - unlocking multi-component bulk MD using only hundreds of GPUs. This is achieved by first identifying feature vectors and intermediate tensors as the two primary contributors to HBM footprints in existing MLIPs. To address these two sources, the dimensionality of the feature vectors has been reduced by introducing physical and chemical knowledge, and intermediate tensors have been eliminated by aggressively fusing all kernels into a single mega-kernel. In evaluation, the proposed MLIP has used 144 NVIDIA A100 GPUs to perform MD simulations on a 6-component bulk system with 1.14x10^9 atoms, while previously such MD simulation spatial scale has been restricted to unary systems and typically achieved on high-end supercomputers equipped with tens of thousands of GPUs.

AI.tldr: 提出一种低HBM占用（不到现有MLIP的3%）的机器学习原子间势（MLIP），仅用144块A100 GPU即可实现10^9原子规模的6组分体相材料分子动力学模拟，此前该规模仅限单组分体系且需数万GPU。
AI.motivation: 多组分体相材料的分子动力学模拟对空间尺度要求极高（约10^9原子），现有MLIP虽已扩展到该尺度，但仅限单组分体系且需要数万GPU；多组分场景下HBM内存占用呈爆炸式增长，使得多组分大规模MD模拟难以实现。
AI.method: 1)识别特征向量和中间张量是现有MLIP中HBM占用过高（peak）的两个主要来源；2)通过引入物理和化学知识降低特征向量的维度；3)将所有核函数激进地融合为一个"mega-kernel"，消除中间张量的存储。
AI.result: 提出的MLIP将HBM占用降至现有MLIP的3%以下，仅用144块NVIDIA A100 GPU即可对1.14×10^9原子的6组分体相系统进行MD模拟，而此前类似规模仅限于单组分系统且需数万GPU。
AI.conclusion: 通过低内存占用的MLIP设计，将多组分体相材料的大规模MD模拟从"数万GPU+超级计算机"的约束中解放出来，仅需数百GPU即可实现，显著降低了该领域对高端计算资源的依赖门槛。

title: External identification and electrothermal modeling of persistent-current-switch operating states in a Siemens MRI magnet
summary: A persistent current switch (PCS) closes the superconducting loop of an MRI magnet; a heater makes it resistive so an external supply can change the magnet current. PCS control is usually treated as binary: heater on--resistive, heater off--superconducting. External current and voltage logs from an MPS2 service power supply (Digit Systems) show for a Siemens MAGNETOM Avanto magnet that the command does not uniquely determine the PCS state: after heater switch-off, Joule self-heating can sustain the resistive state. Purpose-designed maneuvers separate two resistive regimes. With the heater energized, the branch resistance is nearly constant at 1.86--2.19 $Ω$ below 0.5 V. After switch-off, the self-sustained regime follows $R_{sw}=0.65|V_{node}|^{1.5}$ ($R_{sw}$ in ohms, $V_{node}$ in volts) and is 12-fold below the heater-on resistance at 0.4 V. Both regimes obey one electrothermal relation, $R_{sw}=C(P_h h+V_{node}^2/R_{sw})^a$, with $h$ the binary heater command, over a 690-fold resistance range. First, branch resistance and coil inductance set the redistribution time constant, $τ=L/R_{sw}$; final-hold duration therefore controls persistent-current accuracy. Across 18 service sessions on other Siemens magnets, analyzed without transferring the Avanto coefficients, the median hold was $13τ$ and the median residual branch current was 8 ppm of coil current. Second, the intersection of the PCS characteristic and external-circuit load line sets the self-sustainment boundary. The cross-session estimate of 0.062 V lies between observed retrapping at 0.06 V and retention at 0.07 V. In dynamic simulation, the two fixed-coefficient characteristics $R(V,h)$ reduce current RMSE from 1.449 to 0.154 A (9.4-fold); omitting explicit heater input gives no improvement over the inductance-only model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究MRI磁体中的持续电流开关(PCS)控制问题。通过对西门子MAGNETOM Avanto磁体的MPS2电源外部电流和电压日志分析，发现加热器命令不能唯一决定PCS状态：关闭加热器后，焦耳自热可维持电阻态。研究区分了两种电阻模式，建立了统一的电热关系式R_sw=C(P_h·h+V²/R_sw)^a，并分析了其对持续电流精度和自维持边界的影响。
AI.motivation: PCS控制通常被视为二元操作（加热器开-电阻态，关-超导态），但实际观测表明加热器关闭后PCS可能因焦耳自热而维持电阻态，导致命令与状态不一致。这影响MRI磁体的持续电流精度，需要更深入理解PCS的电热行为。
AI.method: 分析MPS2外部电源的电流和电压日志；设计专门操作区分两种电阻模式（加热器通电模式与自维持模式）；推导统一电热关系式；通过18次维修会话和动态仿真验证模型。
AI.result: 加热器通电时分支电阻约1.86-2.19Ω（<0.5V）；断电后自维持电阻满足R_sw=0.65|V_node|^1.5。两种模式统一符合电热关系式，覆盖690倍电阻范围。18次会话中位保持时间为13τ，中位残余分支电流为8ppm。交叉会话估计的自维持边界为0.062V。动态仿真中双固定系数特性R(V,h)将电流RMSE从1.449降至0.154A（9.4倍）。
AI.conclusion: PCS状态不能仅由加热器命令唯一确定，焦耳自热可维持电阻态。通过两参数电热模型可以准确描述PCS行为，显著提升电流预测精度，对MRI磁体持续电流管理有重要工程意义。

title: Accessing Gapped Chiral Phase with Auxiliary-Assisted PEPS
summary: It has been controversial whether infinite projected entangled pair state (PEPS) can faithfully describe chiral gapped phases in two dimensions or not. Finite-bond-dimension PEPS can capture many local and topological properties of chiral phases, but generically develop spurious long-range power-law like correlations. We introduce an auxiliary-assisted framework that bypass this obstruction by embedding the physical chiral system together with an auxiliary time-reversed partner, yielding a non-chiral enlarged representation whose physical chiral sector is recovered with controlled decoupling. For both a free-fermion Chern insulator and an interacting chiral spin liquid, the resulting PEPS show clean gapped correlation functions, and a finite transfer-matrix correlation length, in contrast with the artificial long-range tail of direct chiral PEPS representations. There exist small and negligibly coupling between the physical and auxiliary systems due to the finite entanglement effect, which only affect short-ranged local quantities. Despite the nonchiral enlarged representation, the chiral topological information remains encoded in the entanglement. Using layer-resolved momentum projection, we recover the expected universal chiral entanglement boundary spectrum. Our study provides a practical route to access gapped chiral phases with finite bond-dimension PEPS by changing the representation problem rather than directly studying the chiral pure state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种辅助辅助框架，通过将物理手性系统与一个时间反演伙伴系统耦合，构建非手性扩大的PEPS表示，从而绕过有限键维PEPS描述二维手性间隙相的障碍，恢复干净的手性拓扑信息。
AI.motivation: 有限键维PEPS能否忠实描述二维手性间隙相一直存在争议。虽然PEPS能捕捉局部和拓扑性质，但会发展出虚假的长程幂律关联，阻碍了对真实手性间隙相的准确描述。
AI.method: 将物理手性系统与一个辅助的时间反演伙伴系统嵌入在一起，形成非手性扩大的表示，通过受控去耦合恢复物理手性扇区。对自由费米子Chern绝缘体和相互作用的手性自旋液体进行计算，并采用层分辨动量投影来恢复手性纠缠边界谱。
AI.result: 得到的PEPS展现出干净的间隙关联函数和有限转移矩阵关联长度，与直接手性PEPS表示的人为长程尾部形成对比。物理与辅助系统间存在微小可忽略的耦合，仅影响短程局域量。通过层分辨动量投影恢复了预期的手性纠缠边界谱。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种实用的途径，通过改变表示问题而非直接研究手性纯态，利用有限键维PEPS访问间隙手性相，为手性拓扑态的数值模拟开辟了新思路。

title: Field-Gated Programming of Nested Skyrmion Bags by Spatially Selective Skyrmion Writing
summary: Nested skyrmion bags are composite magnetic solitons whose internal occupation numbers provide an expanded state space for multilevel information encoding. However, deterministic and region-selective writing of individual skyrmions into nested bags remains challenging. Here, using micromagnetic simulations, we propose a field-gated nanocontact protocol for generating and programming double-layer nested skyrmion bags S(m,S(n)). The protocol exploits the opposite field responses of bag regions with antiparallel magnetic backgrounds. Spatially segmented perpendicular magnetic fields selectively expand either the outer region or the inner bag until it overlaps with a nanocontact. A spin-polarized current pulse of the appropriate polarity then nucleates one skyrmion in the selected region, while subsequent field-driven contraction moves the written skyrmion away from the contact and restores the writing site for repeated operation. Starting from an empty nested bag S(0,S(0)), this procedure enables the controlled construction of S(m,S(0)), S(0,S(n)), and general S(m,S(n)) states. The simulated total topological charge changes in unit steps during sequential writing, confirming one-at-a-time and region-selective control. These results provide a possible route toward programmable nested topological states for multilevel spintronic information encoding.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微磁模拟，提出了一种场门控纳米接触协议，用于在双层嵌套斯格明子袋中逐个、区域选择性地写入斯格明子，实现多层级信息编码。
AI.motivation: 嵌套斯格明子袋是复合磁孤子，其内部占据数提供了扩展的状态空间用于多层级信息编码，但如何确定性地、区域选择性地在嵌套袋中写入单个斯格明子仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 利用微磁模拟，提出场门控纳米接触协议。该协议利用反平行磁背景的袋区对外加磁场的相反响应：通过空间分割的垂直磁场选择性膨胀外区或内袋，使其与纳米接触重叠；随后施加适当极性的自旋极化电流脉冲在选定区域成核一个斯格明子；最后通过场驱动收缩将写入的斯格明子移离接触点并恢复写入位点，实现重复操作。
AI.result: 从空的嵌套袋S(0,S(0))出发，可控制地构建S(m,S(0))、S(0,S(n))和一般的S(m,S(n))状态。模拟显示，顺序写入过程中总拓扑电荷呈单位步长变化，确认了一次一个和区域选择性控制的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为可编程的嵌套拓扑态提供了可能的路径，有望用于多层级自旋电子学信息编码。

title: Rare-event sampling for stochastic dynamics in network systems using cluster updates
summary: Understanding the stochastic evolution in complex networks is a central challenge across physics, biology, engineering, social science, and finance. The most consequential macroscopic events, like cascading failures in communication networks, widespread epidemic outbreaks, and rapid shifts in societal opinions, often emerge from a confluence of rare, localized stochastic processes and need to pass certain bottlenecks. Standard forward-time simulation algorithms like the Gillespie method are inefficient for the investigation of such phenomena due to catastrophic rejection rates. Advanced rare-event techniques like splitting methods and transition-path sampling often suffer from kinetic trapping, path degeneracy, genealogical correlations, or critical slowing down when applied to complex heterogeneous networks. We propose to overcome this challenge by establishing a novel technique called conditional-path Monte Carlo (CPMC), inspired by loop algorithms from equilibrium condensed-matter physics. By employing non-local updates on spacetime clusters without rejections, CPMC generates a Markov chain of trajectories that all strictly respect the targeted macroscopic boundary conditions like the occurrence of a massive network failure. We demonstrate the framework's potential by performing a simple risk factor analysis for rare large-scale epidemic outbreaks in SIS dynamics on kinship networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）的新技术，用于高效模拟复杂网络中罕见的宏观事件（如级联故障、大规模流行病爆发）。该方法受凝聚态物理中环路算法启发，通过在时空簇上进行非局部无拒绝更新，生成严格满足目标宏观边界条件的轨迹马尔可夫链，克服了传统Gillespie方法高拒绝率和先进稀有事件方法（分裂法、过渡路径采样）的动力学陷阱与路径退化等问题。
AI.motivation: 复杂网络中的随机演化是关键挑战，最重大的宏观事件（级联故障、流行病爆发、舆论突变）往往源于罕见局部随机过程的汇聚并需通过瓶颈。传统前向模拟（如Gillespie方法）因灾难性拒绝率而低效，而分裂法、过渡路径采样等先进稀有事件技术在处理复杂异构网络时存在动力学陷阱、路径退化、谱系相关或临界慢化等问题。因此需要一种新的高效方法来研究这类现象。
AI.method: 作者提出条件路径蒙特卡洛（CPMC）技术，灵感来自平衡凝聚态物理中的环路算法。核心创新在于：在时空簇上执行非局部更新且无拒绝，从而生成一个轨迹的马尔可夫链，其中所有轨迹都严格满足目标宏观边界条件（如大规模网络故障的发生）。这种方法避免了传统算法的拒绝率问题，并克服了稀有事件采样方法的各种局限性。
AI.result: 作者通过在亲属网络上的SIS动力学中，对罕见的大规模流行病爆发进行简单的风险因素分析，展示了该框架的潜力，验证了CPMC能够有效研究此类稀有事件。
AI.conclusion: CPMC为复杂网络中稀有宏观事件的模拟提供了一种新颖且高效的方法，克服了现有技术的根本性局限，为物理学、生物学、工程学、社会科学和金融学等多个领域中的稀有事件研究开辟了新途径。

title: Highly Efficient 3-in-1 FPGA-Based Unit Combining an ADC, DAC, and Multichannel Pulse Generator for Pulsed EPR Spectroscopy
summary: A hardware and software system for pulsed electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy is presented, built around a single PCI Express (PCIe) card that combines a 16-bit digital-to-analog converter (DAC) with a 10 GS/s effective sample rate, a 2.5 GS/s 14-bit analog-to-digital converter (ADC), and an 11-channel pulse generator on board. Custom firmware reloads the pulse-generator and DAC buffers and streams the digitized data in parallel with a running experiment, so that no time is lost on data input or output. The unit is integrated into the open-source Atomize software and controlled at the level of pulse sequences through a high-level Python application programming interface (API). Benchmarking with a four-pulse double electron-electron resonance (DEER) sequence shows that the card reaches close to 100% time efficiency for accumulation times of a few milliseconds per pulse sequence, even for demanding arbitrary waveform generator (AWG) protocols. Although demonstrated for a single sequence, the efficiency proved insensitive to the number of pulses, the number of measurement points, or the phase-cycling depth, so that comparable performance is expected for any protocol whose shot repetition time exceeds the ~2 ms reprogramming time of the card. The on-the-fly reprogramming, which makes every successive sequence fully independent, also enables nonuniform sampling and acquisition. The system design, its firmware, the Python API, and its performance in pulsed EPR applications are described.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一套基于单张PCIe卡构建的脉冲电子顺磁共振（EPR）硬件与软件系统。该卡集成了16位DAC（10 GS/s有效采样率）、2.5 GS/s的14位ADC以及11通道脉冲发生器，配合定制固件实现实验运行期间并行数据流传输，消除了数据输入输出耗时的瓶颈。系统集成于开源Atomize软件中，通过高级Python API控制脉冲序列。基准测试表明，在四脉冲DEER序列中，该卡在毫秒级累积时间内可达接近100%的时间效率，且性能对脉冲数、测量点数及相位循环深度不敏感。
AI.motivation: 脉冲EPR光谱学需要高精度、高速度的硬件系统来生成任意波形并同步采集数据，以提高实验效率和灵活性。现有系统在数据吞吐、脉冲序列编程和软件集成方面存在瓶颈，限制了复杂实验协议（如DEER）的性能。
AI.method: 作者设计了一款单PCIe卡硬件系统，集成高速DAC、ADC和多通道脉冲发生器，并通过定制固件实现脉冲发生器与DAC缓冲区的实时重载及数据并行流式传输。软件层面采用开源Atomize集成和高级Python API控制脉冲序列，支持任意波形生成与相位循环。
AI.result: 四脉冲DEER基准测试显示，在几毫秒的脉冲序列累积时间内，该系统可达接近100%的时间效率。效率对脉冲数量、测量点数和相位循环深度不敏感，且当重复时间超过约2 ms的重编程时间时，性能可推广至任意协议。系统还支持非均匀采样与采集。
AI.conclusion: 该系统通过PCIe卡上的集成硬件和固件优化，实现了近乎无损的时间效率与灵活的脉冲序列控制，为脉冲EPR应用提供了高性能、开源且易用的解决方案。

title: Broadband phonon-velocity suppression and a finite anisotropic crossover in twisted bilayer SnSe
summary: Moiré superlattices reshape lattice dynamics without altering chemical composition, yet how crystal anisotropy modifies this control remains unclear. We combine density-functional-theory (DFT)-calibrated lattice-dynamical calculations with angle-matched untwisted controls to study puckered bilayer SnSe across seven commensurate twist angles ($3.18^\circ$--$8.77^\circ$). At 300 K, twisting suppresses the band-path heat-capacity-weighted mean-square group velocity to 2.6--8.4\% of the control values; the suppression spans a broad frequency range rather than a few soft branches. The velocity response crosses over between $4.78^\circ$ and $3.82^\circ$ into a regime where the relaxed stacking textures and frequency-resolved velocity profiles become self-similar, with the normalized mean-square velocity ratio spanning only 11.1\% of its mean across the three smallest angles---a finite anisotropic crossover, not a singular-angle condition. Direct DFT--MACE force-constant agreement ($r=0.996$), uniform $4\times4\times1$ stability scans, and acoustic-sum-rule and path-density tests support the trend. The equilibrium trend is defined by six structures after excluding one relaxation-sensitive case. These results extend phonon twistronics to low-symmetry layered materials and identify crystal anisotropy as a key determinant of finite-angle phonon crossover behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT校准的晶格动力学计算与角度匹配的非扭曲对照，研究了层状SnSe在七个不同扭曲角下的声子行为，发现扭曲可将带路径热容加权均方群速度抑制至对照值的2.6-8.4%，并在4.78°到3.82°之间观察到有限各向异性交叉行为，将声子扭电子学拓展到低对称性层状材料。
AI.motivation: 莫尔超晶格重塑晶格动力学而不改变化学组成，但晶体各向异性如何调控这一效应仍不清楚。作者希望揭示各向异性晶体中扭曲角对声子输运的影响机制。
AI.method: 结合DFT校准的晶格动力学计算与角度匹配的非扭曲对照，对褶皱双层SnSe在七个通约扭曲角（3.18°-8.77°）进行研究；采用DFT-MACE力常数验证（r=0.996）、4×4×1稳定性扫描、声学求和规则和路径密度测试来支撑结果。
AI.result: 在300K下，扭曲将带路径热容加权均方群速度抑制至对照值的2.6-8.4%，且抑制覆盖宽频率范围。速度响应在4.78°-3.82°之间发生交叉，进入自相似区域，三个最小角度归一化均方速度比仅跨越均值的11.1%，表现出有限各向异性交叉而非奇异角度条件。基于六个结构定义了平衡趋势。
AI.conclusion: 研究将声子扭电子学拓展到低对称性层状材料，确认晶体各向异性是有限角度声子交叉行为的关键决定因素。

title: Differential-Embedding Reconstruction of Dynamical Systems from Scalar Time Series
summary: We study the reconstruction of an unknown dynamical system from a single noisy scalar time series. The goal is to recover the underlying dynamics for forecasting. We introduce a method that uses differential embedding coordinates to identify a rational closure of the embedding dynamics directly from data. The closure is identified through a weak-form regression pipeline, which avoids unstable pointwise differentiation of noisy data. When applied to noise-free Lorenz and Rössler systems, the method recovers closures that support long forecasts across a broad ensemble of realizations ($18.1$ and $7.1$ Lyapunov times respectively). Under $15$--$30\%$ additive Gaussian noise, performance becomes system-dependent. For the Lorenz system, forecast horizons remain short even in the best cases, whereas the Rössler system generally performs better in absolute terms, though not once normalized by the Lyapunov time. Our proposed method recovers directly interpretable closure coefficients which we compared against the known analytic closures of the Lorenz and Rössler systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从单个带噪标量时间序列重建未知动力系统的问题，提出一种利用微分嵌入坐标识别嵌入动力学有理闭包的方法，通过弱形式回归（避免对噪声数据的不稳定逐点微分）直接从数据中识别闭包。在无噪声Lorenz和Rössler系统上，该方法恢复的闭包支持长时间预报（分别为18.1和7.1个Lyapunov时间）；在15%-30%加性高斯噪声下性能因系统而异，Lorenz系统预报范围在最佳情况下仍然较短，而Rössler系统在绝对数值上表现更好（虽按Lyapunov时间归一化后并非如此）。该方法恢复的闭包系数可直接解释，并与两个系统的已知解析闭包进行了比较。
AI.motivation: 从单个带噪标量时间序列重建未知动力系统并用于预测是困难的，现有方法常因噪声下的不稳定点微分散失精度。作者希望通过一种稳健的方法直接识别嵌入动力学的闭包，从而在噪声环境下仍能实现可靠的长期预报。
AI.method: 利用微分嵌入坐标（differential embedding coordinates）识别嵌入动力学的有理闭包（rational closure）。采用弱形式回归（weak-form regression）管线来识别闭包，避免对噪声数据做不稳定的逐点微分。获得的闭包系数具有直接可解释性，可与已知解析闭包对比。
AI.result: 在无噪声Lorenz和Rössler系统上，方法分别实现了18.1和7.1个Lyapunov时间的长期预报。在15%-30%加性高斯噪声下性能呈系统依赖性：Lorenz系统即使在最佳情况下预报范围仍短，Rössler系统绝对预报时间更长（按Lyapunov时间归一化后则不占优）。恢复的闭包系数与已知解析闭包拟合良好。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能在无噪声条件下有效恢复系统的有理闭包并支持长期预测；在噪声下性能依赖具体动力系统特性，总体上证明了可解释闭包识别方法在动力系统重建与预测中的潜力，但也揭示了噪声鲁棒性仍需进一步的改进。

title: Superconducting $T_\mathrm{c}$ up to 20.6 K in bulk YSi$_2$ and YSi$_2$/Si superlattices due to chemical flattening
summary: Currently, the fundamental building blocks of leading quantum computers are Josephson junctions, whose core is usually the superconducting Al on Si wafers. However, the transition temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$ of bulk Al ($\sim1.1$ K) is below the boiling point of liquid helium ($\sim4.2$ K), which is one of the challenges to its widespread application. Here, we propose a Si-matched AlB$_2$-type superconductor YSi$_2$ as a promising alternative to Al. The solution of anisotropic (isotropic) Migdal-Eliashberg equation without (with) anharmonicity gives $T_\mathrm{c}\sim20.6$ K ($17.2$ K), which is at the highest level in silicides. Its excellent superconductivity can be attributed mainly to the Si honeycombs, which become plane here due to the 'chemical flattening' effects of the Y atoms instead of being buckled in most silicides. We tested its thermodynamical, kinetic, dynamical, and mechanical stability by first-principles calculations. Particularly, the negative elastic stiffness constant $C_{66}$ calculated by usual methods turns positive even without the zero-point energy once the Si honeycombs are compressed below a threshold. This strain can also make its calculated lattice constants agree with the experimental ones. We propose structures to realize this strain, i.e., YSi$_2$(0001)/Si(111) superlattices, which can also strengthen the overall stability of YSi$_2$ while maintaining its $T_\mathrm{c}$ above $7.0$ K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种硅基匹配的AlB₂型超导体YSi₂，作为约瑟夫森结核心材料Al的替代方案。通过各向异性(各向同性)Migdal-Eliashberg方程求解，得到超导转变温度Tc约为20.6 K(17.2 K)，在硅化物中处于最高水平。其优异超导性主要归因于Y原子的"化学平坦化"效应使Si蜂窝结构变为平面。通过第一性原理计算验证了其热力学、动力学、动力学和机械稳定性，并发现通过压缩Si蜂窝结构可以解决负弹性常数C₆₆的问题。最终提出YSi₂(0001)/Si(111)超晶格结构来实现所需应变，同时保持Tc高于7.0 K。
AI.motivation: 当前量子计算机核心元件约瑟夫森结基于Al超导体，但Al的转变温度(~1.1 K)低于液氦沸点(~4.2 K)，限制了其广泛应用。因此需要寻找性能更优的替代超导材料，尤其是与硅衬底匹配的材料。
AI.method: 采用各向异性和各向同性Migdal-Eliashberg方程(考虑/不考虑非谐效应)计算超导转变温度；使用第一性原理计算全面验证材料的热力学、动力学、动力学和机械稳定性；通过施加应变压缩Si蜂窝结构改善负弹性常数问题；提出YSi₂(0001)/Si(111)超晶格结构以实现所需应变。
AI.result: YSi₂的Tc在硅化物中处于最高水平；其超导性源于Si蜂窝结构的平面化(由Y原子的化学平坦化效应实现)。通过压缩Si蜂窝结构，负弹性常数C₆₆变为正值，同时晶格常数与实验值吻合。提出的超晶格结构可增强稳定性，Tc仍保持在7.0 K以上。
AI.conclusion: YSi₂是Al的可行替代材料，具有显著更高的超导转变温度，且与Si衬底匹配，通过超晶格结构设计可以同时保证稳定性和超导性能，为量子计算超导器件的广泛应用提供了新的可能。

title: Linear response functions from inhomogeneous dynamical mean-field theory
summary: We present a method for calculating static lattice susceptibilities with inhomogeneous dynamical mean-field theory. The method utilizes the response of the system to an external field and thereby circumvents two-particle vertex functions. We demonstrate the success of our approach for the magnetic susceptibility of the square-lattice Hubbard model using the numerical renormalization group as an impurity solver and show that it compares well with the results obtained using the standard vertex approach. As it avoids vertex functions and is compatible with virtually any impurity solver, our method is able to reach low temperatures that are hard to access with other methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用非均匀动力学平均场理论（DMFT）计算静态晶格磁化率的方法。该方法通过系统对外场的响应来规避双粒子顶点函数，并利用数值重整化群（NRG）作为杂质求解器，在方形晶格Hubbard模型上验证了其与标准顶点方法的一致性。由于避免使用顶点函数且兼容几乎任何杂质求解器，该方法能够在其他方法难以达到的低温下工作。
AI.motivation: 传统的动力学平均场理论计算静态晶格磁化率通常需要计算双粒子顶点函数，这在数值上代价高昂且对许多杂质求解器不友好，尤其难以在低温下实现。
AI.method: 通过利用系统对外部扰动场的线性响应来计算静态晶格磁化率，从而完全绕过对双粒子顶点函数的直接计算，并结合非均匀DMFT框架和NRG杂质求解器实现。
AI.result: 在方形晶格Hubbard模型的磁性磁化率计算中，该方法的结果与标准顶点方法吻合良好，且能够达到其他方法难以触及的低温区域。
AI.conclusion: 该方法作为一种避免顶点函数的替代方案，兼容性广泛且适用于低温，为静态晶格磁化率计算提供了一种高效实用的途径。

title: A cold-insertable scanning probe microscope for dry dilution refrigerators with picometer stability and ultra-low electron temperatures
summary: Investigating the microscopic mechanisms of quantum materials requires high-resolution scanning probe techniques, often based on atomic force microscopy (AFM). However, implementing AFM in cryogen-free dilution refrigerators with picometer stability is challenged by intense pulse tube mechanical noise ($S_{\rm PT}(f)\approx10^{-6}\,\text{m}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$) and the fundamental trade-off with thermalizing piezoelectric motion stages below 100\,mK. Here, we demonstrate an AFM-based scanning microwave impedance microscope integrated onto a standard cold-insertable probe that successfully resolves this bottleneck. By employing a two-pronged design strategy---coupling a mechanically stiff AFM module with a magnetic-field-compatible, critically damped internal spring-suspension---we achieve an extremely low relative tip-sample vibration noise density of $S_{\rm AFM}(f)<10^{-11}\,\text{m}/\sqrt{\text{Hz}}$. This yields a spectrally integrated relative tip-sample displacement of $Δz\approx10\,\text{pm}$, representing a greater than 100-fold stability improvement over recent fast-loading dry SPM setups. Simultaneously, optimized thermal interfaces, customized copper strapping, and comprehensive RF filtering enable a local sample electron temperature of $T_{\rm e}\leq 60\,$mK, circumventing the thermal penalties of mechanical decoupling. By avoiding permanent structural modifications to the host cryostat, this robust, modular architecture provides an accessible framework for adapting other scanning probe techniques, accelerating the exploration of fragile quantum phases in dry cryostats with picometer stability.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种集成到标准冷插探针上的AFM扫描微波阻抗显微镜，通过双管齐下的设计策略（机械刚硬的AFM模块+磁兼容临界阻尼内部弹簧悬挂），在无液氦稀释制冷机中实现了<10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz的极低振动噪声密度和~10 pm的光谱积分相对位移，同时通过优化热接口和RF滤波将局部样品电子温度维持在≤60 mK，较近期快装载干式SPM系统提升了100倍以上稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在无液氦稀释制冷机中实现AFM面临两大挑战：脉冲管机械噪声极大（~10⁻⁶ m/√Hz）以及100 mK以下压电运动台热化与稳定性之间的根本性权衡，需要解决这一瓶颈以探索脆弱的量子相。
AI.method: 采用双管齐下设计策略：(1)耦合机械刚硬的AFM模块；(2)结合磁兼容、临界阻尼的内部弹簧悬挂系统。同时通过优化热界面、定制铜带连接和全面RF滤波来维持低温性能，且采用模块化架构避免对宿主低温恒温器的永久结构修改。
AI.result: 实现了S_AFM(f)<10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz的相对尖端-样品振动噪声密度，光谱积分相对位移Δz≈10 pm，较近期快装载干式SPM系统提升100倍以上；同时维持局部样品电子温度T_e≤60 mK，规避了机械解耦的热副作用。
AI.conclusion: 该稳健的模块化架构为在干式低温恒温器中适配其他扫描探针技术提供了可行框架，以皮米级稳定性加速脆弱的量子相探索，无需对宿主低温恒温器进行永久性修改。

title: Absence of critical scaling in the Schelling segregation model
comment: 24 pages, 16 figures, 6 appendices. Over 12,500 simulation runs on periodic grids up to L = 320; Chebyshev radii r_0 up to 6 (k = 168 neighbors)
summary: We find no evidence of critical scaling in the Schelling segregation model, in either the Moore neighborhood or its dense-spectrum extension to Chebyshev radii up to $r_0 = 6$ ($k = 168$ neighbors). On periodic grids up to $L = 320$ with 50 trials per point (> 12,500 runs), every finite-size scaling diagnostic in the Moore baseline fails: the per-$L$ $T_c$ does not drift, Var$(S) \sim L^{-2.02 \pm 0.09}$ matches trivial averaging, $γ/ν\approx 0$, and the scaling collapse never reaches a finite optimum. The 8-site Moore neighborhood restricts satisfaction to ratios $j/k$ with $k \leq 8$, giving $S(T)$ a staircase structure with 23 rational thresholds; discreteness alone does not forbid criticality (cf. the Ising model), but the scaling evidence rules it out empirically. A branching-ratio calculation predicts subcritical cascades of mean size $1/(1-R)$ and is validated by perturbation experiments to within 15%; the multiscalar dissimilarity length stays finite across the transition. The dense-spectrum extension strengthens the negative verdict: across $r_0 \in {3,4,5,6}$ on $L \in {40,80,160}$ the Binder cumulant has no $L$-curve crossing and the per-$L$ $T_c$ drift is monotonic and unsaturated; at $r_0 = 4$, extending to $L = 320$ gives $α= -2.70$, below the critical boundary $α= -2$, dissolving an apparent $α= +0.81$ signal visible only on $L \in {40,80}$. The mechanism is the absence of long-range correlation in equilibrium plus deterministic high-$k$ dynamics, not the staircase structure. With a Beta-distributed heterogeneous tolerance, the intolerant tail drives segregation even at moderate population-average tolerance. The staircase theorem and cascade mechanism together account for the Schelling transition without invoking critical phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模数值实验证明Schelling隔离模型不存在临界标度行为。在Moore邻域及扩展到半径r0≤6的稠密谱邻域中，所有有限尺寸标度诊断均失败：Tc不漂移、方差按平凡平均衰减、γ/ν≈0、标度塌缩无最优。机制是平衡态缺乏长程关联加上确定性高k动力学，而非离散阶梯结构。分支比计算预测亚临界级联尺寸，误差在15%内。异质容忍度分布下，不容忍尾部驱动隔离。
AI.motivation: Schelling隔离模型长期被视为从混合态到分离态的相变，但缺乏严格的临界性验证。作者旨在通过严格的有限尺寸标度分析检验该模型是否真正属于临界现象，并澄清其相变机制的本质。
AI.method: 在周期网格（L最大320）上进行大规模蒙特卡洛模拟（>12,500次运行），应用多种有限尺寸标度诊断：每L的Tc漂移分析、方差标度指数、Binder累积量、标度塌缩验证。同时引入稠密谱邻域扩展（r0=3-6）以消除8-site邻域离散效应对结果的影响，并通过分支比计算和微扰实验验证级联机制，最后引入Beta分布异质容忍度测试。
AI.result: 所有标度诊断在Moore基线中均失败：Var(S)~L^-2.02±0.09符合平凡平均，γ/ν≈0，无Tc漂移。稠密谱扩展强化了否定结论：Binder累积量无L-曲线交叉，r0=4时α=-2.70低于临界边界α=-2。分支比预测与微扰实验吻合（15%误差内），异质容忍度下不容忍尾部主导隔离过程。
AI.conclusion: Schelling隔离模型的转变不涉及临界现象，其机制是平衡态缺乏长程关联与确定性高k动力学，加上阶梯定理描述的离散满足阈值和级联传播机制。这重新框定了对Schelling模型的理解：它是级联驱动的亚临界过程而非临界相变。

title: Nonadiabatic Dynamics near Multiple Light-Induced Conical Intersections under Bichromatic Driving: Quantum Wave-Packet Dynamics versus Floquet Surface Hopping
summary: Light-induced conical intersections (LICIs) create externally tunable pathways for nonadiabatic transitions, enabling active control of molecular photophysical and photochemical processes. However, both the dynamics near multiple LICIs under bichromatic driving and the applicability of our recently developed two-mode Floquet fewest switches surface hopping (two-mode F-FSSH) method to this regime remain insufficiently understood. Here, we construct a minimal three-channel Floquet Hamiltonian supporting two LICIs for Na2 interacting with a bichromatic field. We characterize its static Floquet properties and investigate the associated nonadiabatic dynamics using numerically exact quantum wave-packet dynamics and two-mode F-FSSH. We find that the second photon energy controls the relative positions of the LICIs, whereas the second-field intensity primarily redistributes and broadens the derivative-coupling landscape around the second LICI. Consequently, electronic population transfer and molecular alignment exhibit distinct and often nonmonotonic responses to these two control parameters. Two-mode F-FSSH reliably captures the principal features of the early-time dynamics and provides a semiquantitative description of the post-transient time-averaged observables. These findings advance our understanding of LICI-mediated dynamics at both the physical and methodological levels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Na2分子在双色光场下形成的两个光诱导 conical intersections (LICIs) 及其非绝热动力学，并评估了课题组近期发展的两模 Floquet 少开关表面跳跃（two-mode F-FSSH）方法在该体系中的适用性。研究发现第二光子能量控制 LICI 的相对位置，第二场强度主要重塑 derivative-coupling 景观，且电子布居转移和分子排列对这两个控制参数呈现非单调响应。两模 F-FSSH 能可靠捕捉早期动力学主要特征，并对瞬态后时间平均观测量给出半定量描述。
AI.motivation: 光诱导圆锥交叉（LICIs）为主动控制分子光物理和光化学过程提供了外部可调的非绝热跃迁路径，但在双色光驱动下多个 LICIs 附近的动力学行为尚不清楚，且需要验证新发展的两模 F-FSSH 方法在该场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 构建了支持两个 LICIs 的 Na2 与双色光场相互作用的最小三通道 Floquet 哈密顿量；表征了其静态 Floquet 性质；使用数值精确的量子波包动力学和两模 F-FSSH 两种方法研究非绝热动力学。
AI.result: 第二光子能量控制两个 LICIs 的相对位置，第二场强度主要重塑第二个 LICI 附近的 derivative-coupling 景观。电子布居转移和分子排列对这两个参数呈现不同的、通常非单调的响应。两模 F-FSSH 能可靠捕捉早期动力学的主要特征，并对瞬态后的时间平均观测量提供半定量描述。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现从物理和方法论两个层面加深了对 LICI 介导动力学的理解，验证了两模 F-FSSH 作为处理多 LICI 双色场驱动体系的可行工具。

title: Linking Electronic Bonding and Short-range Order to Strength in $α$-Titanium Alloys: A First-Principles Study
summary: The development of accurate strength prediction models for titanium alloys is critical for advanced materials design. This study systematically examines how the mechanical properties of $α$-Ti are affected by substitutional (X = Al, V, Mo) and interstitial (Y = H, C, N, O) alloying elements, with a focus on electronic bonding. Using density functional theory (DFT), we uncover the short-range ordering (SRO) of substitutional atoms and quantify their influence on the electronic bonding and mechanical behavior. The primary novelty of this work lies in developing a predictive model for tensile strength that goes beyond traditional empirical approaches. To quantify the contributions of individual solutes to strengthening, we use physically grounded quantum-chemical descriptors, such as the Integrated Crystal Orbital Hamilton Population (ICOHP), which is a direct measure of bond strength derived from first-principles calculations. The resulting formula quantitatively predicts the tensile strength of a wide range of $α$-Ti alloys, demonstrating a significant advancement in the computational design of high-performance structural materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用密度泛函理论（DFT）系统研究了替位（Al、V、Mo）和间隙（H、C、N、O）合金元素对α-Ti力学性能的影响，通过揭示替位原子的短程有序（SRO）并将量子化学描述符ICOHP纳入预测框架，开发了一种超越传统经验方法的抗拉强度预测模型，可定量预测多种α-Ti合金的拉伸强度。
AI.motivation: 为先进材料设计开发准确的钛合金强度预测模型至关重要，而传统经验方法缺乏物理基础，无法深入理解合金元素对力学性能影响的微观机制。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，分析替位（Al、V、Mo）和间隙（H、C、N、O）合金元素对α-Ti电子键合的影响；揭示替位原子的短程有序（SRO）；使用物理基础的量子化学描述符ICOHP（Integrated Crystal Orbital Hamilton Population）作为键强的直接度量，构建抗拉强度预测公式。
AI.result: 所建立的公式能够定量预测广泛α-Ti合金的抗拉强度，展示了计算设计高性能结构材料的显著进展。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为α-Ti合金强度预测提供了基于第一性原理和物理量子化学描述符的新范式，超越了传统经验方法，为计算驱动的先进结构材料设计开辟了新路径。

title: Theory of Magnetic Excitations in the Heavy-Fermion Spin-Triplet Superconductor UTe$_2$
summary: We study the dynamical spin response of UTe$_2$ by using a mixed-dimensional periodic Anderson model. Within the BCS-RPA formalism, we examine how the $f$-orbital character of the quasiparticles affects magnetic excitations in both the normal and superconducting (SC) states. In the normal state, finite mixing between localized $f$ electrons and conduction electrons produces a hybridization gap and enhances the spin response at $\mathbf{Q}_{\mathrm{Y}} = (0,π,0)$, indicating that the magnetic excitation originates from particle--hole scattering across the hybridization gap. In the SC state, we compare four odd-parity irreducible representations, $A_u$, $B_{1u}$, $B_{2u}$, and $B_{3u}$, for the spin-triplet order parameter. We find that, for the component of the spin susceptibility parallel to the $\mathbf{d}$ vector, a pronounced superconductivity-induced spin resonance appears at $\mathbf{Q}_{\mathrm{Y}}$ only in the $B_{2u}$ state. This behavior arises because the $B_{2u}$ order parameter remains finite and changes its sign between the relevant $f$-electron-dominated Fermi-surface regions connected by $\mathbf{Q}_\mathrm{Y}$ near $k_z=π$. The sign-change criterion is applicable to multiband superconductors in three-dimensional heavy-fermion systems, in the presence of (i) low-dimensional portions of the Fermi surface connected by a nesting vector, (ii) the dominance of the $f$-electron character, and (iii) the finite amplitude of SC gap on the portions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用混合维度周期性Anderson模型，在BCS-RPA框架下研究UTe₂的自旋动力学响应。研究发现B₂u态奇宇称自旋三重态超导序参量在Q_Y=(0,π,0)处产生显著的超导诱导自旋共振，其根源在于该序参量在由Q_Y连接的f电子主导费米面区域间变号。
AI.motivation: UTe₂是近年发现的自旋三重态超导体，其磁激发与超导配对对称性之间存在密切关联。理解f轨道准粒子如何影响磁激发，以及如何通过自旋共振来区分各种可能的奇宇称配对态，是判断其超导配对对称性的关键。
AI.method: 采用混合维度周期性Anderson模型描述UTe₂，在BCS-RPA（随机相位近似）框架下计算正常态和超导态的动力学自旋响应。正常态中考察f电子与巡游电子杂化对磁激发的影响；超导态中比较A_u、B_1u、B_2u、B_3u四种奇宇称不可约表示的自旋三重态序参量，分析其自旋共振行为。
AI.result: 正常态中，f电子与巡游电子的杂化产生杂化能隙，并在Q_Y=(0,π,0)处增强自旋响应，磁激发源于跨杂化能隙的粒子-空穴散射。超导态中，仅在B₂u态下，平行于d矢量的自旋磁化率分量在Q_Y处出现显著的超导诱导自旋共振。原因是B₂u序参量在k_z=π附近由Q_Y连接的f电子主导费米面区域间保持有限且符号翻转。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个适用于三维重费米子多带超导体的变号判据，需同时满足三个条件：(i)费米面存在由嵌套矢量连接的低维部分；(ii)f电子特征占主导；(iii)该部分上超导能隙振幅有限。该判据可用来区分UTe₂的配对对称性，为实验上识别B₂u态提供理论依据。

title: Topological Altermagnetic Insulators
summary: We study the emergence of altermagnetic topological phases stabilized by Ising spin-orbit coupling in a prototypical Lieb lattice model of a correlated altermagnet. Treating the electron interactions within the Hartree-Fock and the exact diagonalization techniques, we establish the co-existence of a quantum spin Hall effect with altermagnetic spin order over a wide region of the parameter space for average electron densities of 2 and 4 per unit cell. We explore how the magnetic structure along edges influences the electronic behavior of the associated topological edge modes, demonstrating their robustness against inversion-symmetry breaking terms.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个原型Lieb晶格模型中的相关交替磁体，发现Ising自旋轨道耦合可以稳定交替磁拓扑相，并在较宽的参数空间内实现量子自旋霍尔效应与交替磁自旋序共存。
AI.motivation: 探索交替磁体中拓扑相的涌现机制，特别是Ising自旋轨道耦合如何在相关交替磁体系中稳定拓扑相，并理解边缘磁结构对拓扑边缘态电子行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用Hartree-Fock和精确对角化两种方法处理电子相互作用，在Lieb晶格模型中研究Ising自旋轨道耦合驱动的交替磁拓扑相，并分析边缘磁结构对拓扑边缘态的影响。
AI.result: 在单位晶胞平均电子密度为2和4的较宽参数区域内，建立了量子自旋霍尔效应与交替磁自旋序的共存；边缘磁结构影响拓扑边缘态的电子行为，且边缘态对反演对称破缺项具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 交替磁拓扑相可以通过Ising自旋轨道耦合在相关Lieb晶格模型中稳定实现，其拓扑边缘态对反演对称破缺具有鲁棒性，为交替磁拓扑材料提供了新的理论平台。

title: Weak localization in magnetic Euler bands
summary: We study the quantum correction to the conductivity due to disorder in two-dimensional fragile topological bands with nonzero Euler class. Contrary to graphene where two Dirac nodes have opposite vorticities, two bands with a unit Euler number possess two Dirac points with the same vorticity, which may affect the Anderson localization. Most notably, we report an anomalous localization behavior in spinful magnetic Euler bands based on symmetry analysis and diagrammatic calculations. Despite the presence of spin-orbit coupling and an in-plane magnetization that explicitly breaks physical time-reversal symmetry, the system exhibits weak localization behavior characteristic of the orthogonal symmetry class. We demonstrate that this counter-intuitive phenomenon originates from an emergent effective time-reversal symmetry composed of crystalline and spacetime inversion symmetries, allowing it to supersede the standard localization behavior. Our findings reveal that the effective crystalline symmetries can fundamentally alter the universality class of disordered systems, rendering the localization behavior independent of the specific vorticity configuration of Dirac nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维脆弱拓扑带（具有非零Euler类）中无序导致的量子电导修正。与石墨烯中两个Dirac节点涡度相反不同，单位Euler数的能带具有两个相同涡度的Dirac点。作者发现自旋磁性Euler带中，尽管自旋轨道耦合和面内磁化明确破缺物理时间反演对称性，系统仍展现正交对称类的弱局域化行为，源于晶格对称与时空反演对称组合出的有效时间反演对称性。
AI.motivation: 探究具有非零Euler类的脆弱拓扑带中，相同涡度的Dirac点对Anderson局域化的影响，以及对称性分析是否足以预测无序系统中的普适性类别。
AI.method: 基于对称性分析和费曼图微扰计算，研究二维脆弱拓扑带（Euler类）中的量子电导修正和弱局域化行为。
AI.result: 发现自旋磁性Euler带中尽管物理时间反演对称性被破缺，系统仍表现出正交对称类的弱局域化行为；该现象源于由晶体对称和时空反演对称组合而成的有效时间反演对称性，使局域化行为与Dirac节点涡度构型无关。
AI.conclusion: 有效晶体对称性可以从根本上改变无序系统的普适性类别，揭示局域化行为不受Dirac节点涡度具体构型的制约。

title: Statistical Mechanics of a Quantum Harmonic Oscillator with Folded Gaussian Frequency
summary: A self-contained statistical-mechanics treatment of a single quantum harmonic oscillator is presented, whose frequency $ω$ is drawn from a folded Gaussian distribution: $ω=|ξ|$ with $ξ\sim\mathcal{N}(μ,σ^2)$. The exact integral representations for the partition function, internal energy, free energy, heat capacity, and entropy are derived, and analytic approximations are given in two complementary limits---small variance ($σ\llμ$) via a cumulant expansion, and the zero-center case ($μ=0$) via low-frequency asymptotic analysis. The model is extended to $N$ independent oscillators, where the heat capacity is shown to be extensive with self-averaging fluctuations $\propto N^{-1/2}$, and finally to a disordered oscillator lattice, where the folded-Gaussian kink at $ω=0$ produces a soft-mode infrared tail. For a single isolated oscillator with $μ=0$, both $C$ and $S$ vanish linearly at low $T$. In the lattice case, the van Hove factor converts this to a $T^d$ power law. The oft-quoted ``third-law violation'' for disordered phonons is here shown to be a spectral property---the absence of an energy gap and a power-law freeze-out---driven by the single-site distribution kink rather than by a genuine Lifshitz tail (which requires rare large-scale spatial fluctuations). The folded Gaussian thus serves as a minimal benchmark for soft-mode disorder thermodynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文对单个量子谐振子（其频率服从折叠高斯分布）进行了自洽的统计力学处理，推导出配分函数、内能、自由能、热容和熵的精确积分表示，并给出小方差（累积量展开）和零中心（低频渐近）两种极限下的解析近似。模型扩展至N个独立谐振子（热容具有广延性，涨落自平均∝N^{-1/2}）及无序谐振子晶格（折叠高斯在ω=0处的扭结产生软模红外尾部）。关键发现：所谓"第三定律违背"实为谱性质（无能隙+幂律冻结），由单点分布扭结而非真正的Lifshitz尾部驱动。
AI.motivation: 为无序声子热力学提供一个最小基准模型，澄清"第三定律违背"在无序体系中的机制本质——区分谱性质驱动的冻结与真正的Lifshitz尾部效应，从而为软模无序热力学建立简洁的解析框架。
AI.method: 采用折叠高斯分布ω=|ξ|（ξ~N(μ,σ²)）对单个量子谐振子的频率进行建模；通过精确积分表示推导各热力学量；使用累积量展开处理小方差极限，用低频渐近分析处理μ=0情形；将模型推广到N个独立振子（利用自平均性质）及无序晶格（结合van Hove态密度因子分析软模红外尾部）。
AI.result: 得到单振子各热力学量的精确积分形式和两种极限下的解析近似。对于μ=0的孤立振子，热容C和熵S在低温下线性消失；在晶格情形下，van Hove因子将这一行为转化为T^d幂律。热容具有广延性与N^{-1/2}的自平均涨落。证明了"第三定律违背"源于单点分布扭结导致的谱性质（无能隙与幂律冻结），而非Lifshitz尾部。
AI.conclusion: 折叠高斯分布可作为软模无序热力学的最小基准模型。无序声子体系的"第三定律违背"应被理解为由单点谱分布扭结控制的谱性质，而非需要罕见大尺度空间涨落的Lifshitz尾部效应，这为区分不同无序机制提供了清晰判据。

title: Extracting a nitrile-centered, ether-assisted motif hierarchy for lithium-battery electrolyte design from billion-scale molecular space
comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, including a graphical abstract
summary: Designing electrolyte molecules for lithium batteries requires balancing electronic stability with appropriate Li+ solvation, yet the structural basis remains unclear across chemically diverse molecules. High-throughput screening expands the searchable space, but ranked candidates alone do not reveal recurring motifs or their applicability limits. We searched nearly one billion GDB13 structures using electronic--solvation descriptors without explicit functional-group preferences or scaffold constraints. Across descriptor weights, high-ranking populations separated into a nitrile-dominant regime and a coexistence regime containing substantial fractions of both nitrile- and ether-containing molecules. These regimes together define a nitrile-centered, ether-assisted motif hierarchy: nitrile remains favored across broad weight ranges, whereas ether becomes prominent under stronger electrostatic and polarity constraints. Encoding this hierarchy in a generative model expands the candidate space beyond GDB13 and yields high-scoring fluorinated structures without an explicit fluorination reward. Explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulations show weak, exchangeable coordination of representative candidates without displacing ethylene carbonate from the dominant first solvation shell around Li+; effects on ion association and transport depend on molecular structure and concentration. These results establish a quantitative, interpretable and physically bounded motif hierarchy that systematizes established nitrile and ether chemistry for lithium-battery electrolyte design.

AI.tldr: 本文通过近十亿个GDB13结构的电子-溶剂化描述符高通量筛选，揭示了锂电池电解质分子设计中以腈为中心、醚辅助的基序层级结构，并利用生成模型扩展搜索空间，发现氟化结构无需显式奖励即可获得高分候选分子。
AI.motivation: 设计锂离子电池电解质分子需要在电子稳定性与Li+溶剂化之间取得平衡，但跨化学多样分子间缺乏清晰的结构基础认知。现有高通量筛选仅提供排名候选，无法揭示重复出现的基序模式或其适用边界，因此需要建立可解释的结构-性能关系。
AI.method: 采用电子-溶剂化描述符对近十亿个GDB13结构进行无偏筛选（不预设官能团偏好或骨架约束）；通过变权描述符分析高排名种群分布；将基序层级编码进生成模型以扩展GDB13之外的候选空间；利用显式溶剂分子动力学模拟验证代表性候选分子的配位行为。
AI.result: 高排名种群在不同描述符权重下分为腈主导区和共存区（腈与醚分子均有显著占比），形成以腈为中心、醚辅助的基序层级。生成模型成功产出高分氟化结构（无显式氟化奖励），分子动力学显示候选分子与Li+呈弱可交换配位，且不排斥碳酸乙烯酯占主导第一溶剂化壳层，对离子缔合和传输的影响依赖于分子结构与浓度。
AI.conclusion: 研究建立了定量、可解释且物理上有界的基序层级，系统化了锂电池电解质设计中已确立的腈与醚化学，为超越传统骨架限制的电解质分子设计提供了结构性指导框架。

title: Claude-SpinDynamics: a cross-platform, dual-precision CPU/GPU micromagnetic simulator with native mumax3 script compatibility
summary: Quantitative spintronics increasingly depends on a handful of GPU micromagnetic codes, all of which require NVIDIA hardware and single precision throughout, leaving researchers without such hardware unable to run even the standard validation problems. We report Claude-SpinDynamics (Claude-SD), a new open source micromagnetic simulator with a cross platform C++20 core (Windows and Linux) and a Python interface that closes this gap: a complete CPU build, validated by the same test suite as the GPU path, runs every unit test and uMAG standard problem with no accelerator at all, alongside GPU builds offering both single and double precision, a choice of two demagnetization FFT backends, and natively implemented spin-orbit, spin-transfer, and Zhang-Li torques, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, and percell materials.Claude-SD natively interprets mumax3's .mx3 scripting language, so existing community scripts run unmodified; under matched conditions the two codes agree cell-by cell to single-precision round-off, and, together with mumax+ and OOMMF, to within 2% on the uMAG dynamic-switching standard problem, with MuMax-CO agreeing to mumax3 to float32 round-off on the same problem. Benchmarked head-to-head against these three codes, Claude-SD's single-precision build is the fastest solver on small and two-dimensional problems and remains competitive at the largest grid sizes, while its double-precision and dual-FFT-backend paths are unmatched among GPU micromagnetic codes. A GPU replicabatching extension further advances an entire ensemble of finite-temperature trajectories in a single kernel launch per step, giving one to two orders of magnitude of throughput over a per-trial loop while reproducing single-trajectory results to numerical round-off. The complete source is openly licensed and distributed with runnable example notebooks and documentation for independent reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Claude-SpinDynamics (Claude-SD)，一个开源微磁模拟器，采用跨平台C++20核心和Python接口，支持纯CPU构建，提供单双精度GPU选项、双退磁FFT后端，原生支持多种磁动力学效应，兼容mumax3脚本语言，经基准测试在多种问题上与现有代码高度一致且性能领先。
AI.motivation: 现有定量自旋电子学领域依赖少数GPU微磁代码（如mumax3），这些代码仅支持NVIDIA硬件和单精度计算，导致缺乏该硬件的研究者无法运行标准验证问题，存在硬件访问壁垒和精度限制。
AI.method: 开发Claude-SD：采用跨平台C++20核心（Windows和Linux）及Python接口；提供纯CPU构建（通过完整测试套件验证）和GPU构建（支持单双精度、两种退磁FFT后端）；原生实现自旋轨道、自旋转移、Zhang-Li力矩、DMI相互作用和逐单元材料；原生解释mumax3的.mx3脚本语言；支持GPU复制批处理扩展，单次核启动即可推进整组有限温度轨迹。
AI.result: Claude-SD与mumax3在匹配条件下逐单元格一致到单精度舍入误差；与mumax3、mumax+和OOMMF在uMAG动态切换标准问题上相差2%以内；单精度构建在小型和二维问题上最快，在大网格上也具竞争力；双精度和双FFT后端路径在GPU微磁代码中独一无二；GPU复制批处理扩展相比逐轨迹循环提升1-2个数量级吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: Claude-SD填补了微磁模拟的硬件可访问性缺口，提供完全开源、跨平台、多精度的高性能解决方案，与现有代码高度兼容且性能优越，为社区提供了独立可复现的研究工具。

title: Transport-Noise Witnesses of Electronic Multipartite Entanglement
summary: Entanglement among particles is a defining feature of strongly correlated quantum materials, distinguishing them from conventional metals and semiconductors. The ability to certify intrinsic entanglement among interacting electrons in solid-state materials is important not only for classifying quantum states of matter, but also for developing material-based quantum technologies. Here, we introduce a transport-based protocol for witnessing multipartite entangled electronic states, based on the equilibrium noise spectrum as an experimentally accessible observable. The appropriately integrated, symmetrized, and projected current noise obeys an upper bound that can be derived from microscopic model parameters and is invariant with respect to the choice of electronic basis. We benchmark this framework in several paradigmatic systems, including twisted bilayer graphene, twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$, and Hubbard models, certifying entanglement in the fractional Chern insulating state. The method extends recently developed scattering-based entanglement witnesses to ultralow-temperature materials, where conventional spectroscopic probes are inaccessible but candidate entangled states are expected to arise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于输运的协议，利用平衡噪声谱作为实验可观测的量来认证固态材料中多体纠缠电子态，并在扭曲双层石墨烯、MoTe₂和Hubbard模型等系统中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 认证固体材料中相互作用电子间的内在纠缠对于量子态分类和材料基量子技术开发至关重要，但传统光谱探针在超低温条件下不可用，需要新的认证方法。
AI.method: 提出基于平衡噪声谱的输运协议，通过对电流噪声进行适当积分、对称化和投影，得到一个可由微观模型参数推导出的上界，该上界对电子基矢的选择具有不变性，可作为纠缠见证。
AI.result: 在扭曲双层石墨烯、扭曲双层MoTe₂和Hubbard模型等多个范例系统中验证了该框架，成功认证了分数量子陈绝缘态中的纠缠，证明方法可扩展到超低温材料场景。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将散射基础的纠缠见证扩展到超低温材料体系，为候选纠缠态出现的极端条件下提供了可行的纠缠认证工具。

title: Observation of nonlocal ferron-drag thermoelectricity
summary: The Peltier effect induces a heat current when a charge current passes through a conductor. Since a charge current is conserved at the junction between two different conductors, the difference between the heat flowing in both conductors for the same charge current leads to heating or cooling of the interface, providing an operating mechanism of solid-state heat pumps. Here, we report observation of heat absorption and release signals even in a junction-free, homogeneous metal when placed in proximity to a ferroelectric insulator. Our experiments using active thermographic imaging techniques confirm the prediction of the ferron-drag effect, i.e., the nonlocal excitation of ferrons, the collective excitation of the ferroelectric order, by conduction electrons in the adjacent metal. We reveal the electric-polarization-direction dependence of the temperature change signals and their unexpected increase with the metal thickness beyond the charge screening length, uncovering additional electron-phonon-ferron interactions in the metal/ferroelectric hybrid structure. The discovery of crosstalk between metals and ferroelectrics via remote ferrons could become both a nuisance and an opportunity for highly integrated circuits with ferroelectric barrier materials and revolutionize the design architecture of thermoelectric devices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道在无结均匀金属中，当邻近铁电绝缘体时观测到热吸收和释放信号，证实了"铁子拖曳效应"（ferron-drag effect）——导电电子非局域激发邻近铁电体中铁电序的集体激发（ferrons）。研究通过主动热成像技术揭示了温度变化信号的电极化方向依赖性和随金属厚度增加而意外增大的现象，发现了金属/铁电混合结构中的额外电子-声子-铁子相互作用。
AI.motivation: 帕尔帖效应通过电荷守恒在异质结界面产生加热/冷却，是可作为固态热泵的机制。但传统帕尔帖效应依赖于结的存在。作者希望探索在无结均匀金属中是否也能通过邻近铁电体的铁子拖曳效应实现热吸收/释放，从而为热电装置设计提供新架构。
AI.method: 采用主动热成像技术，对邻近铁电绝缘体的无结均匀金属进行实验观测，测量热吸收和释放信号，并系统研究电极化方向及金属厚度对温度变化信号的影响。
AI.result: 成功观测到热吸收与释放信号，证实了铁子拖曳效应的预测；发现温度变化信号依赖于电极化方向，且信号随金属厚度增加而增大（超出电荷屏蔽长度），揭示了电子-声子-铁子间的额外相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 金属与铁电体之间通过远程铁子存在串扰效应，这对含铁电势垒材料的高集成度电路既是潜在问题也是机遇，有望革新热电装置的设计架构。

title: Giant Thermal Amplification via Engineered Dissipation in a Sierpiski-Gasket Aharonov-Bohm Interferometer
summary: We propose a three-terminal thermal amplifier based on a Sierpiski-gasket Aharonov-Bohm interferometer, where the third (base) terminal is realized as a floating Buttiker probe that acts as an engineered dissipative reservoir, exchanging energy with the conductor while carrying no net charge current. Using the nonequilibrium Green's function formalism, we demonstrate that the interplay of quantum coherence and engineered dissipation gives rise to giant, magnetic-flux-controlled thermal amplification, whereas purely coherent transport exhibits little or no amplification. We show that the amplification originates from a flux-induced cancellation of the energy-resolved thermal response of the base terminal, causing its differential heat current to vanish while finite heat currents continue to flow through the emitter and collector terminals. As a result, the thermal gain diverges without requiring resonant transmission. This interference-driven cancellation gives rise to an emergent thermal transparency, closely analogous to electromagnetically induced transparency in optical systems, where destructive quantum interference suppresses the thermal response of the base reservoir while maintaining finite heat transport through the remaining terminals. Our results establish the interplay of engineered dissipation and quantum interference as a powerful mechanism for controlling heat flow and realizing high-performance thermal amplifiers in mesoscopic conductors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Sierpiński-gasket Aharonov-Bohm干涉仪的三端热放大器，通过浮空Buttiker探针作为工程化耗散储层，利用量子相干与工程耗散的相互作用实现了磁通可控的巨大热放大效应。
AI.motivation: 纯粹相干输运的热放大效果有限，需要探索将量子干涉与工程耗散相结合的新机制来有效控制介观导体中的热流。
AI.method: 采用非平衡格林函数形式论，在三端热放大器中引入浮空Buttiker探针作为基极终端，该探针作为工程化耗散储层只交换能量而不携带净电荷电流，利用磁通诱导的能量分辨热响应抵消来实现热透明效应。
AI.result: 研究表明量子相干与工程耗散的相互作用能产生巨大的、磁通可控的热放大效应，而纯相干输运几乎无放大效果。热放大源于磁通诱导的基极终端能量分辨热响应抵消，使其微分热流消失，而发射极和集电极仍有有限热流，导致热增益发散。
AI.conclusion: 这种干涉驱动的抵消产生了与光学中电磁感应透明类似的热透明现象，证明了工程耗散与量子干涉的协同作用可作为控制介观导体热流、实现高性能热放大器的强大机制。

title: ChemReporter: A Framework for Curating and Exporting Large-Scale Chemical Datasets for MLIP Training
summary: Training set quality and diversity are key determinants of the reliability of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs), yet using massive datasets in full is often impractical and redundant, making intelligent data selection essential. A major bottleneck, however, is the lack of infrastructure for uniformly accessing, curating, and subsampling heterogeneous large-scale chemical datasets, which differ widely in structure, metadata, and file format. We address this gap with ChemReporter, a modular, method-agnostic framework that converts arbitrary molecular and materials datasets into a unified, queryable representation and exports the results directly into MLIP-ready training data. ChemReporter operates in three decoupled stages: processing, which parses raw datasets into a partitioned Apache Parquet repository enriched with structural, physical, and chemical metadata; querying, which filters and samples this repository via a CLI or Python API using arbitrary selection criteria, from simple physical constraints to custom, user-defined strategies; and exporting, which streams the selected subset into an HDF5 file ready for direct use in modern MLIP training frameworks. Throughout this process, every exported data point remains traceable to its original source entry, and dataset exports can be reliably reproduced given the same configuration and query database version. Because data is stored in a queryable, disk-backed format, ChemReporter can process datasets far larger than available memory, allowing it to scale to billion-structure datasets on standard compute infrastructure. ChemReporter is available on GitHub and PyPI under the Apache License 2.0.

AI.tldr: ChemReporter是一个模块化、方法无关的框架，用于将异构的分子和材料数据集统一为可查询的表示形式，并直接导出为MLIP（机器学习原子间势）就绪的训练数据。它通过三个解耦阶段（处理、查询、导出）工作，支持海量数据的可扩展筛选与采样，且保证数据可追溯性和可复现性。
AI.motivation: 训练集的质量和多样性是机器学习原子间势（MLIP）可靠性的关键决定因素，但大规模数据集往往庞大且冗余，直接全部使用不切实际。然而，异构化学数据集在结构、元数据和文件格式上差异极大，缺乏统一的访问、整理和子采样基础设施，这是智能数据选择的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: ChemReporter采用三个解耦阶段：1) 处理阶段——将原始数据集解析为带结构、物理和化学元数据的分区Apache Parquet仓库；2) 查询阶段——通过CLI或Python API，使用任意选择标准（从简单物理约束到自定义策略）过滤和采样仓库；3) 导出阶段——将选定子集流式导出为HDF5文件，可直接用于现代MLIP训练框架。数据存储于磁盘支持的格式，可处理超出内存规模的数十亿结构数据集。
AI.result: 每个导出的数据点均可追溯到原始源条目，数据集导出可在相同配置和查询数据库版本下可靠复现。框架可处理远大于可用内存的数据集，支持标准计算基础设施上的十亿级结构数据集。项目已在GitHub和PyPI上以Apache License 2.0发布。
AI.conclusion: ChemReporter填补了MLIP训练数据管理中统一数据访问基础设施的空白，为异构化学数据集的智能选择和高质量训练数据构建提供了可扩展、可复现且开源的解决方案。

title: Barium Hexaferrite Thin Films as a Scalable Magnetic-Insulator Platform for Proximity-Engineered Spintronics
summary: Rare-earth iron garnets, such as yttrium iron garnet (YIG) and thulium iron garnet (TmIG), are the benchmark magnetic insulators for spintronic and magnonic devices, but achieving usable perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) in these materials typically relies on substrate strain- engineering, requiring careful lattice-matching and specific growth conditions that constrain ma- terial accessibility. Here we establish sputter grown barium hexaferrite (BaFe12O19, BaM) as a magnetic-insulator alternative with strong intrinsic perpendicular anisotropy, requiring no strain engineering. X-ray diffraction, transmission electron microscopy and Raman spectroscopy confirm stoichiometric films with atomically smooth surfaces, while first-principles calculations corroborate a robust ferrimagnetic ground state. The films exhibit square out-of-plane hysteresis with a coercive field of nearly 0.1 T. Unlike rare-earth garnets, the perpendicular anisotropy in BaM is intrinsic to its magnetoplumbite crystal structure, arising independent of highly ordered strain. Interfaced with Pt and with exfoliated BiSbTeSe2 (BSTS), BaM induces proximity induced anomalous Hall trans- port, confirming efficient interfacial exchange coupling, while the BSTS/BaM heterostructure shows an additional Hall contribution suggestive of non-collinear interfacial spin textures. These results position BaM thin films as a scalable magnetic-insulator platform for spintronic and topological heterostructure devices beyond the constraints of garnet chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出溅射生长的钡铁氧体（BaFe12O19, BaM）作为磁性绝缘体替代方案，其具有无需应变工程的强本征垂直磁各向异性（PMA）。通过XRD、TEM、拉曼光谱及第一性原理计算验证了薄膜质量和铁磁基态，并展示其与Pt和拓扑绝缘体BSTS的界面耦合效应。
AI.motivation: 稀土铁石榴石（如YIG、TmIG）虽为自旋电子学和磁子学器件的基准磁性绝缘体，但其垂直磁各向异性依赖于衬底应变工程，需要严苛的晶格匹配和生长条件，限制了材料的可用性。因此需要寻找一种无需应变工程即可实现本征PMA的替代磁性绝缘体材料。
AI.method: 采用溅射法生长BaM薄膜；利用X射线衍射、透射电子显微镜和拉曼光谱表征薄膜结构；通过第一性原理计算验证铁磁基态的稳定性；制备Pt/BaM和BSTS/BaM异质结构，测量反常霍尔效应以评估界面交换耦合。
AI.result: BaM薄膜具有化学计量比和原子级光滑表面，呈铁磁基态；表现出方形面外磁滞回线，矫顽场约0.1 T；与Pt和BSTS界面均诱导出邻近效应相关的反常霍尔输运，BSTS/BaM异质结构还显示出可能源于非共线界面自旋织构的额外霍尔贡献。
AI.conclusion: BaM薄膜凭借其磁铅石晶体结构固有的垂直磁各向异性，成为一种可规模化、不受石榴石化学限制的磁性绝缘体平台，可应用于自旋电子学和拓扑异质结构器件。

title: Dimensionality Mismatch Enables Decoupled Heat and Charge Transport
summary: Decoupling heat and charge transport is a key challenge in thermoelectrics. Here, we identify a route to spatially separate phonon and carrier transport in quasi-one-dimensional materials through high-throughput screening of the Materials Project database. Representative Sn$_2$S$_3$ and SbTeI exhibit a strong-intrachain--weak-interchain bonding hierarchy that favors phonon propagation along the chains while suppressing transverse lattice heat transport. In contrast, transverse valence-band states provide effective interchain electronic coupling and relatively light hole transport. This mismatch between lattice and electronic transport dimensionalities produces an inverted thermal--electrical anisotropy. Across the screened candidates, interchain lattice thermal conductivity is strongly suppressed, whereas hole transport remains weakly anisotropic or even favors the interchain direction. For SbTeI, this decoupling yields a maximum $zT$ of approximately 2.1 near 900~K. These results establish dimensionality mismatch as a general strategy for decoupling phonon and carrier transport in thermoelectric materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过高通量筛选Materials Project数据库，在准一维材料中发现了一种空间分离声子与载流子输运的路径。代表性材料Sn₂S₃和SbTeI具有强链内-弱链间的键合层级，使声子沿链方向传播但抑制横向晶格热输运；而横向价带态提供有效的链间电子耦合和轻空穴输运。这种晶格与电子输运维度不匹配产生了反转的热-电各向异性，使SbTeI在900K附近实现约2.1的最大zT值。
AI.motivation: 热电材料中解耦热输运和电荷输运是核心挑战，传统策略难以同时优化电导率和低晶格热导率，需要寻找新的通用策略来实现二者的空间分离。
AI.method: 利用高通量筛选方法扫描Materials Project数据库中的准一维材料，通过分析键合层级（强链内-弱链间）来识别晶格热输运与电子输运维度不匹配的材料体系，并以Sn₂S₃和SbTeI为代表进行验证。
AI.result: 筛选出的材料中链间晶格热导率被强烈抑制，而空穴输运保持弱各向异性甚至倾向于链间方向。SbTeI在900K附近取得约2.1的最大zT值，展示了优异的解耦效果。
AI.conclusion: 维度不匹配（dimentionality mismatch）被确立为解耦声子与载流子输运的通用策略，为准一维热电材料的设计提供了新方向。

title: Field-controlled breaking and restoration of parity-time symmetry in Josephson interference
comment: Main text: 12 pages, 4 figures. Supplementary Information: 23 pages, 18 figures
summary: Symmetry plays a fundamental role in determining the phases and physical properties of quantum matter. Controlling symmetry in mesoscopic superconducting devices provides a route to reconfigure their phase-coherent transport. Here we demonstrate symmetry-selective Josephson interferometry in lateral NbTi/PtTe2/NbTi junctions by controlling the relative orientations of the current and magnetic field. From the supercurrent interference patterns, we construct a field-current symmetry map that identifies configurations exhibiting or violating the device-level parity (\mathcal{P}), time-reversal (\mathcal{T}) and their combined \mathcal{P}\mathcal{T} symmetry. In the absence of an in-plane field, the junction exhibits a symmetric Fraunhofer pattern. An in-plane field parallel to the current produces a pronounced side-lobe asymmetry, whereas reversing both the current and the complete magnetic-field configuration restores a generalized \mathcal{T} relation. Remarkably, orienting the in-plane field perpendicular to the current restores the \mathcal{P}\mathcal{T}-symmetric Fraunhofer response even at substantial field strengths. A microscopic model attributes this behavior to the interplay between disorder-induced potential variations and flux dipoles generated by in-plane-field Meissner focusing near the superconducting electrodes. Our results establish a reconfigurable Josephson interferometer in which the field-current geometry selects the symmetry operation being probed and switches the device between symmetry-broken and symmetry-restored interference states.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了在横向NbTi/PtTe2/NbTi约瑟夫森结中,通过控制电流和磁场方向的相对取向实现对称性选择性约瑟夫森干涉测量。研究发现平行于电流的面内磁场产生旁瓣不对称性,而垂直于电流的面内磁场恢复PT对称的夫琅禾费响应,建立了可重构的约瑟夫森干涉仪。
AI.motivation: 对称性在决定量子物质的相和物理性质方面起着基础性作用。作者希望通过在介观超导器件中控制对称性,来重新配置其相位相干输运性质。
AI.method: 在横向NbTi/PtTe2/NbTi结中,通过改变电流和磁场的相对取向(平行或垂直)进行约瑟夫森干涉测量,从超电流干涉图案构建场-流对称性图谱,并结合微观模型解释实验现象。
AI.result: 无面内磁场时呈现对称的夫琅禾费图案;面内磁场平行于电流时产生显著旁瓣不对称性;反转电流和完整磁场配置可恢复广义T关系;当面内磁场垂直于电流时,即使在强场下仍能恢复PT对称的夫琅禾费响应。
AI.conclusion: 建立了可重构的约瑟夫森干涉仪,其中场-流几何结构选择被探测的对称性操作,并在对称性破缺和对称性恢复的干涉态之间切换器件,可归因于无序诱导的势变化与面内磁场迈斯纳聚焦产生的磁通偶极子之间的相互作用。

title: Non-Equilibrium Instantaneous Approximation and Dipole Forbidden d-d Transitions
summary: Time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy provides direct access to pump-induced changes in the electronic structure of correlated materials, but its theoretical description generally requires computationally demanding two-time non-equilibrium calculations. We introduce an instantaneous approximation for pump-driven correlated systems, based on a separation between the rapid decay of the Green's functions in the relative time variable and their slower evolution in the average time. Combined with a one-shot dynamical mean-field construction at the Hubbard I level, the method incorporates the driven dynamics of the local correlated shell into the lattice Green's function while retaining momentum resolution. We also derive an effective coupling for nominally dipole-forbidden d-d excitations. It arises from a dipole-allowed d-p transition followed by p-d hybridization; beyond the instantaneous limit, the same process produces an energy-dependent vertex correction to the optical response. As a proof of principle, we apply the framework to paramagnetic and antiferromagnetic FePS3, using a density-functional theory derived tight-binding model together with a supercell unfolding procedure. The calculated momentum-resolved spectra reproduce the main qualitative features observed after excitation of the first and second d-d transitions in recent time-resolved photoemission experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种瞬时近似方法用于描述泵浦驱动的关联电子体系，结合单次动力学平均场（Hubbard I级别）构造，在保留动量分辨的同时将局域关联壳层的驱动动力学纳入晶格格林函数。方法应用于FePS3，成功再现了近期时间分辨光电子能谱实验的主要定性特征。
AI.motivation: 时间分辨和角分辨光电子能谱可以直接观测泵浦诱导的关联材料电子结构变化，但其理论描述通常需要计算量巨大的双时间非平衡计算，亟需更高效的近似方法。
AI.method: 基于格林函数在相对时间变量上的快速衰减与在平均时间上的缓慢演化的分离，提出瞬时近似；结合Hubbard I级别的单次动力学平均场构造，将局部关联壳层的驱动动力学纳入晶格格林函数，同时保留动量分辨率。此外推导了标称偶极禁戒的d-d激发的有效耦合，来源于偶极允许的d-p跃迁后跟随p-d杂化。
AI.result: 以顺磁和反铁磁FePS3为原理验证，使用基于密度泛函理论推导的紧束缚模型和超胞展开方法，计算得到的动量分辨谱再现了近期时间分辨光电子实验中第一和第二d-d跃迁激发后的主要定性特征。
AI.conclusion: 该瞬时近似方法为泵浦驱动关联体系的时间分辨光电子能谱提供了一种计算高效的描述途径，并揭示了d-d激发有效耦合的微观来源及其超越瞬时极限时的能量依赖顶点修正。

title: Electrode-tunable nonlocal Rashba-Edelstein effect and layer-selective chirality switch in WSe$_2$-intercalated bilayer graphene
summary: We show that intercalating a WSe$_2$ monolayer into bilayer graphene creates a synthetic bilayer graphene at the Fermi level, in which WSe$_2$-mediated wavefunction overlap hybridizes the two graphene layers, giving rise to states delocalized across both layers. Because the interlayer coupling is comparable in energy to the proximity-induced spin-orbit interaction, the resulting spintronic behavior goes beyond what is typically accessible in conventional single-interface proximity systems. A simple four-electrode device, with source and drain electrodes on both the top and bottom graphene layers, gives access to distinct regimes depending on which electrodes are activated. The most prominent feature is a nonlocal Rashba-Edelstein effect, activated via cross-layer source and drain electrodes, in which a charge current injected into one graphene layer generates a spin accumulation in the spatially separated opposite layer. This effect is robust to the twist angle modulation between graphene and WSe$_2$ and to the applied electric field, suggesting that a moderate degree of structural asymmetry along the vertical direction does not destroy it. In addition, activating the source and drain electrodes on either the top or bottom graphene layer reveals local Rashba-Edelstein signals of opposite sign in the two layers, thereby realizing a layer-selective chirality switch. This is a consequence of the hidden Rashba effect, which is present even when a net Rashba splitting is forbidden. Our results suggest new physical regimes and device architectures that could be useful for spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在 bilayer graphene 中嵌入 WSe2 单层，构建了一种位于费米能级附近的合成双层石墨烯结构。WSe2 介导的波函数重叠使两层石墨烯发生杂化，产生跨层离域态。由于层间耦合能量与邻近诱导的自旋-轨道相互作用相当，该系统展现出超越传统单界面邻近系统的自旋电子学行为。四电极器件可实现非局域 Rashba-Edelstein 效应（跨层自旋积累）和局域 Rashba-Edelstein 层选择性手性开关，且对扭转角和电场具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统单界面邻近系统（如 graphene/WSe2）中自旋-轨道耦合效应受限，难以实现更丰富的自旋电子学调控。作者希望通过在三层异质结构中插入 WSe2 单层，利用其对两层石墨烯的同时耦合作用，创造新的物理机制（如隐藏 Rashba 效应）和多功能器件架构。
AI.method: 将 WSe2 单层插入 bilayer graphene 之间形成三明治结构；通过四个电极（上下层各接源漏）来实现不同测量构型；基于第一性原理/理论计算分析层间耦合与邻近自旋-轨道相互作用的竞争关系，并研究扭转角和垂直电场对效应的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实现了非局域 Rashba-Edelstein 效应：在一层注入电荷电流可在另一层产生自旋积累，且对扭转角和电场鲁棒。同时实现了层选择性手性开关：在顶层或底层激活源漏电极时，两层分别产生相反符号的局域 Rashba-Edelstein 信号，该现象源于隐藏 Rashba 效应（即使净 Rashba 劈裂被禁止仍存在）。
AI.conclusion: 这种 WSe2 插层的双层石墨烯结构开辟了新的物理机制和器件架构，展示了跨层自旋调控的可能性，为自旋电子学应用提供了新思路。

title: Unravelling carbene moiety role in the N-heterocyclic carbene-phosphinidenes coordination chemistry: bonding and reactivity in gold chemistry
summary: The coordination properties of the emerging class of N-heterocyclic carbene-phosphinidene (NHCP) ligands have been reported to be strongly affected by the carbene (NHC) moiety, but a clear understanding remains strikingly limited. In this work the bonding features and reactivity of 13 NHCP gold hydride complexes, [NHCPAuH], bearing different classes of NHCs have been systematically explored and compared to carbene analogues, using an unbiased computational protocol. The analyses reveal that, although the $π$-acceptor ability trend of NHCPs qualitatively parallels that of NHCs, the $σ$-donor ability trend reverses, with more $σ$-donating NHC moieties generating less $σ$-donating NHCP ligands. Concurrently, the nature of the NHC moiety impacts the coordination geometry at the P center, with the CNHC-P-Au bond angle appearing as a structural descriptor to monitor and/or design NHCP ligands with desired $σ$-donor properties. The NHCPs stronger $σ$-donor and weaker $π$-acceptor abilities compared to NHCs and their unique structural flexibility and electronic adaptability have been showcased to be directly controlled by the carbene moiety via modulation of the HOMO lone pair energy and its atomic phosphorous 3p character. The reactivity of [NHCPAuH] complexes with CO2, taken as a probe for potential NHCP applications in small molecule activation processes, demonstrates qualitatively similar mechanisms, with remarkably different activation barriers, which directly correlate with the NHCPs $σ$-donor ability, thus reflecting the high tunability of their bonding properties. This work provides insights and perspectives on the design principle of NHCP ligands, with a spotlight on the pivotal role of NHC moiety in modulating their electronic and steric properties, offering opportunities for burgeoning applications across diverse fields.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统计算研究揭示了N-杂环卡宾-磷烯(NHCP)配体中NHC部分对配体配位性能和反应活性的关键调控作用，发现NHCP配体的σ-给电子能力与NHC部分呈反相关趋势，并提出了CNHC-P-Au键角作为设计和监测NHCP配体σ-给体性质的构象描述符。
AI.motivation: NHCP配体作为新兴配体类别，其配位性质已被报道受NHC部分强烈影响，但对其内在机理的理解仍十分有限，缺乏清晰的系统性认识。
AI.method: 采用无偏计算协议，系统探索并比较了13种负载不同类别NHC的[NHCPAuH]金氢配合物的成键特征与反应活性，并将其与对应的卡宾类似物进行对比分析。
AI.result: 发现NHCP配体的π-接受能力趋势与NHC定性平行，但σ-给体能力趋势反转；NHC部分通过调控HOMO孤对电子能量及其磷3p轨道特征，直接控制NHCP的σ-给体/π-受体能力、结构灵活性和电子适应性；与CO2反应表现出相似的机理但激活势垒差异显著，与σ-给体能力直接相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为NHCP配体的设计原则提供了深入见解，强调NHC部分在调节电子和位阻性质中的核心作用，为小分子活化等新兴应用领域开辟了机遇。

title: What makes a useful molecular model of biochar? A community roadmap
summary: Biochars are disordered carbonaceous materials produced by biomass pyrolysis, with applications spanning soil amendment, water remediation, carbon storage, and functional materials. Although they share structural features with other disordered carbons such as coal, kerogen, and activated carbons, the questions posed to biochar models are distinct, and no single model can answer all of them equally well. Model usefulness must be defined relative to a specific question and validated against independent experimental observables. This community roadmap, arising from a CECAM workshop, critically maps current molecular approaches: experimentally guided top-down reconstruction, mimetic bottom-up simulation, and hybrid methods. We argue that first-generation models have been more successful than is often acknowledged, provided they are built at sufficient length scale and with explicit control over microporosity and bulk chemistry. Structural and equilibrium interfacial properties are increasingly tractable with classical force fields, whereas dynamic and reactive behaviours require selective use of reactive methods within multiscale workflows. A parallel, largely unaddressed gap concerns the mineral and ash components of biochar, and the changes the material undergoes during ageing in soil. We identify seven open questions current models cannot yet answer reliably, and five community priorities: force field benchmarking, open model and data repositories, shared classification and metadata standards, ensemble validation, and training in reproducible practice. Across these, sustained interaction with experimentalists is essential to ground models in real observables and document where they fail. Progress will be accelerated by adapting transferable methods from coal, kerogen, and clay-organic matter frameworks rather than repeating trial-and-error development.

AI.tldr: 本文是来自CECAM研讨会的社区路线图，系统评估了生物炭的分子建模方法。文章将生物炭模型分为自顶向下重建、自底向上模拟和混合方法三类，指出第一代模型在足够长度尺度、明确控制微孔性和整体化学性质的前提下比通常认知的更成功。经典力场已能较好处理结构和平衡界面性质，而动态和反应行为需在多尺度工作流中选择性使用反应性方法。文章识别了七个模型尚无法可靠回答的开放问题，并提出五项社区优先事项：力场基准测试、开放模型与数据仓库、共享分类与元数据标准、集成验证和可复现实践培训。
AI.motivation: 生物炭作为一种无序碳质材料，在土壤改良、水修复、碳存储和功能材料等领域有广泛应用，但其分子建模面临独特挑战。现有模型往往从煤、干酪根和活性炭等体系借鉴方法，但生物炭的问题集与之不同，没有单一模型能同样好地回答所有问题。课题组需要通过建立社区共识，明确模型效用的定义标准和验证途径，以推动该领域从试错式发展转向系统性进步。
AI.method: 本文采用社区路线图方法，基于CECAM工作坊的集体讨论，对当前生物炭分子建模方法进行批判性梳理。方法学上划分为三条路径：实验引导的自顶向下重建（top-down reconstruction）、拟态自底向上模拟（mimetic bottom-up simulation）以及混合方法。文章强调模型须相对于特定问题定义其有效性，并通过独立实验观测量进行验证。同时提出借鉴煤、干酪根和黏土-有机物框架中可迁移的方法学。
AI.result: 文章发现：第一代生物炭模型在足够长度尺度和可控微孔性条件下比通常认知更成功；经典力场足以处理结构和平衡界面性质，而动态和反应行为需在多尺度工作流中选择性使用反应性方法。同时识别出模型尚无法可靠回答的七个开放问题（包括矿物和灰分组分、土壤老化过程中生物炭的变化等），并提出五项社区优先事项：力场基准测试、开放模型和数据仓库、共享分类与元数据标准、集成验证、可复现实践培训。
AI.conclusion: 生物炭建模的进展需要持续的实验-理论互动，将模型锚定在真实观测量上并记录其失败之处。通过从煤、干酪根和黏土-有机物框架中借鉴可迁移方法而非重复试错开发，可加速领域进步。矿物/灰分组分和土壤老化过程是当前最突出的未解决空白，需要社区层面的协作来系统应对。

title: Stability and optoelectronic properties of oligothiophene molecules confined in boron-nitride nanotubes : A many-body theoretical approach
summary: We investigate the structural and optoelectronic properties of oligothiophene (nT) molecules encapsulated in boron-nitride (BN) nanotubes using density functional theory, many-body GW and Bethe-Salpeter equation approaches. We show that the binding energy is maximized for tube diameters of approximately 10 Å, decreasing gradually for larger diameters. The nT molecules can slide along the tube with a corrugation potential smaller than room temperature thermal energy, promoting their head-to-tail aggregation. Regarding the electronic properties, we find that hybridization with the tube electronic states has a much smaller effect than that of screening, which can close the nT photoemission gap by as much as an eV. A simple model for the polarization of the BN tube demonstrates how these polarization effects decrease with increasing nT molecule length and BN tube diameter. Compared to the gas phase optical properties, structural relaxation, hybridization, and screening can redshift the absorption onset by up to 250 meV for isolated intercalated nTs. Additionally, the study of a head-to-tail sexithiophene dimer reveals an exciton-exciton interaction that splits the absorption onset into a lowest bright exciton, separated by approximately 75 meV from a dark peak. This suggests possible collective effects upon the formation of nT chains inside BN tubes. Our results confirm and clarify experimental data, mitigating the conclusion that insulating BN tubes just act as a protecting environment for encapsulated molecules.

AI.tldr: 本文通过密度泛函理论、GW和Bethe-Salpeter方程方法，系统研究了寡聚噻吩（nT）分子封装在氮化硼（BN）纳米管中的结构、电子和光学性质。研究发现管径约10 Å时结合能最大，分子可沿管滑动促进头尾聚集；筛选效应远大于杂化效应，可关闭nT光电子学隙达1 eV；光吸收红移可达250 meV，头尾二聚体中存在激子-激子相互作用导致吸收峰分裂约75 meV。
AI.motivation: 澄清BN纳米管是否仅作为封装分子的惰性保护环境，揭示管壁对封装分子电子和光学性质的实际影响。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）进行结构优化，结合多体GW近似和Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）方法计算电子结构和光学激子性质，并构建简单模型分析BN管的极化效应。
AI.result: 结合能对于约10 Å管径最大；管内滑动势垒低于室温热能；筛选效应可关闭nT光电子发射隙达1 eV；光吸收红移最高250 meV；头尾二聚体中存在约75 meV的亮/暗激子分裂。
AI.conclusion: BN纳米管并非只是惰性保护环境，其筛选和杂化效应显著改变了封装分子的电子和光学性质，并可能通过分子链聚集产生集体激子效应。

title: Proximity-induced superconductivity in a bilayer graphene quantum point contact
summary: We report the realization of a gate-defined quantum point contact (QPC) in bilayer graphene proximitized by a single aluminum superconducting electrode. Superconducting correlations induced in the ballistic channel enhance the conductance plateaus beyond their normal-state values. In addition, we observe a pronounced above-gap conductance anomaly which serves as a spectroscopic signature of the loss of superconductivity and the associated collapse of the Andreev excess current. By reconstructing the nonlinear current-voltage characteristics, we find that the magnitude of the excess current increases as successive QPC modes are populated. Additionally, we find that the switching current associated with the loss of superconductivity follows the underlying mode structure of the QPC, exhibiting discrete levels consistent with a heat dissipation-driven transition. These results demonstrate that the one-dimensional transport modes of the QPC govern both the equilibrium proximity effect and the non-equilibrium dynamics of the hybrid system.

AI.tldr: 本研究在双层石墨烯中实现了由铝超导电极邻近化的门控量子点接触（QPC），发现超导关联增强电导平台、观测到超导性丧失的谱学特征，并证明一维输运模式同时调控平衡邻近效应和非平衡动力学。
AI.motivation: 探索超导体与石墨烯量子点接触混合系统中，一维弹道输运模式如何影响超导邻近效应及非平衡超导开关动力学，填补该领域实验空白。
AI.method: 在双层石墨烯中构建门控QPC并采用单一铝超导电极邻近化；通过测量电导平台、重构非线性电流-电压特性，分析Andreev超额电流及超导开关电流随QPC模式填充的变化。
AI.result: 超导关联使电导平台超越常值；观测到带隙以上的电导异常（超导性丧失的谱学标志）；超额电流随QPC模式逐级增大；开关电流呈现离散量子化级别，符合热耗散驱动的转变机制。
AI.conclusion: QPC的一维输运模式同时支配混合系统的平衡邻近效应与非平衡动力学，为石墨烯基超导混合器件研究提供重要平台。

title: Non-invertible Lattice 1-Form Symmetries for Non-Abelian Topological Order
summary: Higher-form symmetries generalize conventional global symmetries and act on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a quantum system. While Abelian topological phases can be organized by 1-form symmetries that form a group, non-Abelian topological phases based on finite groups require 1-form symmetry operators governed by non-invertible fusion algebras. In this work, we make this statement precise in quantum double lattice models $\mathcal D(G)$ for finite non-Abelian groups $G$. We construct the electric, magnetic, and dyonic 1-form operators directly at the lattice fixed point and show that together they form a complete nonlocal diagnostic algebra for the topological Hilbert space. Using these operators, we explicitly determine the cylinder and torus ground-state subspaces for arbitrary finite $G$. Furthermore, we calculate the microscopic fusion and gluing of the 1-form symmetries and show that their topological deformation properties emerge after projection to the defect-free topological subspace. Our results establish ground states of non-Abelian quantum double models as a concrete microscopic realization of spontaneous non-invertible 1-form symmetry breaking and provide an operator language that may be useful for characterizing such states in quantum processors.

AI.tldr: 本文在有限非阿贝尔群G的量子双模型中构造了电、磁和dyonic的一形式算符，证明了它们构成完整的非局域诊断代数，并利用这些算符明确确定了任意有限G下圆柱面和环面上的基态子空间，建立了非阿贝尔拓扑相作为自发非可逆一形式对称性破缺的微观实现。
AI.motivation: 阿贝尔拓扑相可以通过形成群的1-形式对称性来组织，但基于有限群的非阿贝尔拓扑相需要由非可逆融合代数的1-形式对称性算符来描述。此前缺乏对非阿贝尔情形中这些对称性算符的精确构造和系统性研究。
AI.method: 在量子双格点模型D(G)（G为有限非阿贝尔群）中，直接在格点不动点构造电、磁和dyonic的1-形式算符。这些算符共同形成完整非局域诊断代数。利用这些算符显式确定圆柱面和环面上的基态子空间，并计算1-形式对称性的微观融合与胶合，证明其拓扑形变性质在投影到无缺陷拓扑子空间后涌现。
AI.result: 成功构造了非阿贝尔量子双模型中的非可逆1-形式对称性算符，显式确定了任意有限群G下圆柱面和环面的基态子空间，并计算了这些对称性的微观融合与胶合规则，验证了拓扑形变性质的涌现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了非阿贝尔量子双模型的基态是非可逆1-形式对称性自发破缺的具体微观实现，并提供了适用于量子处理器的算符语言来描述此类状态。

title: The Hodge structure of Berry-phase transport: topology, geometry, and noise
summary: We show that the Hodge-de Rham decomposition of the Berry curvature organises the transport of a Bloch band and its fluctuations within a single geometric structure. Splitting the curvature into $L^2$-orthogonal harmonic, exact, and co-exact sectors yields a dictionary for both moments of the current. In the mean response the harmonic sector carries the topological anomalous-Hall conductivity, the exact sector the Fermi-surface geometry and the antisymmetric Berry-curvature dipole of polar metals, and, in three dimensions, the co-exact sector the chiral anomaly, quantised by the Weyl-node charges. In the fluctuations, described by a particle-conserving stochastic Boltzmann equation constrained by the fluctuation-dissipation theorem (FDT), the harmonic sector is silent, so topological transport is noiseless, while the field-driven noise is sourced by the geometric sectors (solely the exact sector in two dimensions); current-noise spectroscopy therefore separates global band topology from local band geometry. We prove that the harmonic null-space protection is dimension-independent, and we settle the remaining sector: the co-exact (monopole) sector carries no conservation law and, under the thermal sampling measure, mixes with the exact sector at $\mathcal{O}(1)$, so it furnishes no clean noise observable. The separation the noise provides is therefore two-way, topology versus geometry, in both two and three dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Hodge-de Rham分解将Berry曲率分解为调和、精确和余精确三个L²正交扇区，系统性地组织布洛赫能带的输运性质及其涨落。调和扇区承载拓扑反常霍尔效应且完全无噪声，精确扇区承载费米面几何和Berry曲率偶极子，余精确扇区在三维中承载手征反常。研究表明电流噪声谱能够将全局拓扑与局域几何分离，实现二维和三维中的"拓扑对几何"双向分离。
AI.motivation: Berry曲率统一支配布洛赫能带的输运及其涨落行为，但不同物理效应（拓扑输运、费米面几何、手征反常、电流噪声）之间的内在结构关系尚不清晰，需要一种数学框架来系统性地分类和组织这些现象。
AI.method: 将Berry曲率进行Hodge-de Rham分解为L²-正交的三个扇区（调和、精确、余精确），建立各扇区与输运可观测量之间的对应词典；利用受涨落-耗散定理约束的粒子数守恒随机Boltzmann方程描述电流涨落，分析各扇区对噪声的贡献。
AI.result: 调和扇区主导拓扑反常霍尔电导且完全静默（无噪声贡献）；精确扇区贡献费米面几何与Berry曲率偶极子，是二维中唯一的噪声源；余精确扇区在三维中承载手征反常（由Weyl节点电荷量子化），但不满足守恒律，与精确扇区在O(1)阶混合，无法提供干净的噪声可观测量。调和零空间的保护在任意维度均成立。
AI.conclusion: Hodge-de Rham分解为Berry曲率驱动的输运提供统一组织结构，电流噪声谱学可以分离全局带拓扑与局域带几何，在二维和三维中均实现拓扑与几何的分离。余精确扇区因缺乏守恒律而不适合作为独立噪声可观测量。

title: Complete O(3) Interactions from Wigner-6j Recoupling to Local O(2) Frames
summary: Equivariant atomistic models commonly use either Clebsch Gordan tensor product(CGTP) or edge aligned SO(2) operationsCGTP support general O(3) representations but become expensive at high angular degree, while existing local SO(2) frame methods are designed for SO(3) or the natural-parity subset of O(3). They therefore do not provide a complete local representation when polar tensors and pseudotensors occur at the same time. In this work, we introduce a generalized Wigner-6j convolution for non-collinear magnetism, electric fields, and magnetic fields, providing a general convolution scheme under O(3) that can incorporate arbitrary node-wise equivariant features. We further develop a complete O(3) convolution framework based on local O(2) frames, reducing the computational complexity of CGTPs from O(L6) to O(L3). We establish the correspondence between global O(3) irreducible representations (irreps) and local O(2) irreps and use this correspondence to construct a closed operator system comprising O2Linear, O2TensorProduct, and O2Gate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于局部O(2)框架的完整O(3)等变卷积框架，通过广义Wigner-6j卷积支持任意节点等变特征，将计算复杂度从O(L⁶)降至O(L³)。
AI.motivation: 现有的等变原子模型存在两大局限：CGTP虽然支持一般O(3)表示但在高角动量下计算昂贵；已有的局部SO(2)框架方法仅针对SO(3)或O(3)的自然宇称子集设计，无法同时处理极张量和赝张量，因而缺乏完整的局部表示能力，特别是在非共线磁性、电场和磁场同时出现的场景下。
AI.method: 1) 引入广义Wigner-6j卷积，在O(3)下提供通用的卷积方案，可整合任意节点级等变特征；2) 基于局部O(2)框架建立完整的O(3)卷积框架，将CGTP的计算复杂度从O(L⁶)降至O(L³)；3) 建立全局O(3)不可约表示与局部O(2)不可约表示之间的对应关系；4) 基于该对应关系构建封闭的算子系统，包括O2Linear、O2TensorProduct和O2Gate三个算子。
AI.result: 论文提出并验证了完整的O(3)等变卷积框架，能够同时处理极张量和赝张量（覆盖非共线磁性、电场和磁场），并通过全局与局部不可约表示的对应关系实现了显著的复杂度降低。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了现有局部框架无法完整表示O(3)的空白，提供了一种既高效又通用的等变模型构建方案，为需要同时处理极张量和赝张量的物理系统（如磁性材料）建模提供了有力工具。

title: Intrinsic Defects in Amorphous Optical Coatings of TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$ for Gravitational-wave Detectors
summary: The increased laser power of future gravitational-wave detectors will require mirror coatings with optical absorption below 0.1 ppm per mirror.
