TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$, currently the best high-index material for reducing room-temperature coating thermal noise, still exhibits ppm-level absorption even after extrinsic contamination is minimized. Using ab-initio simulations and absorption measurements, we identify oxygen-deficient Ti-rich environments as the origin of this residual absorption. We find that ordinary structural disorder in the amorphous network can localize electronic states but does not produce defects capable of absorbing 1064-nm light. In contrast, oxygen vacancies in compact Ti-rich environments create localized Ti$^{3+}$--Ti$^{3+}$-like polaron-pair or mixed Ti-polaron states states with transitions near 1064 nm. Photothermal measurements show increased absorption after dry/inert annealing, supporting the formation of these reduction-sensitive defects. These results show that the residual absorption is not an intrinsic limitation of TiO$_2$-doped GeO$_2$, but a process-dependent defect that may be mitigated through control of oxygen stoichiometry during deposition and annealing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理模拟和吸收测量，揭示了未来引力波探测器镜面涂层（TiO₂掺杂GeO₂）残余吸收的微观起源：氧空位在致密富Ti环境中形成局域化的Ti³⁺-Ti³⁺极化子对或混合Ti极化子态，其跃迁恰在1064 nm附近。普通结构无序只会局域化电子态但不会产生能吸收1064 nm光的缺陷。干/惰性退火后吸收增加（光热测量证实）支持这些还原敏感性缺陷的形成。结论是残余吸收并非TiO₂掺杂GeO₂的固有局限，而是可通过控制氧化学计量来调控的工艺依赖型缺陷。
AI.motivation: 未来引力波探测器需要更高的激光功率，要求镜面涂层光吸收低于0.1 ppm/镜。TiO₂掺杂GeO₂是目前降低室温涂层热噪声的最佳高折射率材料，但即使在消除外在污染后仍存在ppm级吸收，其微观起源不明，需要从原子尺度理解并寻找缓解途径。
AI.method: 结合第一性原理（ab-initio）模拟与实验吸收测量。通过模拟非晶网络中的结构无序与氧空位缺陷，计算其电子态局域化及光学跃迁性质；同时采用光热测量方法表征不同退火条件下的吸收变化。
AI.result: 发现普通非晶结构无序仅局域化电子态但不产生可吸收1064 nm光的缺陷；而致密富Ti环境中的氧空位形成Ti³⁺-Ti³⁺极性子对态或混合Ti极化子态，其跃迁能量接近1064 nm。光热测量显示干/惰性（还原性）退火后吸收增加，支持该类还原敏感缺陷的形成。
AI.conclusion: TiO₂掺杂GeO₂的残余吸收并非材料固有的本征限制，而是由氧空位在富Ti环境中形成的工艺依赖型缺陷所致。可通过在沉积和退火过程中精确控制氧化学计量来缓解乃至消除这类缺陷，从而满足未来引力波探测器对超低吸收镜面涂层的需求。

title: Scarred discrete time crystal in a periodically driven dimerized spin chain
summary: We investigate the emergence of a scarred discrete time crystal (SDTC) phase in a periodically driven dimerized spin chain. While generic interacting Floquet systems are expected to thermalize according to the eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH), we demonstrate that this system hosts quantum many-body scars (QMBS) that induce a regime of weak ergodicity breaking. Through an analysis of Floquet level statistics, entanglement entropy, and eigenstate fidelity, we identify a manifold of low-entanglement states characterized by semi-Poisson statistics embedded within an otherwise thermal spectrum. These scarred states support robust subharmonic oscillations with period doubling, signaling the spontaneous breaking of discrete time-translation symmetry. We show that the SDTC response is robust against a variety of initial state configurations, demonstrating its stability beyond fine-tuned conditions. A finite-size scaling analysis reveals that the time-crystalline lifetime grows with system size within the range accessible to our exact-diagonalization calculations. However, drawing on the general phenomenology of approximate many-body scars, we expect that hybridization between Floquet scars and the thermal continuum will eventually curtail this growth, causing the lifetime to saturate at system sizes beyond our current numerical reach. This characterizes the SDTC as a long-lived metastable dynamical regime rather than a strictly stable thermodynamic phase, providing a comprehensive framework for understanding the interplay between periodic driving and constrained many-body dynamics in disorder-free systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究周期驱动的二聚化自旋链中疤痕离散时间晶体（SDTC）相的出现。尽管一般相互作用Floquet系统根据本征态热化假说（ETH）预期会热化，但该体系包含量子多体疤痕（QMBS），诱导弱遍历性破缺区域。通过Floquet能级统计、纠缠熵和本征态保真度分析，识别出低纠缠态流形（具有半Poisson统计），嵌入在热谱中。这些疤痕态支持周期加倍的稳健次谐振荡，表明离散时间平移对称性自发破缺。有限尺寸分析显示时间晶体寿命随系统尺寸增长，但预期与热连续谱杂交最终会使其饱和，将SDTC定性为长寿命亚稳态动力学而非严格稳定的热力学相。
AI.motivation: 探索在无无序的周期驱动系统中，量子多体疤痕能否实现弱遍历性破缺，并产生离散时间晶体（DTC）相。这为理解周期驱动与约束多体动力学之间的相互作用提供了新的视角，挑战了通用Floquet系统必然热化的传统认知。
AI.method: 采用精确对角化方法分析周期驱动的二聚化自旋链。通过Floquet能级统计（半Poisson统计）、纠缠熵和本征态保真度识别疤痕态流形，并研究不同初始态构型下的次谐振荡响应，辅以有限尺寸标度分析。
AI.result: 识别出低纠缠疤痕态流形，嵌入热谱中并表现出半Poisson统计。疤痕态支持稳健的周期倍增振荡，SDTC响应在不同初始态下均保持稳定。有限尺寸分析显示时间晶体寿命随尺寸增长，但预期在超出数值可达范围后因与热连续谱杂交而饱和。
AI.conclusion: SDTC被定性为长寿命亚稳态动力学体制而非严格稳定的热力学相。该工作提供了一个综合框架，用于理解周期驱动与约束多体动力学在无无序系统中的相互作用，扩展了弱遍历性破缺和时间晶体的研究边界。

title: Morphology-Guided Deterministic Fabrication of Low-Noise High-Temperature Superconducting Quantum Interference Devices
summary: Reproducible bicrystal high-temperature superconducting quantum interference devices remain limited by local variability along the grain boundaries that form the Josephson junctions. Here, we develop a site-selective fabrication workflow in which atomic force microscopy maps the intended junction region before lithography, quantifies an apparent grain-boundary width, rejects pore-rich segments, and writes a nearby registration mark for site-specific pattern alignment. The apparent grain-boundary width provides a practical morphology metric, with narrower regions consistently yielding larger critical currents and characteristic voltages. Iterative optimization within this workflow further improves junction and device performance, reaching a liquid-nitrogen-temperature field-noise level of 40 fT Hz^(-1/2). This strategy turns local grain-boundary heterogeneity from an uncontrolled source of variability into a basis for site-selective fabrication, providing a route towards scalable manufacturing of low-noise HTS SQUIDs with high uniformity.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种位点选择性制造工作流程，利用原子力显微镜在光刻前对高温超导晶界约瑟夫森结区域进行成像，量化表观晶界宽度并剔除富孔段，通过迭代优化实现了40 fT Hz^(-1/2)的液氮温度场噪声水平，将局部晶界异质性从变异性来源转变为可控制造的基础。
AI.motivation: 可重复的双晶高温超导量子干涉器件（SQUIDs）受限于形成约瑟夫森结的晶界局部变异性，这一非均匀性严重阻碍了器件的可扩展制造和性能一致性。
AI.method: 提出位点选择性制造工作流：(1) 光刻前使用原子力显微镜(AFM)绘制目标结区形貌；(2) 量化表观晶界宽度作为形态学指标；(3) 拒绝具有富孔（pore-rich）的晶界段；(4) 写入邻近对准标记用于位点特异性图案对准；(5) 在此框架内进行迭代优化以提升结和器件性能。
AI.result: 表观晶界宽度是实用的形态学度量指标，较窄的区域一致地产生较大的临界电流和特征电压。通过工作流内的迭代优化，在液氮温度下实现了40 fT Hz^(-1/2)的场噪声水平。
AI.conclusion: 该策略将局部晶界异质性从不可控的变异性来源转化为位点选择性制造的基础，为高性能、高均一性的低噪声HTS SQUIDs可扩展制造提供了可行路径。

title: Hydrogen (deuterium) dynamics and thermal stability in ion-irradiated platinum-hydride thin films synthesized at low temperature
comment: 35 pages, 6 figures, 1 table, including supplementary material
summary: Hydrogen (H) and deuterium (D) interactions with transition metals play a central role in heterogeneous catalysis and hydrogen-related technologies. While H-Pt surface interactions have been extensively studied, direct investigations of hydrogen incorporation and transport in Pt remain limited due to its low solubility. Here, we study H(D) incorporation and desorption dynamics in metastable $PtH(D)_x$ thin films prepared by low-energy ion irradiation, enabling hydrogen loading far above equilibrium concentrations. Nuclear reaction analysis (NRA) reveals a nonuniform hydrogen depth profile with two accumulation regions: the subsurface and the film-substrate interface. Thermal desorption spectroscopy (TDS) exhibits two desorption peaks near 190 and 230 K, consistent with hydrogen release from these sites. Resistance relaxation measurements, analyzed within a two-parallel-channel conduction model, indicate different relaxation kinetics for subsurface and near-interface hydrogen. Arrhenius analysis reveals two thermally activated processes for $PtH_x$ with an average hydrogen concentration of $x = 0.15$, with activation energies of $130 \pm 18$ meV (subsurface) and $164 \pm 26$ meV (near interface). Above 140 K, D exhibits slower relaxation rates with activation energies of $117 \pm 8$ and $121 \pm 7$ meV for $PtD_x$ prepared under the same implantation dose. Within experimental uncertainty, the activation barriers remain comparable, while the prefactors are reduced significantly for D, indicating isotope-dependent attempt frequencies and zero-point energy effects. TDS simulations based on the Polanyi-Wigner formalism reproduce the experimental desorption spectra by resolving subsurface and near-interface contributions, in agreement with the NRA profile. These findings provide insight into hydrogen kinetics in $PtH_x$ for Pt-based catalysis, sensing, and hydrogen-metal interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过低能离子辐照制备亚稳态PtH(D)_x薄膜，系统研究了氢在Pt中的掺入与脱附动力学。NRA显示氢在次表面和膜-基底界面两处累积，TDS在190和230K出现两个脱附峰。电阻弛豫分析揭示了两个热激活过程，H的激活能分别为130±18 meV（次表面）和164±26 meV（近界面），而D表现出明显降低的前因子，归因于同位素相关的尝试频率和零点能效应。
AI.motivation: Pt与氢的相互作用在异相催化和氢能技术中至关重要，但Pt中氢的溶解度和掺入动力学研究非常有限。由于Pt对氢的溶解度低，直接研究氢的掺入和输运困难，需要开发能实现远超平衡浓度氢负载的方法，以揭示氢在Pt中的动力学行为。
AI.method: 1) 利用低能离子辐照制备亚稳态PtH(D)_x薄膜，实现远超平衡浓度的氢负载；2) 采用核反应分析(NRA)表征氢深度分布；3) 使用热脱附谱(TDS)研究脱附动力学；4) 通过电阻弛豫测量结合双平行通道导电模型分析弛豫动力学；5) 基于Arrhenius分析提取激活能；6) 利用Polanyi-Wigner形式进行TDS模拟验证实验数据。
AI.result: NRA揭示氢在次表面和膜-基底界面两个区域的非均匀分布；TDS显示190K和230K两个脱附峰。PtH_x (x=0.15)的激活能分别为130±18 meV（次表面）和164±26 meV（近界面）。PtD_x的激活能为117±8和121±7 meV，激活壁垒在实验误差内可比，但D的前因子显著降低，表明同位素依赖的尝试频率和零点能效应。Polanyi-Wigner模拟成功复现实验脱附谱。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次系统揭示了Pt中亚稳态高浓度氢的掺入与脱附动力学，确认氢在次表面和近界面两处的累积与不同动力学行为。同位素效应的发现表明零点能效应对氢-金属相互作用有重要影响。这些发现为Pt基催化、传感和氢-金属相互作用领域提供了重要的动力学见解。

title: Resolving the Magnetic Ground State and Field-Induced Transitions in Magnetic Dirac Semimetal Candidate EuMnSb$_2$
summary: The magnetic structure of a magnetic topological semimetal EuMnSb$_2$ is investigated in fields up to 30 T using polarized and unpolarized neutron diffraction, pulsed-field x-ray magnetic circular dichroism and pulsed-field magnetometry. We determine the zero-field magnetic structures of the Eu and Mn sublattices, and find that magnetic transitions induced by applied fields below 2 T correspond to changes in the magnetic order of the Eu spins alone without detectable perturbation to the order of the Mn spins. An additional magnetic transition is observed at fields close to the saturation field for the Eu spins. We present a mean-field model which describes key features of the magnetic behavior and allows us to estimate the dominant Eu--Eu and Eu--Mn exchange interactions responsible for the coupling between magnetism and electronic topology.

AI.tldr: 本文利用极化与非极化中子衍射、脉冲场X射线磁圆二色和脉冲场磁强计，在高达30T的磁场下研究了磁性拓扑半金属EuMnSb₂的磁结构。确定了Eu和Mn子晶格的零场磁结构，发现2T以下的磁场诱导磁相变仅涉及Eu自旋的磁序变化，而Mn自旋序不受扰动。在接近Eu自旋饱和场处观察到额外的磁转变。提出了平均场模型，描述关键磁行为并估算主导的Eu-Eu和Eu-Mn交换相互作用，这些相互作用负责磁性与电子拓扑之间的耦合。
AI.motivation: 理解磁性拓扑半金属中磁结构与电子拓扑之间的耦合机制，特别是EuMnSb₂中磁性对拓扑电子性质的调控作用，这对拓扑材料的研究和应用具有重要意义。
AI.method: 综合运用多种实验手段：极化与非极化中子衍射（确定零场及场诱导磁结构）、脉冲场X射线磁圆二色（探测元素特异性磁响应）、脉冲场磁强计（测量宏观磁化行为），并结合平均场模型进行理论分析，定量估算Eu-Eu和Eu-Mn交换相互作用。
AI.result: 确定了EuMnSb₂中Eu和Mn子晶格的零场磁结构；发现2T以下磁场诱导的磁转变仅改变Eu自旋的磁序，Mn自旋序保持稳定；在高场接近Eu饱和场附近观察到额外的磁转变；平均场模型成功描述了关键磁行为并估算出主导的Eu-Eu和Eu-Mn交换相互作用强度。
AI.conclusion: EuMnSb₂中Eu与Mn子晶格表现出解耦的磁行为，Eu自旋序在低场下容易响应磁场变化，而Mn自旋序相对稳定。通过平均场模型量化了Eu-Eu与Eu-Mn间的交换耦合，揭示这些磁性相互作用是连接磁性与电子拓扑性质的关键桥梁，为调控磁性拓扑材料的电子结构提供了理论依据。

title: Electrically Switchable Spintronics in a Multiferroic Altermagnet
summary: We introduce a minimal model of a two-dimensional lattice that, upon spontaneous symmetry breaking, simultaneously develops altermagnetic order, a finite electric polarization, and a spin-polarized transport response, all of which are controlled by an external electric field. By coupling a dimerized altermagnet to an external electric field, we show that the three order parameters are not merely compatible but dynamically entangled, so that switching one (for instance, reversing the polarization with an electric field) necessarily reconfigures the other two. We show that this model offers a clear physical blueprint for designing next-generation spintronic logic and pure spin current memdevices that merge the ultrafast, stray-field-free advantages of compensated magnets with the low-power switching architectures of ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个二维晶格的最小模型，通过自发对称性破缺同时产生交错磁有序、有限电极化和自旋极化输运响应，三者均由外电场控制，且相互动态纠缠，为设计下一代自旋电子逻辑和纯自旋电流存储器件提供了蓝图。
AI.motivation: 作者希望将交错磁体（交磁体）的快速、无杂散场优势与铁电体的低功耗开关架构相结合，探索一种能同时调控磁性、极化和输运响应的新型材料平台，以克服传统自旋电子学器件在功耗和速度上的瓶颈。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个二维二聚化交错磁体的最小晶格模型，通过将二聚化交错磁体与外电场耦合，分析自发对称性破缺后各有序参量（交错磁序、电极化、自旋极化输运）之间的相互关系，并利用电场作为外部控制手段来切换这些有序参量。
AI.result: 研究表明这三个有序参量不仅是相容的，而且是动态纠缠的——切换其中任何一个（例如用电场反转极化）必然重新配置另外两个。该模型提供了将补偿磁体的超快、无杂散场优势与铁电体的低功耗开关架构融合的设计蓝图。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为设计下一代自旋电子逻辑器件和纯自旋电流存储器件（memdevices）提供了清晰的理论蓝图，有望实现超快、低功耗且无杂散场的自旋电子学应用。

title: Individual Vanadium Dopants Form Deep In-Gap States in Monolayer WS2
summary: Point defects in atomically thin materials have a strong impact on physical properties and those that induce in-gap states are advantageous for quantum information science and engineering (QISE). However, dopant engineering consisting of well-controlled synthesis and robust identification of in-gap states is challenging. In this work, we addressed this challenge by first using finely tuned chemical vapor deposition to incorporate vanadium dopants into a monolayer WS2 (V-WS2). Next, we utilized a suite of scanned probe microscopy techniques to identify and characterize individual dopants. The latter included conductive atomic force microscopy (cAFM), low temperature scanning tunneling microscopy and spectroscopy (STM/STS), and scanning transmission electron microscopy and unambiguously revealed that vanadium dopants form deep in-gap states 0.35 eV above the valence band maximum in V-WS2. Our experimental results are well supported by first principles calculations and taken together demonstrate that V-WS2 is a promising platform for QISE applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过精细调控化学气相沉积将钒掺杂剂引入单层WS2中，并利用多种扫描探针显微镜技术（cAFM、低温STM/STS、STEM）鉴定出钒掺杂剂在价带顶上方0.35 eV处形成深的带隙内态，实验与第一性原理计算一致，证明V-WS2是量子信息科学与工程应用的理想平台。
AI.motivation: 原子级薄材料中的点缺陷对物理性质有强烈影响，那些能诱导带隙内态的缺陷对量子信息科学与工程（QISE）非常有利。然而，掺杂工程面临两大挑战：可控的合成方法以及带隙内态的可靠鉴定。
AI.method: 首先使用精细调谐的化学气相沉积（CVD）将钒掺杂剂掺入单层WS2（V-WS2）；随后利用一套扫描探针显微镜技术，包括导电原子力显微镜（cAFM）、低温扫描隧道显微镜/谱（STM/STS）和扫描透射电子显微镜（STEM）来鉴定和表征单个掺杂剂；最后辅以第一性原理计算进行验证。
AI.result: 多种扫描探针技术明确揭示钒掺杂剂在V-WS2中形成深带隙内态，位于价带最大值上方0.35 eV处，实验结果与第一性原理计算高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 实验与理论相结合证明V-WS2是一个有前景的量子信息科学与工程应用平台。

title: Chiral Damping-Induced Chirality Switching and Control of Domain Walls in Antiferromagnets
summary: We investigate the impact of chiral damping (CD) on current-driven domain-wall (DW) dynamics in antiferromagnets (AFMs). Asymmetric CD between sublattices generates off-diagonal components in the DW mass tensor, thereby coupling translational and rotational modes. When CD is modulated by an ac gate voltage via the Rashba spin-orbit interaction (RSOI), symmetric and asymmetric contributions induce oscillations in the DW velocity and tilt angle, respectively. A perturbative analysis yields explicit expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, in quantitative agreement with numerical simulations. Remarkably, even in the absence of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction (DMI), asymmetric CD enables chirality switching between Néel- and Bloch-type DWs. Finally, by exploiting the relativistic Lorentz contraction of the DW width at high driving currents, we propose an experimentally viable protocol to qualitatively and quantitatively extract the CD contribution. These results establish clear experimental signatures of CD in antiferromagnetic DW dynamics and demonstrate its potential as a control parameter for magnetic textures.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了手性阻尼（CD）对反铁磁（AFM）中电流驱动畴壁（DW）动力学的影响。研究发现，子晶格间的不对称CD会在DW质量张量中产生非对角分量，从而耦合平动和转动模式。利用Rashba自旋轨道耦合通过交流门电压调制CD时，对称和不对称贡献分别诱导DW速度和倾斜角的振荡。即使在无DMI情况下，不对称CD也能实现Néel型和Bloch型DW之间的手性切换。此外，利用高驱动电流下DW宽度的相对论洛伦兹收缩效应，提出了实验上可行的方案来定性和定量提取CD贡献。
AI.motivation: 手性阻尼作为磁性材料中重要的耗散机制，其对反铁磁畴壁动力学的影响尚未被充分理解。理解CD对磁织构的作用不仅有助于揭示基础物理机制，还能为磁性器件的调控提供新的控制参数。
AI.method: 采用微扰分析方法推导振荡振幅的解析表达式，并结合数值模拟进行定量验证。通过调节Rashba自旋轨道耦合相关的交流门电压来调制CD，分析对称和不对称CD贡献对DW速度和倾斜角振荡的影响。利用相对论洛伦兹收缩效应设计实验提取CD的方案。
AI.result: 解析表达式与数值模拟结果定量一致。发现不对称CD即使在无DMI条件下也能实现Néel-Bloch型DW的手性切换，并提出了利用高驱动电流下DW宽度洛伦兹收缩来提取CD的实验方案。
AI.conclusion: 该研究确立了CD在反铁磁DW动力学中的明确实验特征，展示了CD作为磁织构控制参数的潜力，为后续实验验证和器件应用提供了理论基础。

title: Intrinsic Wannier Functions for Hamiltonian downfolding
summary: Downfolding ab initio material band structure into a low-energy subspace spanned by orbitals of specified atomic character, a procedure known as Wannier downfolding, is a common task in the simulation of complex materials. We introduce the Intrinsic Wannier Function (IWF) method to Wannierize bands with given atomic character. The method is non-iterative and requires only a single dimensionless parameter to disentangle bands. In benchmarks on silicon, graphene, and the three-band model of a mercury cuprate, we show that Intrinsic Wannier Functions provide high quality downfolded band structures compared to those from standard approaches such as Maximally Localized Wannier Functions and the Selected Columns of the Density Matrix method. Further, their straightforward implementation and robustness positions Intrinsic Wannier Functions as a general and useful tool for Wannier downfolding in materials electronic structure and in high-throughput applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Intrinsic Wannier Function (IWF)的新方法，用于将材料的能带结构降折叠到由指定原子特征轨道张成的低能子空间中。该方法是非迭代的，仅需一个无量纲参数即可解纠缠能带，并在硅、石墨烯和水银铜酸盐三带模型等基准测试中展示了高质量结果。
AI.motivation: Wannier downfolding（将第一性原理材料能带结构降折叠到由特定原子特征轨道张成的低能子空间）是复杂材料模拟中的常见任务，但现有方法（如MLWF和SCDM）在实现和稳健性方面存在不足，需要更通用和简便的工具。
AI.method: 提出Intrinsic Wannier Function (IWF)方法，该方法是非迭代的，仅需要单个无量纲参数即可实现能带的解纠缠（disentangle），从而实现对具有指定原子特征的能带进行Wannier化。
AI.result: 在硅、石墨烯以及汞铜酸盐三带模型上的基准测试表明，IWF方法相比MLWF和SCDM等标准方法，能够提供高质量的降折叠能带结构，且实现简单、稳健性好。
AI.conclusion: IWF方法因其简单实现和稳健性，可作为Wannier降折叠的通用有用工具，特别适用于材料电子结构计算和高通量应用。

title: Helical Magnon Frequency Comb in Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmion Lattices
summary: Synthetic antiferromagnetic skyrmion lattices (SAF-SkLs), consisting of two ferromagnetic SkLs coupled antiferromagnetically with compensated magnetization, provide a promising platform for robust nonlinear magnonics. Here, we investigate helical magnon frequency comb (HMFC) generation in a SAF-SkL by combining analytical modeling with micromagnetic simulations. We show that nonlinear coupling between helical magnon edge states and the skyrmion gyration produces frequency combs with pronounced edge localization. The HMFC exhibits strong enhancement exclusively when the driving frequency lies within the helical edge-state band, whereas the interior response remains negligible. This frequency selectivity confirms the essential role of helical edge modes in localized nonlinear frequency conversion. We further demonstrate that the interlayer antiferromagnetic coupling reconstructs the magnon spectrum, thereby tuning the comb spacing and the number of comb teeth while also redistributing modal energy. Our results establish SAF-SkLs as a tunable platform for edge-localized HMFCs and suggest a route toward robust coherent magnonic signal processing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了合成反铁磁斯格明子晶格（SAF-SkLs）中螺旋磁振子频率梳（HMFC）的产生机制，结合解析建模与微磁模拟，揭示了螺旋磁振子边缘态与斯格明子陀螺运动之间的非线性耦合可产生具有显著边缘局域化的频率梳，并通过层间反铁磁耦合实现频率梳间距与齿数的可调性。
AI.motivation: 合成反铁磁斯格明子晶格具有磁化补偿和结构稳定性的优势，被认为是实现鲁棒非线性磁振子学的理想平台。探索其边缘态相关的非线性频率转换机制，对于发展相干磁振子信号处理具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用解析建模与微磁模拟相结合的方法，研究SAF-SkL中螺旋磁振子频率梳的产生。通过分析螺旋边缘态与斯格明子回旋运动的非线性耦合，并考察层间反铁磁耦合对磁振子能谱的重构效应。
AI.result: 研究发现HMFC具有显著的边缘局域化特征；当驱动频率处于螺旋边缘态能带内时，频率梳响应显著增强，而内部响应可忽略；层间反铁磁耦合可重构磁振子谱，从而调控频率梳间距、梳齿数量及模态能量分布。
AI.conclusion: SAF-SkLs可作为边缘局域化HMFC的可调谐平台，为鲁棒相干磁振子信号处理提供了新途径。

title: Graph neural network prediction of temperature-dependent hydrogen diffusion and thermal conductivity tensors of tungsten containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries
summary: Helium bubbles and grain boundaries in tungsten plasma-facing components alter hydrogen-isotope transport and thermal conduction by orders of magnitude, yet evaluating these transport properties for a given microstructure requires hours of molecular dynamics (MD) per configuration. We present a graph neural network surrogate that maps a tungsten atomic configuration containing helium bubbles and grain boundaries directly to the full $3\times3$ symmetric tensors of the hydrogen diffusion coefficient $D_H(T)$ and the thermal conductivity $κ(T)$ at arbitrary temperature. Anisotropy is captured by a rotation-equivariant tensor pooling layer; temperature enters through predicted temperature-independent parameters (an Arrhenius pair $(D_0,E_a)$, a phonon conductivity tensor, and a defect residual resistivity) expanded analytically via the Arrhenius and Wiedemann-Franz-Matthiessen relations. Training labels for 635 microstructures are generated with an embedded-atom-method potential (Green-Kubo conductivity and multi-temperature tracer diffusion); the electronic channel is calibrated against published irradiation-degradation measurements, and the pipeline is anchored to a first-principles machine-learning potential (VASP+FLARE) through paired MD calibration runs and an active-learning loop. The learned activation energies (median 0.21 eV, rising in bubble and grain-boundary structures) reproduce literature hydrogen migration barriers and trapping physics, and the equivariant pooling keeps predictions consistent across arbitrarily oriented sub-blocks. Coupled finite-element thermal-hydrogen analyses driven by the surrogate show that conductivity degradation changes predicted hydrogen permeation by a factor of 2.5 through the temperature field. The model returns both tensors in milliseconds, enabling microstructure-resolved transport input for component-scale analyses of fusion divertors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种图神经网络代理模型，可将含氦泡和晶界的钨原子构型直接映射为氢扩散系数张量和热导率张量（任意温度下），预测速度达毫秒级，显著优于需数小时的分子动力学模拟。
AI.motivation: 钨面向等离子体部件中的氦泡和晶界会使氢同位素输运和热传导性能改变数个数量级，但评估这些输运性质需要每个构型进行数小时的分子动力学模拟，计算成本极高，难以支撑组件级分析。
AI.method: 采用图神经网络代理模型，通过旋转等变张量池化层捕获各向异性；温度通过预测与温度无关的参数（Arrhenius对、声子导率张量、缺陷剩余电阻率）并结合Arrhenius和Wiedemann-Franz-Matthiessen关系解析展开。635个微观结构的训练标签由嵌入原子法势生成（Green-Kubo导率和多温度示踪扩散），电子通道经辐照退化实验校准，并通过VASP+FLARE第一性原理机器学习势和主动学习循环锚定。
AI.result: 学习到的激活能（中位数0.21 eV，在含氦泡和晶界结构中升高）重现了文献中的氢迁移势垒和俘获物理；等变池化保证任意定向子块预测一致性。耦合有限元热-氢分析显示，导率退化通过温度场使氢渗透预测改变2.5倍。模型可在毫秒内返回两个张量。
AI.conclusion: 该代理模型实现了从微观结构到输运张量的快速映射，为聚变偏滤器组件级分析提供了微观结构分辨的输运输入，弥合了原子尺度模拟与工程尺度分析之间的差距。

title: Tunable Fano Resonance and Frequency Locking in a Graphene-SiNx Hybrid Nanomechanical Resonator
summary: Fano resonances, arising from the interference between discrete and continuum states, are observed across a wide range of quantum and classical systems. Here, we report the experimental observation of Fano resonances in a graphene SiNx hybrid nanomechanical system modeled as coupled oscillators. The broad, low quality factor graphene mode plays the role of the continuum, while the dense comb of sharp, high quality factor SiNx modes provides the discrete states. The inter-mode detuning is tunable via a DC gate voltage, enabling dynamic control of the Fano resonance: we demonstrate gate controlled switching of both the sign and the magnitude of the Fano asymmetry parameter $q$, in quantitative agreement with a coupled oscillator theory that predicts $q=-\cotφ$, with $φ$ the phase of the continuum response. At strong drive, the graphene mode enters the Duffing regime and its jump-down frequency locks to successive SiNx modes, producing a staircase of drive insensitive frequency plateaus; a weak seeding tone deterministically switches the resonator between adjacent locked states. The dense SiNx mode thus acts, in the linear regime, as the discrete states of a tunable Fano interferometer and, in the nonlinear regime, as a frequency ruler that stabilizes and quantizes the graphene oscillation. This platform offers a controllable mechanical realization of Fano interference and opens new avenues for high resolution hybrid resonant sensors and stable nanomechanical frequency references.

AI.tldr: 本文在石墨烯-SiNx混合纳米机械系统中实验观测到Fano共振现象，通过DC门电压可动态调控Fano不对称参数q的符号和大小，并在强驱动下实现频率阶梯锁定，为高分辨率混合谐振传感器和稳定纳米机械频率参考开辟了新途径。
AI.motivation: Fano共振源于离散态与连续态的干涉，在量子与经典系统中广泛存在，但在混合纳米机械系统中实现可控的Fano共振实验观测仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 构建石墨烯-SiNx混合纳米机械系统：宽的低品质因子石墨烯模式作为连续态，密集的高品质因子SiNx模式梳作为离散态；通过DC门电压调节模间失谐，实现在线性和非线性（Duffing）区域对Fano共振的动态控制。
AI.result: 实验实现了门电压控制的Fano不对称参数q的符号与大小切换，与耦合振子理论q=−cotφ定量吻合；强驱动下石墨烯进入Duffing区域，跳降频率锁定到连续SiNx模式，形成驱动器不敏感的阶梯频率平台，弱种子音调可在相邻锁定态间确定性切换。
AI.conclusion: 该平台提供了可控的Fano干涉机械实现：线性区作为可调Fano干涉仪，非线性区作为频率标尺稳定并量化石墨烯振荡，为高分辨率混合谐振传感和稳定纳米机械频率参考提供了新可能性。

title: Uncovering the deformation mechanism of glasses during indentation through high-resolution X-ray scattering
summary: Indentation experiments can be used to mimic real-life damage events of glasses that lead to surface flaws and thus lower practical strength. Conventional indentation studies often focus on the surface deformation after unloading. However, to understand the link between the surface deformation and structure, it is crucial to characterize the sub-surface deformation during the indentation process. The indentation-induced deformation, consisting of both elastic and plastic zones, is governed by the glass composition and structure, indentation and atmospheric conditions, and stress state. However, only a few experimental methods exist for characterizing the sub-surface indentation deformation mechanism during indentation. In this study, we use synchrotron X-ray nanoscattering to probe the deformation mechanism in situ during indentation of four types of oxide and oxynitride glasses with distinct structural features. This is done by measuring the variation in the position and intensity of the first sharp diffraction peak of the X-ray structure factor with a high spatial resolution down to ~100 nm. We find that the deformation zones of these glasses, which are characterized by the shape, size, and relative contribution between densification and shear flow under different indentation loads, vary with Poisson's ratio. Thus, our work provides new insights into the mechanical behavior of oxide glasses, contributing to the design of more damage-resistant glasses.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用同步辐射X射线纳米散射原位表征四种氧化物及氮氧化物玻璃在压痕过程中的亚表面变形机制，通过测量第一尖锐衍射峰的位置和强度变化（空间分辨率约100 nm），揭示了变形区形状、尺寸及致密化与剪切流动的相对贡献随泊松比的变化规律，为设计更具抗损伤性的玻璃提供了新见解。
AI.motivation: 压痕实验可模拟玻璃真实损伤事件，但传统研究仅关注卸载后的表面变形，缺乏对压痕过程中亚表面变形的实验表征方法。理解表面变形与结构之间的联系需要原位表征亚表面变形，这对设计抗损伤玻璃至关重要。
AI.method: 采用同步辐射X射线纳米散射技术，对四种具有不同结构特征的氧化物和氮氧化物玻璃进行压痕过程中的原位表征。通过测量X射线结构因子第一尖锐衍射峰的位置和强度变化，以约100 nm的高空间分辨率探测变形机制，并分析不同压痕载荷下变形区的形状、尺寸以及致密化与剪切流动的相对贡献。
AI.result: 研究发现，这些玻璃的变形区特征（包括形状、尺寸以及不同压痕载荷下致密化与剪切流动的相对贡献）随泊松比的变化而变化，揭示了变形机制与玻璃泊松比之间的关联。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为氧化物玻璃的力学行为提供了新的理解，为设计更具抗损伤性的玻璃材料奠定了基础。

title: A magnonic-optoelectronic reservoir for physical reservoir computing
summary: Physical reservoir computing is a promising approach for fast and energy efficient computer vision, natural language processing, and general pattern recognition. This work presents a physical reservoir based on magnonic-optoelectronic oscillator (MOEO). This approach allowed us to realize short-term memory and nonlinearity as separate system components. The device`s optical path uses a fiber-optic delay line as a short-term-memory element. The microwave path is responsible for nonlinear mapping of input data to a higher-dimensional space. The strong four-wave nonlinearity of spin waves propagating in an yttrium-iron garnet (YIG) ferrite film enables the process. The reservoir performance is evaluated by completing task-independent tests known as short-term memory (STM) and parity-check (PC) tasks. In addition, a numerical model of the MOEO based reservoir is developed. Results of the numerical simulation of the reservoir performance are in good agreement with the experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于磁光光电振荡器（MOEO）的物理储备池计算系统，通过光纤延迟线实现短期记忆，利用钇铁石榴石（YIG）薄膜中自旋波的强四波非线性进行高维非线性映射。系统通过短期记忆和奇偶校验任务评估性能，实验与数值模拟结果吻合良好。
AI.motivation: 物理储备池计算有望实现快速、节能的计算机视觉、自然语言处理和模式识别任务。作者希望通过MOEO架构将短期记忆和非线性映射分离为独立组件，从而更灵活地设计和优化物理储备池系统。
AI.method: 采用磁光光电振荡器（MOEO）作为物理储备池：光学路径使用光纤延迟线作为短期记忆元件，微波路径利用YIG铁氧体薄膜中自旋波的强四波非线性对输入数据进行高维非线性映射。通过STM和PC任务评估性能，并建立数值模型进行仿真验证。
AI.result: MOEO储备池成功实现了短期记忆与非线性功能的分离，在STM和PC任务中表现出良好性能，且数值模拟结果与实验数据高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 基于MOEO的物理储备池是一种可行且有效的实施方案，其模块化设计（记忆与非线性分离）为优化物理储备池性能提供了新思路，并为自旋波非线性在类脑计算中的应用提供了实验证据。

title: Design of altermagnetism in oxide superlattices exploiting interface effects and quantum confinement
summary: The discovery of altermagnetism has initiated intensive research and opened new avenues for spin- tronic and transport applications. While current efforts are mostly focused on bulk materials which are typically insulating, here we propose design strategies to achieve a combination of altermag- netism and metallicity in oxide superlattices by exploiting symmetry breaking, electrostatic doping and confinement. While bulk SrCrO3 does not exhibit altermagnetism due to compensating effects between adjacent layers our density functional theory calculations with a Hubbard U parameter re- veal, that a single SrCrO3 layer confined in a (SrCrO3)1/(SrTiO3)1(001) superlattice (SL) exhibits a sizable non-relativistic spin splitting (NRSS) up to 350 meV with bulk d-wave nature due to the coexistence of orbital ordering and octahedral rotations (OORs). Since this system is insulating, we extend to SrCrO3/LaCrO3(001) SLs. In the (SrCrO3)4/(LaCrO3)4(001) SL the combination of a polar discontinuity at the interface and stronger OORs promotes metallic d-wave altermagnetism. The NRSS of up to 120 meV is contributed by the interfacial Cr d bands at the Fermi level with indications for a spin-selective Fermi surface nesting. These findings establish oxide superlattices as a promising platform to realize and explore altermagnetism for quantum transport and spintronic functionalities

AI.tldr: 该论文提出通过对称性破缺、静电掺杂和限域效应等设计策略，在氧化物超晶格中实现交变磁性与金属性的结合。作者通过DFT+U计算发现，在(SrCrO3)1/(SrTiO3)1(001)超晶格中单层SrCrO3展现出高达350 meV的体d波非相对论自旋劈裂；进一步在(SrCrO3)4/(LaCrO3)4(001)超晶格中利用界面极性不连续性和更强的八面体旋转，实现了金属性d波交变磁性，界面Cr d带贡献了高达120 meV的非相对论自旋劈裂，并呈现出自旋选择的费米面嵌套特征。
AI.motivation: 当前交变磁性研究主要集中于块体绝缘材料，缺乏同时兼具交变磁性与金属性的体系，这限制了其自旋电子学和输运应用的发展。
AI.method: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）并引入Hubbard U参数，对氧化物超晶格进行第一性原理计算，通过对称性破缺、静电掺杂和限域效应等设计策略调控电子结构。
AI.result: (SrCrO3)1/(SrTiO3)1(001)超晶格中实现高达350 meV的非相对论自旋劈裂（体d波性质）；(SrCrO3)4/(LaCrO3)4(001)超晶格中实现金属性d波交变磁性，界面Cr d带贡献120 meV自旋劈裂并存在自旋选择性费米面嵌套。
AI.conclusion: 氧化物超晶格是实现和探索交变磁性的有前景平台，为量子输运和自旋电子学功能提供了新的材料设计思路。

title: ALKEMIE Agent: an autonomous platform for computational materials design
summary: Despite the powerful multi-scale modeling methods and high-throughput infrastructures established in the materials community, real material computation workflows remain fragmented and heavily manual, requiring researchers to constantly bridge software tools, data analysis, and intermediate decisions. This growing gap between methodological capability and practical execution highlights the need for a new kind of autonomous computational framework, one that can coordinate tools, knowledge, and workflows in a more unified and adaptive way. Here, we introduce ALKEMIE Agent, an agentic platform in which retrieval-augmented generation, a materials-computation knowledge base, registered skills, database-supported provenance, AI-assisted structure modeling, bounded task execution, tool-calling iteration, and error-diagnostic assistance are integrated within a traceable control loop. The capabilities of ALKEMIE Agent are demonstrated through applications including materials recommendation, structure modeling, phonon calculations, machine-learned interatomic potential training, LAMMPS simulations, Ab Initio Monte Carlo (AIMC) sampling, and active-learning-based materials screening. Finally, we outline the future directions and challenges for the development of agentic platforms for computational materials design.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ALKEMIE Agent，一个面向材料计算的智能体平台，它集成了检索增强生成、材料计算知识库、注册技能、数据库溯源、AI辅助结构建模、有界任务执行、工具调用迭代和错误诊断辅助等功能，并展示了其在多种材料计算场景中的应用。
AI.motivation: 尽管材料领域已建立了强大的多尺度建模方法和高通量基础设施，但实际的材料计算工作流仍然碎片化且高度依赖人工操作，研究人员需要不断在软件工具、数据分析和中间决策之间进行衔接。这种方法论能力与实际执行之间的差距日益扩大，迫切需要一种能够以更统一、更自适应的方式协调工具、知识和工作流的自主计算框架。
AI.method: ALKEMIE Agent采用智能体架构，在可追踪的控制循环中集成了检索增强生成（RAG）、材料计算知识库、注册技能模块、数据库支持的溯源机制、AI辅助结构建模、有界任务执行、工具调用迭代以及错误诊断辅助等核心组件。
AI.result: 通过多项应用验证了平台能力，包括材料推荐、结构建模、声子计算、机器学习势训练、LAMMPS模拟、从头算蒙特卡洛（AIMC）采样以及基于主动学习的材料筛选等工作场景。
AI.conclusion: ALKEMIE Agent为材料计算提供了一个自主智能体的新范式，能够有效弥合方法论能力与实际执行之间的鸿沟，同时作者也展望了材料计算智能体平台未来的发展方向与面临的挑战。

title: Strain-stabilized altermagnetism and conductivity anisotropy in FeSb2
summary: We show that FeSb2 experiences a transition from a conventional antiferromagnet to an altermagnet when tensile strain is applied. In the altermagnetic phase, the lifted Kramers degeneracy results in spin splitting up to ~0.2eV near the Fermi level even without spin-orbit coupling. The transition to the altermagnetic phase is accompanied by a dramatic change in the Fermi-surface geometry, which leads to a uniaxial conductivity anisotropy up to ~60%, much greater than those observed in typical ferromagnetic metals. Using density-functional theory and Wannier interpolated Fermi surfaces, we show that this magnetotransport behavior may function as an experimental indicator of the transition to the altermagnetic phase. These findings highlight FeSb2 as a versatile, strain-tunable platform for exploring and utilizing altermagnetic transport phenomena for spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过密度泛函理论（DFT）和Wannier插值费米面计算，发现FeSb2在施加拉伸应变时从传统反铁磁体转变为交变磁体（altermagnet），在此相中无需自旋轨道耦合即可实现近费米能级约0.2eV的自旋劈裂，并伴随费米面几何的剧烈变化，导致高达约60%的单轴电导各向异性，可作为交变磁相转变的实验指示器。
AI.motivation: 寻找一种可应变调控的交变磁体材料平台，该材料在交变磁相中具有显著的自旋劈裂和磁输运各向异性，可用于自旋电子器件。FeSb2被认为是一个具有潜力的候选材料。
AI.method: 使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算FeSb2在不同应变条件下的电子结构和磁性；利用Wannier插值构建费米面，分析费米面几何变化与电导各向异性之间的关系。
AI.result: 拉伸应变使FeSb2从传统反铁磁体转变为交变磁体；交变磁相中无需自旋轨道耦合即可获得约0.2eV的自旋劈裂；费米面几何变化导致高达约60%的单轴电导各向异性，远大于典型铁磁金属。
AI.conclusion: FeSb2是一个可通过应变调控的多功能平台，用于探索和利用交变磁输运现象，其显著的磁输运各向异性可作为交变磁相转变的实验指示，对自旋电子器件具有重要应用前景。

title: Bond Disproportionation, Ligand Holes, and Persistent Spin Textures in Ag$_2$BiO$_3$
summary: The origin of the proposed bond disproportionated insulating state of the non-centrosymmetric ($Pnn2$) phase of Ag$_{2}$BiO$_{3}$ is explored using first principles electronic structure calculations. The novel insulating state is elucidated by first considering the initially proposed centosymmetric metallic ($Pnna$) phase of Ag$_{2}$BiO$_{3}$. Our calculations reveal that the valence skipping Bi$^{4+}$ ions in this phase are better described as Bi$^{3+}\underline{L}$ with completely filled Bi-(6$s$) states and a ligand hole. However, phonon calculations indicate that the metallic ($Pnna$) state is dynamically unstable. Structural stability is achieved through breathing distortions of the oxygen octahedra, resulting in two inequivalent Bi sites and a reduction of symmetry to the $Pnn2$ phase. Electronic structure calculations further reveal that the $Pnn2$ phase is a bond disproportionated insulator where the nominal charge state of Bi is described by : 2[Bi$^{3+}\underline{L}$ (Bi$^{4+}$)] $\rightarrow$ Bi$^{3+}\underline{L}^{2-δ}$ (Bi1$^{5+}$) + Bi$^{3+}\underline{L}^δ$ (Bi2$^{3+}$), highlighting the crucial role of ligand holes in driving the insulating state. Next we have investigated the electronic structure of Ag$_{2}$BiO$_{3}$ in the insulating ($Pnn2$) phase including spin-orbit coupling. Our density functional theory (DFT ) calculations complemented by ${\bf k.p}$ model Hamiltonian analysis reveal persistent spin-textures around the $X$ and $Y$ high symmetry points of the orthorhombic Brillouin zone imposed by non-symmorphic symmetry, positioning Ag$_{2}$BiO$_{3}$ as a promising candidate for spintronic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了非中心对称Pnn2相Ag₂BiO₃的键歧化绝缘态的起源。研究发现，最初提出的中心对称金属Pnna相中，价态跳变Bi⁴⁺离子实际上应描述为Bi³⁺L（配体空穴），且该金属相具有动力学不稳定性。通过氧八面体的呼吸畸变，结构稳定化为Pnn2相，形成两个不等价的Bi位点，表现为键歧化绝缘体。进一步的DFT计算结合k·p模型揭示了X和Y高对称点附近的持续自旋纹理，使其成为自旋电子学的候选材料。
AI.motivation: 探索非中心对称Pnn2相Ag₂BiO₃中键歧化绝缘态的物理起源，并评估其在自旋电子学应用中的潜力。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理电子结构计算（DFT），包括声子计算分析动力学稳定性、电子结构计算揭示电荷态分布，并结合k·p模型哈密顿量分析自旋轨道耦合效应下的自旋纹理。
AI.result: (1) 金属Pnna相中Bi⁴⁺实际为Bi³⁺L（配体空穴）态，且该相动力学不稳定；(2) 通过氧八面体呼吸畸变和对称性降低获得Pnn2相，表现为键歧化绝缘体，电荷态分布为Bi³⁺L²⁻δ (Bi1⁵⁺) + Bi³⁺L^δ (Bi2³⁺)；(3) 考虑自旋轨道耦合后，Pnn2相在X和Y高对称点附近具有非对称性对称性所强加的持续自旋纹理。
AI.conclusion: Ag₂BiO₃的Pnn2相绝缘态源于配体空穴驱动的键歧化机制，且该材料具备非对称性对称性保护的持续自旋纹理，是自旋电子学应用的有前景候选材料。

title: Raman-detected quantum dot microscopy for nanoscale electrostatic potential imaging
summary: Quantification of electrostatic potentials at the nanoscale is crucial for understanding the principles governing properties of materials across multiple length scales. Currently, one of the most successful approaches relies on the charging response of a molecular quantum dot, suspended on a tip of a scanning probe microscope and measured using dynamic force spectroscopy. We investigate the possibility of an optical detection, aiming to improve the speed and reduce the complexity of this measurement scheme. We show that the integrated tip-enhanced Raman scattering intensity strongly correlates with the charge state of the quantum dot, and use it to map the electrostatic potential of a single atom. A quantitative equivalence with the established force spectroscopy method is found. We address the underlying photophysical principle of this new method by measuring the Raman spectra as a function of excitation wavelength and the molecular quantum dot charge. We reveal that the observed Raman intensity variations are primarily driven by transitions between resonant and non-resonant Raman scattering regimes of the molecule.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于尖端增强拉曼散射（TERS）的光学检测方法，用于纳米尺度静电势的定量测量，通过建立拉曼散射强度与分子量子点电荷态之间的强相关性，实现了单原子静电势的成像映射，并与传统的动态力谱方法在定量上等效。
AI.motivation: 纳米尺度静电势的量化对理解材料跨尺度的性质至关重要。目前最成功的方法依赖扫描探针显微镜尖端上的分子量子点的充电响应，通过动态力谱测量。然而该方法速度慢且复杂度高，因此研究者希望探索光学检测方案来提高测量速度并降低系统复杂度。
AI.method: 研究者利用尖端增强拉曼散射（TERS）技术，将分子量子点置于扫描探针显微镜尖端上，通过测量集成TERS强度来反映量子点的电荷状态。他们进一步通过改变激发波长和分子量子点电荷来测量拉曼光谱，以揭示该方法的底层光物理机制。
AI.result: 研究证明集成尖端增强拉曼散射强度与量子点电荷态之间存在强相关性，成功实现了单原子静电势的映射，并与已确立的力谱方法在定量上达到等效。拉曼强度变化主要由分子在共振与非共振拉曼散射状态之间的跃迁驱动。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种新颖的光学静电势探测方法，兼具比力谱方法更快的速度和更低的复杂度，同时在定量精度上与成熟方法等效，为纳米尺度静电测量提供了新途径。

title: Rare-earth chalcogenide perovskites: A promising class of materials for optoelectronic applications
summary: Rare-earth chalcogenide perovskites have attracted significant attention for optoelectronic applications due to their nontoxic composition, robust phase stability, and excellent optoelectronic properties. However, their excitonic and polaronic properties remain largely unexplored due to the high computational cost of accurate theoretical treatments. In this work, we present a comprehensive first-principles investigation of excitonic dynamics and polaronic effects in a series of III-III rare-earth chalcogenide perovskites ABX$_{3}$ (A = Y, La; B = Sc, Y; X = S, Se), along with their structural stability and optoelectronic properties, using state-of-the-art density functional theory in conjunction with many-body perturbation theory within the G$_{0}$W$_{0}$ and Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) frameworks. All investigated compounds satisfy the dynamical and mechanical stability criteria. They exhibit quasiparticle band gaps in the range of 2.75$-$4.47 eV, and the BSE calculations reveal strong optical absorption spanning the visible to ultraviolet regions. The computed excitonic properties indicate intermediate-to-large exciton binding energies (0.148$-$0.517 eV), moderately localized excitons, and strong electron-hole wavefunction overlap, indicative of favorable radiative recombination characteristics and enhanced light-matter interaction. Furthermore, analysis based on the Fröhlich model demonstrates intermediate-to-strong carrier-phonon coupling, with electron-phonon interactions generally stronger than hole-phonon interactions. Overall, rare-earth chalcogenide perovskites ABX$_{3}$ exhibit a compelling combination of structural stability, tunable optoelectronic properties, pronounced excitonic effects, and favorable polaronic transport, positioning them as promising lead-free materials for next-generation optoelectronic devices, including light-emitting devices and photodetectors.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算（DFT结合G₀W₀和BSE方法）系统研究了稀土硫族钙钛矿ABX₃（A=Y, La; B=Sc, Y; X=S, Se）的激子动力学和极化子效应，发现该类材料兼具结构稳定性、可调光电性能（带隙2.75-4.47 eV）、中等至较大激子结合能（0.148-0.517 eV）以及有利的极化子输运特性，是极具前景的无铅光电材料。
AI.motivation: 稀土硫族钙钛矿因其无毒组成、优异的相稳定性和光电性能而备受关注，但受限于高计算成本，其激子和极化子性质尚未被深入探索。理解这些性质对于评估其实际光电应用潜力至关重要。
AI.method: 采用最先进的密度泛函理论（DFT）结合多体微扰理论，在G₀W₀和Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）框架内，对系列III-III稀土硫族钙钛矿ABX₃进行系统计算，包括结构稳定性分析、准粒子带隙计算、激子性质（结合能、波函数重叠）以及基于Fröhlich模型的载流子-声子耦合分析。
AI.result: 所有化合物满足动力学和力学稳定性标准；准粒子带隙在2.75-4.47 eV范围内；BSE计算显示可见至紫外区域的强光吸收；激子结合能为0.148-0.517 eV（中等至较大），激子适度局域化且电子-空穴波函数重叠强；Fröhlich模型分析显示中等至强载流子-声子耦合，电子-声子相互作用普遍强于空穴-声子相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 稀土硫族钙钛矿ABX₃结合了结构稳定性、可调光电性能、显著激子效应和有利极化子输运等优势，是用于下一代光电器件（如发光器件和光电探测器）的 promising 无铅材料。

title: Plexciton-mediated Raman scattering in strongly coupled systems
summary: A series of experimental results demonstrate a distinctive Raman response in plasmon-exciton coupled systems. The enhancement of Raman scattering varies for different phonon modes. We describe the microscopic dynamical process of this Raman scattering using quantum many-body theory. Unlike conventional Raman scattering involving electron-phonon interactions, the process in plasmon-exciton coupled systems is characterized by inelastic scattering between phonons and plasmon-exciton polaritons-formed through the coupling of plasmons and excitons-acting as intermediate states. We derive analytical expressions for the Raman intensity and enhancement factors for various phonon modes, which show excellent agreement with experimental data. Furthermore, experimental fittings indicate a substantial disparity in the linewidths of the upper and lower polariton branches, for which we provide a comprehensive theoretical explanation. Based on linear response theory, we propose a microscopic mechanism for the formation of plasmon-exciton polaritons, enabling the analytical calculation of their dispersions and linewidths. This approach naturally accounts for the significantly asymmetry observed in the linewidths of the upper and lower polariton branches. By characterizing the polariton-phonon scattering process at the quantum level, we reveal the fundamental physical mechanism driving polariton-enhanced Raman scattering. Our work establishes a universal framework for describing the dynamical evolution of coupled systems, providing a versatile paradigm for exploring the interactions between plasmons and other quasiparticles.

AI.tldr: 本文通过量子多体理论系统地描述了等离子激元-激子耦合体系中的增强拉曼散射过程，提出了声子与等离子激元-激子极化激元之间非弹性散射的微观机制，并解析推导了不同声子模式的拉曼强度和增强因子，与实验数据高度吻合。同时基于线性响应理论解释了上下极化激元分支线宽的不对称性，建立了耦合体系动力学演化的普适框架。
AI.motivation: 等离子激元-激子耦合体系展现出独特的拉曼响应，不同声子模式的拉曼增强存在显著差异，但此前缺乏对该微观动力学过程的系统理论描述，特别是声子与极化激元之间散射机制的理论解释尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用量子多体理论描述等离子激元-激子极化激元作为中间态与声子之间的非弹性散射过程；基于线性响应理论推导极化激元的色散关系和线宽，并解析计算不同声子模式的拉曼强度和增强因子。
AI.result: 解析表达式与实验数据高度吻合；成功解释了上下极化激元分支线宽的显著不对称性；在量子层面表征了极化激元-声子散射过程，揭示了极化增强拉曼散射的基本物理机制。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了描述耦合体系动力学演化的普适框架，为探索等离子激元与其他准粒子之间的相互作用提供了通用范式，对极化增强拉曼散射和耦合量子体系的研究具有重要理论意义。

title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs
summary: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reaches new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework designing crystals, proposing each candidate with a stated rationale and testing it. The agent reasons in an interpretable \emph{language of motifs}, writing each crystal as a \emph{motif profile} that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the \emph{motifs}---composing it. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile and constructs a crystal from the modified one, and the most promising candidates are validated by first-principles calculation. Applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent magnets, MatEvolve---built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning---reaches new structural prototypes more than three times as often as generative models under an equal validation budget, at a comparable on-target-magnet rate. Beyond design, analysing the discovered crystals' human-readable profiles reveals structure--property relationships.

AI.tldr: 介绍MatEvolve，一个基于智能体AI的晶体设计框架，使用可解释的"基序语言"来表示和设计晶体，在稀土匮乏永磁体设计中比生成模型更能发现新结构原型。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的材料发现通常在插值时比外推更可靠，很少能发现新的结构类型。需要一种能够超越现有数据分布、探索新结构空间的方法。
AI.method: MatEvolve是一个智能体AI框架：1) 使用可解释的"基序语言"将每个晶体表示为"基序剖面"（描述构成晶体的重复几何模式）；2) 智能体通过编辑基序剖面来设计新材料，并从修改后的剖面构建晶体；3) 最有希望的候选体通过第一性原理计算验证；4) 基于Claude Fable 5语言模型，无需微调。
AI.result: 在稀土匮乏永磁体设计中，MatEvolve在同等验证预算下发现新结构原型的频率是生成模型的三倍以上，同时保持了相当的达标磁体率。
AI.conclusion: MatEvolve不仅能更有效地发现新结构类型，其人类可读的基序剖面还能揭示结构-性质关系，为材料设计提供了可解释的途径。

title: Five-terminal quantized transconductance originating from symmetric quantum fluctuations
summary: We consider the renormalization of transport in a quantum contact by the external electromagnetic environment and show that weak quantum fluctuations from a symmetric environment can lead to a quantized transconductance in five-terminal contacts. This mechanism does not work for fewer terminals. We present an implementation of the environment and investigate several example quantum contacts where the quantization takes place.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了量子接触中由外部电磁环境引起的输运重整化，发现对称环境的弱量子涨落可以在五端子接触中导致量子化的跨电导，而更少端子的接触无法实现这一机制。
AI.motivation: 探索外部电磁环境对量子接触输运性质的影响，特别是寻找在更多端子接触中实现量子化电导的新机制。
AI.method: 考虑量子接触中由外部电磁环境引起的输运重整化，分析对称环境的量子涨落对多端子接触输运的影响，提出环境的具体实现方案，并研究多个量子接触实例。
AI.result: 发现对称环境的弱量子涨落可以在五端子接触中产生量子化的跨电导，且该机制在端子数少于五时不起作用。
AI.conclusion: 五端子量子接触在对称电磁环境作用下可实现量子化跨电导，为多端子量子输运调控提供新途径。

title: Synthesizing like a chemist: an iterative, feedback-driven loop for materials discovery
summary: Most computationally predicted materials are never synthesized because conventional synthesis optimization is slow, expertise-dependent, and iterative. Here we present a closed-loop framework that automates this expert workflow by placing human tacit knowledge in the loop through a large language model (LLM) that distills synthesis knowledge from the literature, high-throughput hyperspectral imaging for rapid film evaluation, and multi-objective Bayesian optimization guided by experimental feedback. In a paired optimization campaign, LLM-assisted initialization produced more Pareto-optimal samples and higher hypervolume than a Latin hypercube sampling baseline at matched trial counts, and this advantage persisted throughout iterative optimization. We demonstrate the framework by synthesizing the previously unreported perovskite-inspired compound Rb3BiI6 as thin films and validating the optimized films by optical bandgap analysis and X-ray diffraction. The framework transforms synthesis prediction from single-shot recommendation to iterative learning, providing a generalizable strategy to accelerate automated and fully autonomous experimental materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种闭环框架，将大语言模型（LLM）蒸馏的文献合成知识、高光谱成像和贝叶斯优化相结合，实现材料合成的自动化优化。实验通过LLM辅助初始化获得了优于拉丁超立方采样的Pareto最优样本和更高超体积，并成功合成了此前未见报道的Rb3BiI6薄膜。
AI.motivation: 大多数计算预测的材料由于传统合成优化过程缓慢、依赖专家经验且迭代繁琐而从未被实际合成，亟需一种自动化、可泛化的合成优化策略。
AI.method: 提出闭环框架，包括：(1) 利用LLM从文献中蒸馏合成知识并将人类隐性知识纳入循环；(2) 高光谱成像实现薄膜快速评估；(3) 多目标贝叶斯优化由实验反馈驱动迭代学习。
AI.result: 在配对优化实验中，LLM辅助初始化在相同试验次数下产生更多Pareto最优样本和更高超体积，且优势在迭代优化中持续保持。成功合成了此前未报道的Rb3BiI6钙钛矿衍生化合物薄膜，并通过光学带隙分析和X射线衍射验证了优化后的薄膜。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将合成预测从单次推荐转变为迭代学习过程，为加速自动化和全自主实验材料发现提供了可泛化的策略。

title: Topological insulator realization induced by fermionic interaction through BF mediators
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, to be published in Phys. Lett. A
summary: This paper demonstrates that ordinary fermions, interacting via a BF mediator, form a renormalized structure with non-trivial topological properties. We explore the analogy between the renormalized fermion and a subset of real three-dimensional topological insulators (TIs) in the vicinity of their single Dirac cones. Using the typical magnitude of TI lattice and gaps, we constrain model parameters. The topological structure induced by radiative corrections enters a class of modified Dirac equations, ensuring the existence of helical gapless near-boundary modes. We derive an effective potential for inter-quasi-particle interactions that incorporates finite-size effects in the axial direction, revealing signatures of spin-orbit coupling and time-reversal invariance. Remarkably, particles with different spins do not interact via the characteristic spin-orbit coupling, and a non-central spin-dependent force arises. We also address the behavior of the system in the phase transition associated with the thin-film limit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究普通费米子通过BF中介子相互作用形成的重整化结构，发现其具有非平凡的拓扑性质，并与三维拓扑绝缘体（TIs）中单狄拉克锥附近的物理行为建立类比。通过拓扑绝缘体的典型晶格和能隙尺度约束模型参数，证明辐射修正诱导的拓扑结构属于修正狄拉克方程的一类，确保螺旋无质量近边界模式的存在。论文还推导了包含轴向有限尺寸效应的准粒子间有效势，揭示了自旋轨道耦合和時間反演不变性的特征，特别发现不同自旋的粒子不通过特征性自旋轨道耦合相互作用，而是产生非中心自旋相关力。此外还讨论了薄膜极限相变行为。
AI.motivation: 探索BF理论中介导的费米子重整化结构与拓扑绝缘体之间的深层联系，试图建立辐射修正诱导的拓扑现象与凝聚态物理中拓扑绝缘体之间的类比桥梁，从而为理解费米子相互作用中的拓扑结构提供新的理论框架，并阐明薄层系统中的相变行为。
AI.method: 采用BF中介子相互作用框架研究费米子重整化结构；通过与三维拓扑绝缘体单狄拉克锥附近的物理进行类比，利用TI晶格和能隙的典型值约束模型参数；分析辐射修正产生的拓扑结构并将其归入修正狄拉克方程类别；推导包含轴向有限尺寸效应的准粒子间有效势；研究不同自旋粒子间的自旋相关力以及薄层极限下的相变行为。
AI.result: 证明了普通费米子经BF中介子相互作用后可形成具有非平凡拓扑性质的重整化结构；确认该拓扑结构对应修正狄拉克方程的一类，确保螺旋无质量近边界模式的存在；推导出包含有限尺寸效应的有效势，揭示自旋轨道耦合和时间反演不变性的特征；发现不同自旋粒子间不经历特征性自旋轨道耦合，而是产生非中心自旋相关力；表征了薄膜极限时的相变行为。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了量子场论中BF介导的费米子重整化结构与拓扑绝缘体物理之间令人信服的类比，展示了辐射修正如何在根本上改变费米子系统的拓扑属性。发现的自旋相关力的非中心特性以及薄膜极限相变行为，为未来研究拓扑量子物质和薄层系统中的新奇量子现象提供了理论依据。

title: Beyond Local Berry Geometry: A First-Principles Finite-Momentum Theory of Electronic Position
summary: Electronic position controls how a crystal polarizes and responds to an external field. In crystals, it is usually described through local changes of electronic states in momentum space. This Berry framework has reshaped modern solid-state physics, but strong fields drive electrons across a finite momentum range, where coherence between different momenta becomes part of the response. Here we establish a first-principles theory of electronic position at finite momentum that retains this missing information. We show that unequal-momentum coherence can cancel under spatial averaging and still produce polarization, forming a coherence dipole. We obtain the matrix directly from material wave functions, without model bands or fitted transition elements. In Si, the finite-momentum geometry sets a material momentum scale. Comparing this scale with the momentum change driven by the field predicts when finite-momentum physics becomes active. Crossing the scale strongly reorganizes the fifth and higher harmonics, showing that momentum-space geometry, rather than emitted photon energy alone, controls the nonlinear response. HHG is the first demonstration, but the theory applies whenever driven electrons explore a finite momentum range. It therefore extends quantum geometry beyond the local Berry limit and provides a general basis for predicting field-driven phenomena in real materials.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了有限动量下电子位置的第一性原理理论，超越了局域Berry框架的限制。作者发现不同动量间的相干性在空间平均后可以抵消但仍产生极化，形成"相干偶极"。该理论直接从材料波函数获得矩阵元，无需模型能带或拟合跃迁矩阵元。在硅中，有限动量几何设定了材料动量尺度，该尺度与场驱动的动量变化比较可预测有限动量物理何时激活。跨越该尺度会显著重组第五次及以上高次谐波，说明是动量空间几何而非仅发射光子能量控制非线性响应。
AI.motivation: 传统Berry框架通过动量空间中的局域电子态变化描述晶体极化，但在强场下电子跨越有限动量范围，不同动量之间的相干性成为响应的一部分，现有理论丢失了这一关键信息。作者旨在建立一种能够保留这种相干性信息的第一性原理理论。
AI.method: 作者建立了有限动量下电子位置的第一性原理理论框架，直接从材料波函数计算矩阵元，不依赖模型能带或拟合的跃迁矩阵元。理论核心是揭示"相干偶极"概念——不同动量间的相干性可在空间平均后抵消但仍产生极化。通过比较有限动量几何设定的材料动量尺度与场驱动动量变化，预测有限动量物理的激活条件。
AI.result: 在硅中验证了该理论，有限动量几何设定了材料动量尺度；跨越该尺度会强烈重组第五次及以上的高次谐波，证明动量空间几何控制非线性响应的非线性行为，而非仅由发射光子能量决定。
AI.conclusion: 该理论将量子几何拓展到局域Berry极限之外，适用于任何电子在强场驱动下探索有限动量范围的场景，为预测真实材料中场驱动现象提供了通用基础。高次谐波产生（HHG）是该理论的首个演示应用。

title: First-Principles Prediction of Phonon-Mediated Infrared Optical Properties of WO$_3$ Polymorphs
summary: Many crystals exhibit polymorphism, undergoing atomic rearrangements that result in unit cells belonging to different symmetry groups. These structural changes directly affect lattice vibration modes and consequently influence their mid-infrared optical properties. In this study, we use tungsten trioxide (WO$_3$) as a representative system, owing to its multiple temperature-dependent phases, to study the impact of polymorphism on mid-infrared optical behaviour. Using a fully first-principles approach, we investigate three phases of WO$_3$ and evaluate their mid-infrared optical properties. Significant differences are observed among the three crystallographic phases, demonstrating the potential of this methodology as a predictive tool for materials discovery and targeted design.

AI.tldr: 本研究以三氧化钨（WO₃）为代表体系，利用全第一性原理方法研究了三种不同晶相的多态性对其红外光学性质的影响，发现三种晶相之间存在显著的光学性质差异，展示了该方法在材料发现和定向设计中的预测潜力。
AI.motivation: 多晶型现象普遍存在于晶体材料中，不同对称群导致的原子重排会直接影响晶格振动模式，进而改变红外光学性质。理解这种结构变化与光学行为之间的关联对于材料设计和预测至关重要，因此需要系统研究多态性对红外光学性质的影响。
AI.method: 以WO₃作为代表性体系（因其具有多种温度依赖相），采用完全第一性原理的方法，对WO₃的三种晶相进行建模和计算，评估其红外光学性质。
AI.result: 三种WO₃晶相在红外光学性质上表现出显著差异，证明多态性对光学行为有实质性影响。
AI.conclusion: 该第一性原理方法可以作为一种预测工具，用于材料发现和按需设计具有特定红外光学性质的材料。

title: Engineering two-qubit gates via anisotropic exchange in germanium spin qubits
summary: Germanium hole spin qubits are a promising and versatile platform for quantum computation and simulation. In this system, strong spin-orbit interaction (SOI) renders the single-qubit $g$-tensor anisotropic and electrically tunable, enabling operational sweet spots with reduced noise sensitivity. SOI also transforms the isotropic two-qubit exchange coupling into an anisotropic tensor whose geometry is inherited from the single-qubit $g$-tensors and spin-flip tunnelling. Here, using two hole spin qubits in a strained-germanium quantum well and full vector control of the magnetic field, we map this exchange tensor, separate it into longitudinal and transverse components, and show that they govern controlled-phase and SWAP-like dynamics, respectively. We find that the longitudinal exchange can be tuned via the magnetic field orientation from a conventional positive value, through zero, to an effectively negative one, as measured by inverted exchange-split spin transitions. The magnetic field direction thus provides continuous control over the interaction Hamiltonian: at a point of purely transverse exchange, we engineer a single-pulse baseband iSWAP, unattainable under isotropic exchange. Linking $g$-tensor geometry to exchange anisotropy establishes native Hamiltonian engineering, enabling spin-based quantum simulation and gate sets selected by the global field orientation alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过磁场全矢量控制，对锗空穴自旋量子比特中的交换张量进行了完整测绘，并将其分解为纵向和横向分量。研究发现纵向交换可通过磁场方向从正调至负，横向交换可产生各向同性交换无法实现的 iSWAP 操作，从而实现了仅通过全局场方向即可选择哈密顿量的原生量子门集。
AI.motivation: 锗空穴自旋量子比特具有强自旋轨道耦合，使单量子比特g张量各向异性且电可调，同时将各向同性的双量子比特交换耦合转变为各向异性张量。理解并映射这一交换张量的几何结构，是实现可编程量子门和量子模拟的关键前提。
AI.method: 在应变锗量子阱中使用两个空穴自旋量子比特，通过磁场全矢量控制来系统测绘交换张量，将交换耦合分解为纵向（控制受控相位动力学）和横向（控制SWAP类动力学）两个分量，并追踪其随磁场方向的演化。
AI.result: 实验成功将纵向交换从正值经零点调至有效负值（通过反转的交换分裂自旋跃迁测量），并证明了磁场方向提供了对相互作用哈密顿量的连续调控。在纯横向交换点，实现了单脉冲基带iSWAP门，这是各向同性交换无法实现的。
AI.conclusion: 将g张量几何与交换各向异性联系起来，确立了原生哈密顿量工程方法，仅通过全局磁场方向的选择即可实现自旋量子模拟和多样化的量子门集，为该平台提供了高度灵活且可扩展的量子计算方案。

title: Spin-pump-induced spin transport demonstration in a photoconductive PTCDA molecular thin film with a transparent spin current detector
summary: We demonstrate spin-pump-induced spin transport in a photoconductive PTCDA (3,4,9,10-perylene-teracarboxylic dianhydride) molecular thin film with a transparent ITO (In2O3 + SnO2) film as a spin current detector. In a tri-layer stacking structure sample composed of ITO/PTCDA/Ni80Fe20, pure spin current is generated in the PTCDA layer by using the spin pumping driven by the ferromagnetic resonance of the Ni80Fe20 layer. The generated spin current is absorbed into the ITO layer, converted to a charge current due to the inverse spin-Hall effect of the ITO layer, and detected as an electromotive force via the ITO resistance. Also, the light irradiation effect on spin transport in PTCDA films is investigated.

AI.tldr: 本文在ITO/PTCDA/Ni80Fe20三层堆叠结构中实现了自旋泵浦诱导的自旋输运，利用ITO层的逆自旋霍尔效应检测自旋电流，并研究了光照对PTCDA薄膜中自旋输运的影响。
AI.motivation: 探索有机分子薄膜（PTCDA）中的自旋输运特性，并利用透明导电氧化物ITO作为自旋电流探测器，研究光照射对自旋输运的调节作用。
AI.method: 采用自旋泵浦技术：通过Ni80Fe20层的铁磁共振产生纯自旋电流注入PTCDA层，自旋电流随后被ITO层吸收，利用ITO的逆自旋霍尔效应转换为电荷电流，并通过ITO电阻检测为电动势。同时研究了光照条件对自旋输运的影响。
AI.result: 成功在光导性PTCDA分子薄膜中实现了自旋泵浦诱导的自旋输运，并通过ITO层的逆自旋霍尔效应检测到了自旋电流转换的电信号。
AI.conclusion: ITO可以作为自旋电流检测器，PTCDA作为有机自旋输运层可行；光的照射效应可能成为调控有机薄膜自旋输运的有效手段。

title: Reduced vortex descriptors linking polycrystallinity in magnetic nanoparticles with polarized magnetic small-angle neutron scattering
summary: Analytical vortex models reduce polarized magnetic small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) from nanoparticle ensembles to a small set of texture descriptors. In this work, we apply this reduction to micromagnetic simulations of polycrystalline iron oxide nanoflowers at a fixed particle size and examine how a controlled parametrization of multigrain disorder is reflected in the remanent descriptors. The particles are represented by explicit Voronoi microstructures, and intraparticle disorder is varied through the intergrain exchange coupling and anisotropy-axis coherence. Fitting each remanent magnetization state to a hyperbolic vortex model reveals a predominantly two-channel organization: the intergrain exchange coupling is associated mainly with the radial vortex profile, whereas the anisotropy-axis coherence is associated mainly with the orientational moment of the vortex-axis distribution. The normalized spin-flip SANS cross sections are accurately represented by independent fits of the analytical linear-vortex SANS expression obtained from the first-order expansion of the hyperbolic profile. The fitted orientational descriptor agrees closely with its independent real-space estimate, whereas the corresponding radial descriptors exhibit a strong global nonlinear relation. This separation identifies which information from the micromagnetic vortex textures is robustly retained by the reduced analytical representation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分析涡旋模型对多晶铁氧化物纳米花微磁模拟中剩磁态的降维表征能力。通过在Voronoi微结构上参数化调控晶间交换耦合和各向异性轴相干性，发现两类无序参数分别主导涡旋的径向剖面和取向矩，且解析线性涡旋SANS表达式能准确拟合归一化自旋翻转截面。
AI.motivation: 解析涡旋模型可将极化磁性小角中子散射（SANS）数据简化为少量纹理描述符，但此前缺乏对多晶无序参数化与这些描述符之间映射关系的系统理解。作者旨在明确降维表征中哪些微磁涡旋纹理信息被稳健保留，哪些信息在解析简化中发生非线性重组。
AI.method: 使用显式Voronoi微结构表示多晶铁氧化物纳米花颗粒，通过改变晶间交换耦合和各向异性轴相干性来参数化颗粒内无序。对每个剩磁态进行双曲涡旋模型拟合，并将解析线性涡旋SANS表达式（由双曲剖面一阶展开得到）与归一化自旋翻转散射截面进行独立拟合。
AI.result: 研究发现两通道分离：晶间交换耦合主要影响径向涡旋剖面，各向异性轴相干性主要影响涡旋轴分布的方向矩。解析SANS表达式的拟合取向描述符与实空间独立估计吻合良好，而径向描述符存在强全局非线性关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了解析涡旋模型降维表征中信息保留的分离性——取向信息被稳健传递，而径向剖面信息在解析表示中发生非线性压缩，为从SANS数据反演微磁涡旋结构提供了方法学指导。

title: Efficient nonequilibrium electron dynamics from first-principles: leveraging Koopmans spectral functionals and Wannier localization
summary: We present an efficient first-principles approach for simulating the nonequilibrium electron dynamics in extended systems beyond the linear regime. The method combines Koopmans-compliant functionals, which provide an accurate quasiparticle band structures, with the real-time evolution of the electronic density matrix in a Wannier basis within the Hartree plus screened exchange (HSEX) approximation. The locality of the orbital basis enables physically motivated approximations that significantly reduce both the computational cost and memory requirements while preserving accuracy. The screened Coulomb interaction, the central ingredient of the HSEX self-energy, is computed efficiently using density-functional perturbation theory. We benchmark the approach in the linear regime against experimental spectra and reference Green's function calculations for systems featuring both weakly and strongly bound excitons. Moving to the nonlinear regime, we investigate high-harmonic generation (HHG) in silicon and lithium fluoride. While in silicon the HHG spectrum is largely governed by the quasiparticle band structure, in LiF, a material featuring strong excitonics effect, the harmonic emission is selectively enhanced at excitonic resonances, suggesting that HHG probes correlated electron-hole excitations rather than solely the quasiparticle band structure. The present framework enables fully \textit{ab-initio} simulations of excitonic effects in nonlinear optical spectra at a significantly reduced computational cost compared to real-time Green's function approaches, providing an efficient route to the study of ultrafast and strong-field phenomena in solids.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的第一性原理方法，用于模拟扩展系统中超越线性响应的非平衡电子动力学。该方法结合了Koopmans兼容泛函（提供准确的准粒子能带结构）和Wannier基组中电子密度矩阵的实时演化（采用Hartree加屏蔽交换HSEX近似）。通过利用局域轨道基组的特性，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算成本和内存需求。在非线性领域，作者研究了硅和氟化锂中的高次谐波产生（HHG），发现硅的HHG谱主要由准粒子能带结构决定，而LiF中谐波发射在激子共振处被选择性增强，表明HHG探测的是相关的电子-空穴激发而非仅准粒子能带结构。相比实时格林函数方法，该框架能以显著降低的计算成本实现非线性光谱中激子效应的全从头算模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有的实时格林函数方法虽然能准确描述非平衡电子动力学和非线性光学现象中的激子效应，但计算成本极高，难以应用于实际材料体系。需要一种既能保持精度又能显著降低计算开销的方法，用于研究固体中的超快和强场现象。
AI.method: 该方法将Koopmans-compliant泛函（提供准确准粒子能带结构）与Wannier基组中密度矩阵的实时演化相结合，采用Hartree加屏蔽交换（HSEX）近似。屏蔽库仑相互作用通过密度泛函微扰理论高效计算。局域轨道基组允许采用物理上合理的近似来降低计算成本和内存需求。
AI.result: 在线性区间的基准测试表明，该方法与实验光谱和参考格林函数计算结果吻合良好，适用于弱束缚和强束缚激子系统。在非线性区间，硅的HHG谱主要由准粒子能带结构决定，而LiF中谐波发射在激子共振处选择性增强，揭示了HHG可探测相关电子-空穴激发。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了非线性光谱中激子效应的全从头算模拟，计算成本相比实时格林函数方法显著降低，为研究固体中的超快和强场现象提供了高效途径，并揭示了HHG可作为探测材料中激子效应的手段。

title: Classical Mechanics Exactly Yields the Full Bound-State Spectrum of the Two-Dimensional Coulomb Problem
summary: High-lying Rydberg excitons in two-dimensional semiconductors universally exhibit a characteristic odd-integer energy scaling distinct from three-dimensional systems. While this hallmark of two-dimensional Coulomb interaction is well known from quantum mechanical solutions, its deeper classical geometric origin remains unclarified. Here we show that the complete bound-state spectral structure of the two-dimensional Coulomb problem---a central model for two-dimensional exciton physics---follows as an exact theorem from classical mechanics augmented by a single phase-scale parameter $α$ with dimensions of action. We derive an amplitude-closure criterion as a necessary and sufficient condition for a classical propagator kernel to satisfy a linear evolution equation, and demonstrate that the singular Coulomb potential can be mapped shell-by-shell via Levi-Civita regularization into the class of quadratic Hamiltonians that obey this criterion exactly. The resulting spectrum bears odd-integer modal numbers, $1/N^2$ energy ratios and $N$-fold degeneracies, all independent of $α$ and consistent with experimental observations of high-lying Rydberg excitons. This work provides a pure classical-geometry benchmark for two-dimensional exciton spectral analysis, allowing quantitative disentanglement of universal Coulomb effects from material-specific screening effects. No semiclassical, short-wavelength or $\hbar \to 0$ approximation is invoked at any stage. Our results invert the usual logical hierarchy for this integrable system: the wave equation emerges as a representation of the underlying classical geometry, rather than as an independent first principle.

AI.tldr: 本文证明二维库仑问题的完整束缚态能谱可以从经典力学加上一个具有作用量量纲的单一相位尺度参数α精确推导出来，无需任何半经典或短波长近似。作者通过Levi-Civita正则化将奇异库仑势逐壳映射到满足振幅闭合准则的二次哈密顿量类，从而以纯经典几何的方式重现了奇数模态数、1/N²能量比和N重简并等二维里德堡激子的特征谱结构。
AI.motivation: 二维半导体中高激发里德堡激子表现出独特的奇整数能量标度，与三维系统截然不同。虽然这一二维库仑相互作用的标志性特征已从量子力学解中知晓，但其更深的经典几何起源尚未阐明。作者希望揭示这一量子谱结构底层的经典几何本质。
AI.method: 作者推导出振幅闭合准则，作为经典传播子核满足线性演化方程的充要条件。然后通过Levi-Civita正则化将奇异库仑势逐壳映射到精确满足该准则的二次哈密顿量类中。引入单一的具有作用量量纲的相位尺度参数α，整个谱结构作为经典力学的精确定理得出，全程不涉及任何半经典、短波长或ħ→0近似。
AI.result: 得到的谱具有奇整数模态数、1/N²能量比和N重简并，所有这些特征均与α无关，并与高激发里德堡激子的实验观测一致。该工作为二维激子光谱分析提供了纯经典几何基准，能够定量分离普适的库仑效应与材料特有的屏蔽效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作颠倒了这个可积系统的通常逻辑层级：波动方程是底层经典几何的一种表示，而非独立的第一性原理。二维库仑问题的量子谱结构完全源于经典力学加单一相位参数的几何构造。

title: Toward the Ultimate Limit: Elemental Metals in One Dimension
summary: Low-dimensional materials exhibit extraordinary properties that make them promising candidates for advanced technologies. Although they have been investigated extensively, most of the research has focused on layered two-dimensional (2D) materials. Here, inspired by recent advances in atomically thin metallenes, we further reduce dimensionality and use density-functional theory simulations to study the geometry, energetics, elasticity, and electronic structure of 40 non-magnetic one-dimensional (1D) atomic chains of elemental metals. We find that nearly all chains have a buckled ground state, nine chains are distorted, and three chains---Cd, Hg, and Sr---are semiconducting with an electronic gap. We also find that transition metals retain a substantial fraction of their 3D bulk cohesive energy even in 1D chains. We assessed chains' dynamical stabilities by molecular dynamics simulations and found that 26 of them are thermodynamically stable at 100 K. Finally, we performed chain pulling simulations to investigate the straightening dynamics of selected stable chains. Given that experimental techniques have recently reached the 1D-chain limit, our systematic study provides a foundation and timely guide to accelerating synthesis and characterization of these materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟，系统地研究了40种非磁性元素金属的一维（1D）原子链的几何结构、能量、弹性和电子结构，发现多数链呈屈曲基态，其中Cd、Hg和Sr为半导体，26种链在100K下具有热力学稳定性，为1D材料合成与表征提供基础指导。
AI.motivation: 低维材料具有非凡性质，但以往研究多集中在二维层状材料上。受原子级薄金属烯（metallenes）研究的启发，作者希望进一步降低维度至一维原子链，系统探索元素金属1D链的性质，以填补该领域的系统研究空白。
AI.method: 使用密度泛函理论（DFT）模拟研究40种非磁性元素金属1D原子链的几何结构、能量、弹性和电子结构；通过分子动力学（MD）模拟评估链的动力学稳定性；并通过链拉伸模拟研究选定稳定链的展直动力学。
AI.result: 几乎所有链都有屈曲基态，9条链发生畸变；Cd、Hg和Sr三条链是带隙的半导体；过渡金属在1D链中仍保留相当比例的3D块体结合能；26种链在100K下热力学稳定；链拉伸模拟揭示了稳定链的展直动力学行为。
AI.conclusion: 该系统性研究为理解一维金属原子链的结构与性质提供了全面基础，鉴于实验技术已接近1D链极限，本研究为加速这些材料的合成与表征提供了及时的理论指导。

title: Surface weak ferromagnetism
summary: This paper proposes a model of a Néel-ordered antiferromagnet exhibiting a weak ferromagnetic moment restricted to the crystal surface, generated by spin-orbit coupling induced by broken surface symmetries. Depending on crystal termination, the surface magnetic moment can align with identical or opposing signs on the top and bottom surfaces, resulting in a zero Faraday effect paired with a finite Kerr effect upon reflection for the latter configuration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种Néel有序反铁磁体模型，该模型因表面对称性破缺诱导的自旋-轨道耦合，在晶体表面产生受限的弱铁磁矩。根据晶体终止条件的不同，上下表面的磁矩可同向或反向排列；反向排列时产生零法拉第效应但同时存在有限的克尔效应。
AI.motivation: 探索反铁磁材料表面因对称性破缺而产生的自旋-轨道耦合效应，研究表面磁矩的取向如何影响磁光效应（法拉第效应与克尔效应），从而为反铁磁体的光学探测与表征提供理论依据。
AI.method: 建立一个Néel有序反铁磁体的理论模型，考虑表面对称性破缺诱导的自旋-轨道耦合，分析不同晶体终止条件下表面弱铁磁矩的取向（同号或异号），并计算相应的法拉第效应（透射）与克尔效应（反射）响应。
AI.result: 发现表面磁矩的排列方式取决于晶体终止条件：同向排列与异向排列均可实现。在异向排列（上下表面磁矩方向相反）的构型下，法拉第效应为零，而反射测量的克尔效应为有限值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了反铁磁体表面磁光响应的独特物理机制，表明通过选择合适的晶体终止条件和测量方式（反射而非透射），可以有效地探测反铁磁表面的弱磁信号，为反铁磁自旋电子学与磁光表征提供新思路。

title: Tuning single-molecule fluorescence by atomic-scale control of the local environment
summary: Molecules that absorb and emit light play a central role in microscopy, light-emitting devices and photosynthesis. Their fluorescence arises from well-defined radiative transitions that are governed by the electronic states and their coupling to the nuclear motion that are influenced by the local environment. Yet the effect of controlled atomic-scale variations in the emitter surroundings remains unexplored. Here, we use scanning tunneling microscopy combined with optical spectroscopy to investigate the optical response of a single phthalocyanine to the change in the position of a nearby molecule, controlled with precision better than 100 pm. Upon decreasing the intermolecular distance, the molecular emission energy redshifts and its line profile evolves. Supported by theoretical calculations, we disentangle the electronic and nuclear contributions to the changes in fluorescence. We find that the redshift originates from the interaction between the excitations of the two molecules, while the lineshape changes reflect modifications of the molecular rotational degree of freedom and non-equilibrium dynamics. We extend this control to larger assemblies, where one molecule tunes the energies of two chromophores, mimicking the environmental tuning in photosynthetic systems. Our study provides atomic-scale insight into how the local environment affects the optical properties of molecular systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用扫描隧道显微镜结合光学光谱技术，以亚100皮米的精度控制单分子周围的邻近分子位置，探究其对单个酞菁分子光学响应的影响。研究发现分子间距离减小时，发射能量发生红移且线型演化，并通过理论计算分离了电子和核贡献，揭示了红移源于分子间激发相互作用，线型变化反映转动自由度和非平衡动力学的改变。该控制还可扩展到更大的分子组装体，模拟光合系统环境调谐机制。
AI.motivation: 荧光分子的光学性质受电子态与核运动耦合及局域环境影响，但受控原子尺度变化对发射体周围环境的影响此前未被探索，亟需在原子尺度揭示局域环境如何调控分子光学性质。
AI.method: 采用扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合光学光谱，以优于100皮米的精度控制邻近分子的位置；结合理论计算，分离电子与核运动对荧光变化的贡献，并扩展到多分子组装体系。
AI.result: 分子间距离减小时，分子发射能量发生红移且谱线轮廓演化；红移源于两分子激发的相互作用，线型变化源于分子转动自由度和非平衡动力学改变；该机制可扩展到更大组装体，实现单分子对双发色团的能量调谐。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在原子尺度揭示了局域环境对分子体系光学性质的影响机制，为理解并调控分子级光物理过程提供了新途径，并对模拟光合系统的环境调谐具有重要意义。

title: Effect of Magnetic Vacancies on the Spontaneous Spin-Reorientation Transition in HoFe$_{1-x}$Al$_x$O$_3$ Single Crystals
summary: In this work, we report the first growth of single crystals of the substitution series HoFe$_{1-x}$Al$_x$O$_3$ with aluminium concentrations up to $x=0.2$ and investigate the evolution of their spontaneous spin-reorientation transition (SRT). Among rare-earth orthoferrites, HoFeO$_3$ exhibits a distinctive sequence of magnetic phases ($Γ_4$-$Γ_{24}$-$Γ_{12}$-$Γ_2$). This complex sequence arises from the competition between the $K_{ac}$ and $K_{ab}$ anisotropies associated with the Ho$^{3+}$ ions and the effective magnetic field produced by the weak ferromagnetic moment of the canted Fe$^{3+}$ sublattice. Introducing magnetic vacancies perturbs the antiferromagnetic compensation of the Fe$^{3+}$ subsystem in the $ab$ plane and generates an additional effective magnetic field acting on the Ho$^{3+}$ ions. This field alters the balance between the $K_{ac}$ and $K_{ab}$ anisotropies within the SRT temperature range and thereby broadens the stability range of the $Γ_{12}$ phase in the magnetic phase diagram.

AI.tldr: 本文首次成功生长了铝取代的HoFe$_{1-x}$Al$_x$O$_3$单晶（x最高达0.2），并研究了其自发自旋重取向转变（SRT）的演化。研究发现铝引入的磁空位扰乱了Fe$^{3+}$子系统的反铁磁补偿，产生附加有效磁场作用于Ho$^{3+}$离子，从而改变K$_{ac}$与K$_{ab}$各向异性的平衡，拓宽了Γ$_{12}$相在磁相图中的稳定范围。
AI.motivation: HoFeO$_3$具有独特的磁相序列（Γ$_4$-Γ$_{24}$-Γ$_{12}$-Γ$_2$），其来源是Ho$^{3+}$离子的各向异性与Fe$^{3+}$弱铁磁矩产生的有效磁场之间的竞争。理解如何通过化学取代调控这种竞争关系，对于深入认识稀土正铁氧体中的自旋重取向机制具有重要意义。
AI.method: 通过晶体生长方法制备了HoFe$_{1-x}$Al$_x$O$_3$系列单晶（x=0~0.2），系统研究了铝取代对自旋重取向转变的影响。铝取代在Fe$^{3+}$亚晶格中引入磁空位，破坏ab平面内的反铁磁补偿，从而产生作用于Ho$^{3+}$离子的附加有效磁场。
AI.result: 铝取代产生的附加有效磁场改变了SRT温度范围内K$_{ac}$和K$_{ab}$各向异性之间的平衡，从而拓宽了Γ$_{12}$相在磁相图中的稳定范围，使整个自旋重取向转变的相序列和温度区间发生系统性演化。
AI.conclusion: 通过铝取代引入磁空位可以有效调控HoFeO$_3$中Ho$^{3+}$离子感受到的有效磁场，进而调节各向异性之间的竞争平衡，实现对自旋重取向转变和磁相图的可控调控。

title: Optical Response Beyond Magnetic Symmetries
summary: The optical response of magnetic materials is conventionally classified through magnetic space groups (MSGs), where spin and lattice are locked by the relativistic spin-orbit interaction. However, most optical observables are governed primarily by nonrelativistic physics, and thus a purely MSG-based description can overlook important insights. Here we systematically show that spin-space groups (SSGs), which operate at the nonrelativistic level, provide a broader and more predictive framework for analyzing a variety of optical responses of magnets. Focusing on linear optical absorption, we derive the transformation rules imposed by SSGs and show that they generate effective real-space point groups, which can enforce relations among charge response coefficients that are absent from conventional MSG analysis. We illustrate the basic principle in a Lieb-lattice altermagnet model with tunable spin-orbit coupling, where SSG predictions on the linear dichroism remain remarkably accurate even when relativistic band splittings become sizable. We further establish the predictive power of this framework through first-principles calculations on two altermagnetic candidates: the actinide UCr2Si2C, where the optical absorption remains nearly isotropic despite its strong spin-orbit coupling and the pronounced anisotropy apparent from magnetic symmetries, and the transition-metal fluoride RbMnF4, where birefringence is confined to a single plane by symmetries emerging exclusively from SSGs. Finally, we extend the concept to the spin Hall response of the coplanar noncollinear antiferromagnet ScMnO3, where SSGs explain the hierarchy of calculated spin Hall coefficients, demonstrating their direct relevance to spintronics as well.

AI.tldr: 本文系统展示了自旋空间群（SSGs）为分析磁体的光学响应提供了比传统磁空间群（MSGs）更广泛、更具预测性的框架。作者推导了SSG对线性光学吸收的变换规则，生成了有效的实空间点群，能强制执行传统MSG分析所缺失的电荷响应系数间的关系。通过Lieb晶格交替磁体模型、第一性原理计算（UCr2Si2C和RbMnF4）以及共面非共线反铁磁体ScMnO3的自旋霍尔响应验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统上磁材料的光学响应通过磁空间群（MSGs）分类，其中自旋和晶格被相对论性自旋-轨道耦合锁定。然而大多数光学可观测量主要由非相对论物理支配，因此纯粹基于MSG的描述可能忽视重要的物理洞察。作者旨在引入自旋空间群（SSGs）作为更全面的分析框架。
AI.method: 1) 系统推导SSGs对线性光学吸收施加的变换规则，生成有效的实空间点群；2) 在具有可调自旋-轨道耦合的Lieb晶格交替磁体模型上验证基本原理，测试线性二色性的SSG预测准确性；3) 对两种交替磁体候选材料（UCr2Si2C和RbMnF4）进行第一性原理计算验证；4) 将概念扩展到共面非共线反铁磁体ScMnO3的自旋霍尔响应分析。
AI.result: 1) Lieb晶格模型中，即使相对论能带劈裂显著增大，SSG对线性二色性的预测仍然非常准确；2) UCr2Si2C尽管具有强自旋-轨道耦合和明显的磁对称各向异性，其光学吸收仍接近各向同性；3) RbMnF4的双折射被限制在单一平面内，这是仅由SSGs产生的对称性的结果；4) ScMnO3中SSGs解释了计算得到的自旋霍尔系数层级结构，证明其对自旋电子学的直接相关性。
AI.conclusion: 自旋空间群（SSGs）框架为磁体的光学响应和自旋输运性质提供了比传统磁空间群更强大、更具预测性的描述工具，即使在相对论效应显著的情况下依然有效，对光电材料和自旋电子学领域具有重要意义。

title: Tuning electronic properties and Schottky contact in graphene-based van der Waals heterostructures by electric gating and interlayer coupling
comment: Main Manuscript: 13 figures, 16 pages. Supplemental Material: 9 figures, 6 pages
summary: Van der Waals heterostructures (vdW HTSs) incorporating graphene (GE) have been an active area of research, both theoretical and experimental, due to their potential to yield devices with a wide variety of applications. In this paper, first-principles calculations are employed to investigate C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/GE, hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$/GE, and C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$ 2D vdW HTSs. A systematic analysis of structural and thermodynamic stability, electronic, mechanical, and optical properties of semiconductor/metal and semiconductor/semiconductor interfaces is performed. Both semiconductor/metal HTSs form $n$-type Schottky contacts, which can be converted into $p$-type Schottky or Ohmic contacts by tuning the external perpendicular electric field and the interlayer coupling. In the semiconductor/semiconductor C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$ HTS, the valence and conduction band edges originate from distinct layers, resulting in a type-II band alignment that promotes efficient electron-hole (e-h) separation. Furthermore, the band alignment can be effectively tuned between type-I and type-II by applying an external electric field and varying the interlayer distance. From the optical absorption spectra of the HTSs, we concluded that the C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/GE and hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$/GE exhibit an optical response across a wide frequency range, whereas the C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$ HTS shows prominent activity primarily in the ultraviolet region. Using the $G_{0}W_{0}$+BSE approach, the exciton binding energies are also calculated for the gapped systems, namely C$_{6}$N$_{6}$, hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$ monolayers, and their HTS (C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$), yielding values of 1.01 eV, 1.14 eV, and 1.18 eV, respectively, highlighting strong e-h interactions. Moreover, the band-edge analysis of C$_{6}$N$_{6}$/hg-C$_{3}$N$_{4}$ HTS further favors pronounced interlayer e-h coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算，系统研究了C6N6/GE、hg-C3N4/GE和C6N6/hg-C3N4三种二维范德华异质结的结构稳定性、电子、力学和光学性质。半导体/金属异质结形成n型肖特基接触，可通过外电场和层间耦合调控为p型或欧姆接触；半导体/半导体异质结呈现type-II能带对齐，有利于电子-空穴分离，并可通过外电场和层间距在type-I和type-II间调控。G0W0+BSE计算表明激子束缚能高达约1 eV，体现强电子-空穴相互作用。
AI.motivation: 石墨烯基范德华异质结在理论和实验上都是活跃的研究领域，因其有望制造具有广泛应用前景的器件。作者旨在通过第一性原理系统探索不同半导体/金属和半导体/半导体组合的异质结性质，为器件设计提供理论指导。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算(DFT)系统研究三种2D vdW异质结的结构与热力学稳定性、电子、力学和光学性质；通过施加外部垂直电场和调节层间耦合来调控肖特基接触类型和能带对齐；使用G0W0+BSE方法计算带隙系统的激子束缚能。
AI.result: 半导体/金属异质结(C6N6/GE、hg-C3N4/GE)形成n型肖特基接触，可调为p型或欧姆接触；C6N6/hg-C3N4为type-II能带对齐，利于e-h分离，且可在外电场和层间距调控下转变为type-I。光学吸收上，含GE的异质结覆盖宽频范围，而C6N6/hg-C3N4主要在紫外区活跃。激子束缚能分别为1.01、1.14和1.18 eV，体现强e-h相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 三种vdW异质结具有可调控的电子结构特性，尤其是C6N6/hg-C3N4展现出type-II能带对齐和强激子效应，有望在光电器件中实现高效电荷分离，为设计新型二维范德华异质结器件提供理论依据。

title: Insights into the Structural and Orientational Ordering of 2D Metal Halide Perovskites
summary: Metal halide perovskite nanoplatelets combine quantum confinement with structural anisotropy, yet how thickness and processing govern their internal crystal lattice versus collective organization remains unresolved. In this study, we separate internal structure, superlattice organization, and film texture using 2-5 monolayer CsPbBr3 nanoplatelets and larger nanocrystals across spin-coating and drop-casting routes. Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction analysis of the specimens indicates that orthorhombic-compatible signatures recur throughout the thickness and deposition series, with a preserved lattice-morphology relationship in which 020/040 and 101/202 lattice planes are associated with the platelet thickness and lateral dimensions, respectively. Upon deposition on the substrate, we notice a thickness-dependent crossover: 2-monolayer nanoplatelets remain predominantly face-on across deposition routes, whereas thicker nanoplatelets show marked processing sensitivity and orientational disorder. Processing therefore can be used as a tool to direct the NPL packing, establishing thickness as a key determinant of processing sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用掠入射X射线衍射（GIXD）系统分析了2-5个单层CsPbBr3纳米片及更大纳米晶的内部晶格结构、超晶格组织和薄膜织构，揭示厚度与加工方式对纳米片取向行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 金属卤化物钙钛矿纳米片兼具量子限域效应和结构各向异性，但厚度和加工条件如何调控其内部晶格与集体组织之间的关系仍不清楚，需要独立解耦这两方面的影响。
AI.method: 对2-5个单层的CsPbBr3纳米片和更大尺寸纳米晶，分别采用旋涂和滴涂两种沉积方式制备样品，并利用掠入射X射线衍射（GIXD）分析内部结构、超晶格组织和薄膜织构。
AI.result: 所有厚度和沉积系列中均出现正交相兼容的衍射特征，且晶格-形貌关系保持稳定：020/040晶面与纳米片厚度相关，101/202晶面与横向尺寸相关。沉积后观察到厚度依赖的交叉转变：2个单层的纳米片在各种沉积方式下均以面朝上（face-on）排列为主，而更厚的纳米片则表现出明显的加工敏感性和取向无序。
AI.conclusion: 加工方式可作为调控纳米片堆积的有效工具，厚度是决定加工敏感性的关键因素，为定向控制钙钛矿纳米片薄膜织构提供了设计原则。

title: Mechanical-microstructural correlation on SPS-fabricated NiTi alloy
summary: Mechanical properties and dynamical mechanical analysis were performed on compact Spark Plasma Sinter samples. It has been observed that the sample with less porosity reflects the behavior of superelasticity response. Other samples show failure during first cycles that may be due to porosity. Compaction of metallic powder is one of the standard procedures in the field of powder metallurgy for the fabrication of bulk material. Consolidation of the sample as a function of sintering temperature plays a crucial role in the final compaction mechanism. However, the evolution of compaction, microstructure, phase transformation and mechanical properties as a function of sintering temperature is hardly disclosed. In this work, a correlation has been established between mechanical and microstructural properties of compact samples. The maximum compactness and the corresponding microstructure, porosity, texture, phase transformation, grain size, hardness, mechanical properties of compact samples were discussed. The research establishes mechanical properties-structure correlations for compaction of NiTi alloy in advanced engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究对NiTi合金的放电等离子烧结（SPS）致密样品进行了力学性能与动态力学分析（DMA），发现低孔隙率的样品表现出超弹性响应，而多孔样品在首个循环中即发生失效。论文建立了烧结温度与致密化程度、微观结构、相变行为及力学性能之间的关联。
AI.motivation: 金属粉末压实是粉末冶金制备块体材料的标准工艺之一，烧结温度对最终致密化机制至关重要。然而，目前关于烧结温度如何影响压实过程中的致密化、微观结构、相变及力学性能的演变尚缺乏系统性研究。
AI.method: 对致密SPS样品进行动态力学分析（DMA）和力学性能测试，并结合微观结构表征（包括孔隙率、织构、相变、晶粒尺寸、硬度）来建立力学性能与结构之间的相关性。
AI.result: 低孔隙率样品表现出超弹性响应，而孔隙率较高的样品在初始循环中即发生失效；研究建立了烧结温度与样品最大致密化程度、微观结构及力学性能之间的相关关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为NiTi合金在先进工程应用中的粉末压实工艺提供了力学性能与微观结构之间的关联机制，有助于优化烧结工艺参数以获得更优综合性能的致密材料。

title: Enhancing Hydrogen Adsorption Ability of MOF-5 with Metal Node Exchange and Linker Functionalisation
summary: In the search for promising material candidates for hydrogen storage, we investigate from first principles derivatives of metal organic framework 5 (MOF-5), including isoelectronic substitution of the metal centers (Zn $\rightarrow$ Mg, Cd) and linker functionalization with NH$_2$, OH, and NO$_2$ groups. Metal-node substitution consistently stabilises and ligand functionalization systematically enhances H$_2$ binding at the metal-oxo cluster sites. The combination of Cd centers and NO$_2$ groups proves to be most efficient, yielding an adsorption energy of -15.58 kJ mol$^{\text{-1}}$, which substantially outperforms the storage ability of pristine MOF-5.
