Detailed electronic structure analysis clarifies how the local framework environment coordinates the guest molecule, providing a robust design framework to guide the experimental development of advanced adsorbent materials.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了MOF-5的衍生物（金属中心替换为Mg、Cd，配体引入NH₂、OH、NO₂官能团）对储氢性能的影响，发现Cd与NO₂的组合最优，吸附能达到-15.58 kJ/mol，显著优于原始MOF-5。
AI.motivation: 寻找高性能储氢材料是清洁能源领域的核心挑战，而MOF-5作为代表性多孔材料具有储氢潜力，需要通过化学修饰系统性地优化其储氢性能。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理计算方法，系统考察了MOF-5的等电子金属中心替换（Zn→Mg、Cd）和配体官能团化（NH₂、OH、NO₂）对H₂吸附行为的影响，并结合电子结构分析揭示吸附机理。
AI.result: 金属节点替换和配体官能化均能改善储氢性能，其中Cd中心和NO₂基团的组合表现最佳，H₂吸附能为-15.58 kJ/mol，远超原始MOF-5的储氢能力。
AI.conclusion: 电子结构分析阐明了局部框架环境如何协调客体H₂分子，为实验开发先进吸附材料提供了稳健的设计框架。

title: Machine Learning-Accelerated Band-Edge Engineering of Pnictogen Chalcohalide Solid Solutions for Solar Energy Technologies
summary: Pnictogen chalcohalide (MChX; M=Bi,Sb; Ch=S,Se; X=I,Br) solid solutions combine earth-abundant constituents, tunable band gaps ($1.2$-$2.1$ eV), and strong optical absorption, making them attractive for solar energy conversion. Yet their vast compositional space has so far prevented a systematic assessment of how band-edge positions vary with stoichiometry and surface termination. Here, we combine first-principles density functional theory with machine learning to predict the valence and conduction band-edge positions of $\mathrm{Bi}_x\mathrm{Sb}_{1-x}\mathrm{S}_y\mathrm{Se}_{1-y}\mathrm{I}_z\mathrm{Br}_{1-z}$ solid solutions across their full compositional range on the two most stable surfaces, (010) and (011). We find that the valence-band maximum and conduction-band minimum can be tuned by more than $1$ eV through composition alone, and shift by up to $0.6$ eV between the two surface terminations for a same composition despite their nearly degenerate formation energies, establishing facet selection as a design parameter on par with chemical substitution. Guided by these results, we identify specific compositions capable of driving hydrogen, ammonia, methane, hydrogen peroxide, and oxygen (photo)electrochemical half-reactions, and show that several electron- and hole-transport contact materials commonly used in photovoltaic devices align with MChX solid solutions only as hole-selective contacts.

AI.tldr: 本文结合第一性原理密度泛函理论与机器学习，系统预测了铋锑硫硒碘溴固溶体（MChX）在整个组分空间内两种最稳定表面上的价带和导带带边位置，发现组分可调节带边超过1 eV，而表面终止可造成高达0.6 eV的偏移，并据此识别出能驱动多种光/电化学半反应的具体组分。
AI.motivation: MChX固溶体具有地球资源丰富、带隙可调（1.2-2.1 eV）和强光吸收等优点，是有前景的太阳能转换材料。但其巨大的组分空间阻碍了系统评估带边位置随化学计量和表面终止的变化，缺乏对能带边缘的系统认识阻碍了材料设计。
AI.method: 将第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）与机器学习相结合，预测BixSb1-xSySe1-yIzBr1-z固溶体在整个组分范围内两种最稳定表面（010）和（011）上的价带最大与导带最小位置。
AI.result: 仅通过组分即可调节价带最大值和导带最小值超过1 eV；同一组分在两种表面终止之间的带边偏移可达0.6 eV，而两种表面形成能几乎简并，表明晶面选择与化学取代同等重要。据此识别出能驱动氢、氨、甲烷、过氧化氢和氧气等光/电化学半反应的具体组分，并发现常用光伏电子和空穴传输接触材料仅能作为MChX固溶体的空穴选择性接触。
AI.conclusion: 组分和晶面选择都是MChX固溶体能级工程的关键设计参数，该工作为太阳能转换器件中的能带对准和接触材料选择提供了系统性指导。

title: Strain control of mid-IR spectroscopic nonlinear photocurrents in PtSe$_2$
summary: Semi-metallic noble-metal dichalcogenides are promising materials for infrared optoelectronics, yet the origin and tunability of their nonlinear optical responses remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate in-situ mechanical control of photon-drag photocurrents in polycrystalline PtSe$_2$ thin films grown on flexible polyimide substrates. Using polarization-resolved mid-infrared photocurrent spectroscopy under uniaxial tensile strain, we observe pronounced strain-dependent changes in resistivity, photoconductivity, and helicity-dependent nonlinear photocurrents. The spectral response is consistent with optical excitations across the spin-orbit-coupling-induced (SOC) band gap near the K point. We develop a theoretical framework attributing the photocurrent primarily to photon-drag induced by photon-momentum symmetry breaking. Strain modifies its magnitude and polarization dependence through deformation potentials that tune the SOC-induced band gap. These results establish mechanical strain as a route toward reconfigurable infrared polarization detection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了柔性基底上生长的多晶PtSe₂薄膜中，单轴拉伸应变对光拖拽光电流的非线性光学响应的调控机制，并通过理论框架将其归因于应变通过形变势调控自旋轨道耦合（SOC）带隙，从而改变光电流的幅度和偏振依赖性，为可重构红外偏振探测提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 半金属贵金属二硫族化合物在红外光电子学中具有应用前景，但其非线性光学响应的起源和可调性尚不清楚，亟需深入理解其机制并探索调控手段。
AI.method: 在柔性聚酰亚胺基底上生长多晶PtSe₂薄膜，通过偏振分辨中红外光电流光谱技术，在单轴拉伸应变下系统测量电阻率、光电导率及螺旋度依赖的非线性光电流变化，并结合理论框架将光电流归因于光子动量对称性破缺引起的光拖拽效应，通过形变势调制SOC带隙来解释应变的影响。
AI.result: 观察到显著的应变依赖的电阻率、光电导率和螺旋度依赖非线性光电流变化；光谱响应与K点附近由自旋轨道耦合诱导的带隙光学激发一致；建立了将光电流主要归因于光子动量对称性破缺诱导的光拖拽效应的理论框架。
AI.conclusion: 机械应变可作为调控红外光电器件性能的有效手段，为实现可重构红外偏振检测提供了新思路。

title: Data-driven discovery and rapid, direct synthesis of MXenes
summary: MXenes, two-dimensional transition-metal carbides and nitrides, are typically obtained from MAX phases, yet historical reports suggest a broader, largely unexplored chemical space. Here we combine machine-learning-assisted database mining with experiments to uncover overlooked multilayer (ml) MXenes. Screening of repositories reveals a "Treasure Chest" of 38 previously synthesized but unrecognized ml-MXene candidates. Guided by these findings, we rediscover five MXenes using a rapid, scalable self-propagating high-temperature synthesis that requires no sustained external heating and completes within minutes. Inspired by the identified chemistries, we further realize 11 previously unexplored rare-earth-based M2CT2 MXenes (M= Pr, Nd, Sm, Gd, Tb, Ho, and Tm). Experiments and theory reveal semiconducting behavior and diverse magnetic states across this family. Together, these results expand the MXene family and demonstrate a data-driven strategy for accelerating materials discovery through sustainable methods.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过机器学习辅助数据库挖掘发现38个被忽视的ml-MXene候选材料，并利用无需持续外部加热的自蔓延高温合成法在几分钟内重新发现了5种MXene，进而实现了11种此前未探索的稀土基M2CT2 MXene，扩展了MXene家族。
AI.motivation: MXene通常从MAX相获得，但历史文献表明存在更广泛且尚未被充分探索的化学空间。研究者希望通过数据驱动的方法挖掘被忽视的MXene材料，以加速材料发现。
AI.method: 结合机器学习辅助数据库挖掘与实验验证；使用自蔓延高温合成方法进行快速、可扩展的合成，无需持续外部加热；基于发现的化学组成进一步探索稀土基MXene。
AI.result: 筛选出38个此前已合成但未被识别的ml-MXene候选；重新发现5种MXene；实现11种稀土基M2CT2 MXene（M=Pr, Nd, Sm, Gd, Tb, Ho, Tm）；实验和理论证明其具有半导体行为和多样的磁性状态。
AI.conclusion: 该工作扩展了MXene家族，并展示了数据驱动策略与可持续合成方法相结合可加速材料发现。

title: A nuclear-quantum-corrected machine-learning potential reveals quantum-enhanced hydrogen segregation at general grain boundaries in alpha-iron
summary: Atomistic descriptions of hydrogen diffusion and trapping at defects are essential for understanding hydrogen embrittlement. As the lightest solute in metals, hydrogen exhibits nuclear quantum effects that alter these processes even at room temperature. Explicit treatment of such effects is computationally demanding, limiting large-scale simulations of complex environments. Here, we use an Fe-H machine-learning interatomic potential (MLIP) based on the performant implementation of the atomic cluster expansion (PACE), covering diverse Fe-H environments, and relabel the training configurations underpinning its transferability with quantum mean forces from centroid-constrained path-integral molecular dynamics at 300 K. This yields a nuclear-quantum-corrected PACE (NQC-PACE) without additional density functional theory calculations. At parent PACE, NQC-PACE describes nuclear quantum effects on hydrogen trapping at vacancies, dislocations, surfaces and general grain boundaries, H-H interactions, and diffusion in alpha-Fe. Grand-canonical Monte Carlo/molecular dynamics simulations show nuclear quantum effects markedly enhance hydrogen segregation at general grain boundaries and trapping behaviour in closer agreement with experimental trends. This enhancement arises from selective quantum stabilisation of open, anisotropically soft local environments. Our framework uses finite-temperature quantum mean forces to relabel the configurational space covered by an MLIP, enabling large-scale analysis of complex materials where light-element quantum effects matter.

AI.tldr: 本文通过用量子均力重新标记Fe-H机器学习原子间势（PACE）的训练构型，构建了核量子修正的NQC-PACE势，无需额外DFT计算即可描述氢在α-Fe中的扩散、捕获及晶界偏析等核量子效应，并通过巨正则蒙特卡洛/分子动力学模拟揭示了核量子效应对氢在一般晶界处偏析的显著增强作用。
AI.motivation: 氢脆问题中氢在缺陷处的扩散和捕获至关重要，但氢作为最轻的溶质原子，其核量子效应即使在室温下也显著影响这些过程。显式处理核量子效应计算代价高昂，限制了复杂环境下的大规模模拟，因此需要一种高效且准确的方法来在机器学习势中引入核量子效应。
AI.method: 基于PACE实现构建Fe-H机器学习原子间势，覆盖多样化的Fe-H环境；在300K下通过质心约束路径积分分子动力学生成量子均力，用于重新标记（relabel）底层训练构型，从而在不进行额外DFT计算的情况下获得核量子修正的NQC-PACE势。
AI.result: NQC-PACE准确描述了核量子效应对氢在空位、位错、表面和一般晶界处的捕获、H-H相互作用及α-Fe中的扩散的影响。巨正则蒙特卡洛/分子动力学模拟表明，核量子效应显著增强了氢在一般晶界处的偏析行为，且更符合实验趋势，这种增强源于开放、各向异性软局部环境的选择性量子稳定化。
AI.conclusion: 该框架利用有限温度量子均力重新标记MLIP覆盖的构型空间，使得在复杂材料中进行大规模分析时能够考虑轻元素量子效应，为核量子效应敏感的复杂材料模拟提供了高效可行的途径。

title: Automated Burgers Vector Identification for Individual Dislocations in Bulk Crystals
summary: Weak-beam imaging in dark-field X-ray microscopy (DFXM) can resolve individual dislocations in bulk crystals, but assigning Burgers vectors from the resulting contrast typically requires manual comparison with forward simulations. Here, we train a physics-informed convolutional neural network (CNN) on geometrical optics simulations of isolated dislocations in face-centred cubic (FCC) aluminium, incorporating crystallographic constraints into the learning pro- cess. The model identifies Burgers vectors from weak-beam integrated rocking-curve images. On synthetic test data, the model achieves an accuracy of approximately 93%. In an experimental cross-slip case, the constrained model as- signs 72.7% of the layer-wise predictions to the reference Burgers vector. These results show that simulation-trained, physics-informed CNNs represent a step toward automated dislocation identification in DFXM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于物理信息的卷积神经网络（CNN），用于自动识别暗场X射线显微镜（DFXM）弱束成像中单个位错的Burgers矢量，在合成测试数据上准确率约93%，在实验交叉滑移案例中层级预测与参考Burgers矢量的一致率达72.7%。
AI.motivation: DFXM弱束成像能够解析块体晶体中的单个位错，但从中分配Burgers矢量通常需要人工对照正向模拟，过程耗时且主观，亟需自动化的识别方法。
AI.method: 在面心立方（FCC）铝的孤立位错几何光学模拟上训练物理信息CNN，将晶体学约束纳入学习过程，从弱束积分摇摆曲线图像中识别Burgers矢量。
AI.result: 合成测试数据上模型准确率约93%；在实验交叉滑移案例中，约束模型将72.7%的层级预测分配到参考Burgers矢量。
AI.conclusion: 模拟训练、物理信息驱动的CNN代表了向DFXM自动化位错识别迈出的重要一步。
